jobs.title: Store Manager
jobs.description:
What to expect when you work here

As a Store Manager (SM), you will be responsible for managing the store’s team members and the overall success of the store. You will partner with your Assistant Store Manager to hold your team accountable for meeting sales goals by ensuring that they provide friendly, enthusiastic customer service. You will be expected to maintain a strong sense of product knowledge, and to provide customers and team members with in-depth information on product features and benefits. You will also be responsible for managing all store operations, including opening and closing procedures, administering returns/store credit, managing schedules, performance metrics and standards, and dividing tasks amongst your team.

You can expect our 5 Core Values to drive everything we do.

Aim For The Podium:

• We provide an outstanding shopping experience and deliver exceptional customer service. The SM is an essential sales driver, coach, and communicator, providing training, leading by example, and communicating sales goals
• Ensure that merchandising is completed according to MAPP, and that the store aesthetic is clean, stocked, and organized
• Stay up-to-date with our brand and product knowledge, company information, sales and company-wide events, truly becoming a resource to your team and our customer base
• Hustle, improve, win, and don’t fear change. Take victory laps, and celebrate wins big and small
• Build and retain a winning team by partnering with Talent Acquisition and actively recruiting in-store and in your local community

Take Risks; Wear a Helmet:

• It never hurts to try something new. We are always looking to grow and progress and want to hear all your new ideas.
• Little wins can make a big difference - when you try something new, and it works, feed the idea up, so it can be shared. The best new ideas come from the teams in our stores!
• Don't be afraid to fail; no one is right all the time, but you can always be well-prepared.

Share The Road:

• We take the health, safety, and wellness of our employees seriously. Our Wellness program and safety committee offers workshops, classes, resources, etc. to all of our team members
• Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion council and employee resource groups promote open and honest communication, remove barriers, and champion policies to build a more equitable environment
• Do the right thing, and lead by example with a friendly and upbeat personality
• Set a tone of friendly competition, so that your team works together when selling, and everyone understands when to step back and when to step up and offer help

Keep It Real:

• You'll earn an hourly base rate, plus you'll have a chance to earn commission on a tiered system, based on meeting your sales goal, with additional incentives available, such as SPIFFS and monthly bonus potential
• Full Time benefits include Medical/Dental/Vision/Life/Accident, Paid Time Off, 401K, and a generous employee discount
• Because a whole lot of life happens between paychecks, Comoto also offers a voluntary benefit to all team members called DailyPay which allows for secure, instant transfers of earned pay before payday. This benefit is available to all team members immediately upon hire
• We strongly value training and development - with that, your first fiscal month of employment will be base pay only, so you may focus on learning
• Deliver honest feedback in a way that motivates your team members to push for their best

Fuel Your Passion:

• Work in an industry that you are passionate about!
• We are a growing company, and we promote from within - career opportunities!
• Represent Cycle Gear at special events, such as annual sales meetings, Bike Nights, local motorcycle venues and mechanic schools, etc.
• We have the best customers! Riders are passionate, friendly, charitable, community-minded people, and we get to interact with them every day!

Our next Store Manager has:

• Sales management, product sales, and/or customer service experience, ideally in a specialty retail environment
• Demonstrated the ability to lead a team that delivers results
• A proven track record of teaching, motivating and holding a team accountable
• Experience with computers (MS Excel) and POS systems (RetailPro)
• A self-starter mentality that consistently delivers an outstanding, personalized retail experience
• An open mind, and is eager to learn and be a part of the riding community
• Motorcycle riding, knowledge, or interest (strongly desired, but not a requirement)

Cycle Gear provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics.

jobs.title: CNC Programmer / T&D Machinist
jobs.description:
Title:  CNC Programmer / Machinist

Reports to:  Tool and Die Supervisor

Job Purpose:  Program, qualify, and produce machined parts using CNC Mills, CNC Lathes, Wire EDM machines, and manual milling and grinding equipment.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Create, save and maintain CNC programs using MasterCAM software from Auto-Cad or step files.
• Create, save, and maintain working drawings and files.
• Set up one-off and/or production jobs to run for self and others.
• Maintain quality standards and tolerances.
• Keep records as directed in work orders for time and materials.
• Maintain equipment per OEM and PSG requirements.
• Maintain supplies.
• Set up and operate standard milling machine, lathe, drill press, grinder and other machine tools as directed under general supervision.
• Work directly with engineering to design and manufacture tooling, fixtures, and production parts.
• Follow all OSHA and internal safety standards.
• Perform other duties as required or assigned by supervisor.

• High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent work experience.
• 5 years minimum verifiable machinist experience and/or Technical Diploma.
• Ability to program, qualify, and run CNC equipment.
• Ability to perform standard shop computations (math).
• Ability to read schematics (blue prints), engineering drawings, and technical manuals.
• Ability to perform basic maintenance of equipment.
• Ability to utilize heat treat equipment.
• Ability to read, understand, follow and enforce safety procedures.
• Ability to make administrative/procedural decisions and judgments as well as work within a team environment.

Phoenix Stamping Group, LLC offers a drug-free work place along with a competitive salary and benefits package. jobs.description:

jobs.title: Document Production Workflow Coordinator - 1st Shift (Onsite)
jobs.description:
The Document Production Workflow Coordinator is an experienced position delivering exceptional customer service to our clients by providing timely and accurate document production of an intermediate to advanced level.  Advanced ability to assess documents, has a technical eye to detect and ensure proper corrections (proofing, edits, conversions, formatting, creation, comparisons, etc.) for requesters.  The position requires advanced software aptitude in those programs used for document production, as well as speed and accuracy in a high-volume, high-pressure production environment.  The Document Production Workflow Coordinator may require the training of team members, and may be responsible for the day-to-day coordination of workflow within a shift or site.

1st Shift Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00 am - 5 pm Eastern

Job duties

(* denotes an “essential function”)

• *Intakes work requests from the client; including clarification of job instructions and negotiation of deadlines with the requester. Seeks alternate solutions to deadline requests, as needed
• *Prioritizes work requests across team and coordinates/balances multiple projects based on experience and following established guidelines, especially when working with escalated deadlines or issues
• *Acts as a leading definitive resource for all questions relating to document production, proofreading and quality assurance by the team
• *Identifies and corrects errors in complex business documents to ensure quality of return product to requesters
• *Detects formatting and compositional errors in documents; verifies citations are properly formatted
• *Checks corrected proofs of documents against mark-up for comparison and quality assurance

• *Facilitates focus and coordination on and between shifts in the production of deliverables to the client in order to meet or exceed the client’s expectations for quality, timeliness and service
• *Trains more junior staff members, as needed
• Communicates with manager and/or client on job or deadline issues in a timely and professional manner
• Assists the Lead, Supervisor or Manager in the execution of administrative and/or other procedures or systems across impacted team members
• Facilitates team’s adherence to company policies (conduct, attire, performance, attendance)
• Works collaboratively, demonstrating open and flexible communication, within and across team members
• Contributes to recommendations for individual development goals, trainings, or performance expectations to Lead, Supervisor or Manager to enhance team skill levels and quality outputs

• Adhere to company policies in addition to client site policies.

Working conditions

• Ability to work overtime as needed.
• Work is performed in a professional work environment.
• Business casual attire required.
• Must be able to work sitting all or most of the time.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with years of experience able to substitute
• Minimum of 3 years prior office experience, proofreading, word processing or document production experience
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office suite; able to technically troubleshoot applicable software specific to the business/client
• MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) certification desired
• Advanced knowledge of document production and/or proofreading procedures and/or generally accepted practices
• Extensive experience in business terminology, document production and/or proofing formats; skill and efficiency in use of reference resources
• Attention to detail with emphasis on accuracy and quality; able to coordinate across the team and work on multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring quality results
• Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills necessary in order to communicate questions and/or suggestions to client and other team members in a professional and customer service oriented manner
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline driven team environment
• Good judgment and organizational skills with sound decision-making ability and solutions-oriented approach with the ability to ask for and follow directions
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team; self-motivated to ensure own production
• Communicate with team members, Lead, Supervisor, Manager and/or Client on job or deadline issues
• Must be able to meet deadlines and complete all projects in a timely manner.
• Ability to handle sensitive and/or confidential documents and information.
• Good problem-solving skills, with the ability and understanding of when to escalate a problem to a supervisory level.
• Must work well in a team environment.
• Must be able to interact effectively with multi-functional and diverse backgrounds.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Program Director - TSMO and Emerging Technology
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Program Director to lead our organization’s TSMO and emerging technology practices.

The Impact You’ll Make

• Provide strategic and technical leadership for the traffic systems management and operations and emerging technology program, establishing program direction, priorities, technical standards, and delivery strategies to drive successful outcomes across complex transportation initiatives.
• Lead the development and advancement of TSMO and emerging technology strategies and solutions that improve system reliability, reduce congestion, system safety, enhance traveler information and incident response, and address evolving transportation and operational needs.
• Serve as a national resource for pursuits or projects involving TSMO, ITS and emerging technology solutions
• Direct the strategy, design, development, and implementation of integrated traffic data systems that collect, process, analyze, and distribute multi-source data, including detectors, probe data, connected vehicle feeds, CCTV, signal systems, and third-party sources.
• Establish and lead the data architecture strategy supporting APIs and Center-to-Center (C2C) connections, ensuring scalable, secure, resilient, and interoperable data exchange across systems, agencies, and transportation partners.
• Establish and oversee data governance frameworks encompassing data standards, quality controls, ownership, access policies, metadata management, and compliance with agency and industry requirements.
• Provide technical direction for database and data-platform solutions, including relational, time-series, and cloud-based environments optimized for real-time operations, construction work zone data, historical analysis, and performance reporting.
• Lead the evaluation and application of AI platforms, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies to enhance data exchange, generate predictive insights, and deliver actionable intelligence that improves transportation operations and planning.
• Direct complex data integration initiatives across legacy and modern platforms, establishing approaches that ensure data quality, consistency, interoperability, scalability, and accessibility across operations, planning, and performance management.
• Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies into traffic management centers and operational systems
• Collaborate with traffic management center staff, traffic operations personnel, ITS engineers, signal technicians, IT teams, and external partners to translate operational needs into technical requirements and deployable solutions
• Provide technical leadership for the development and integration of data pipelines, APIs, C2C interfaces, and visualization solutions supporting real-time transportation operations, historical analysis, and data-driven decision-making.
• Establish and evaluate traffic system performance measures and analytical approaches to identify operational bottlenecks, assess countermeasure effectiveness, identify emerging needs, and guide data-driven operational and program improvements.
• Lead collaboration across traffic operations, ITS engineering, signal systems, IT teams, agencies, and external partners, translating complex operational and business needs into technical strategies, requirements, and deployable solutions.
• Advance program performance management and technical excellence through dashboards, after-action reporting, TSMO documentation, and performance insights; evaluate emerging transportation technologies and AI applications; and provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship across project teams.

The Expertise You’ll Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or closely related field.
• 12+ years of progressive experience in traffic engineering, ITS, traffic systems management and operations, data management systems, emerging technology, or related transportation technology disciplines, including technical leadership of complex programs or initiatives.
• Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred or ability to obtain within a reasonable timeframe.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex, multidisciplinary transportation programs and providing technical direction across engineering, operations, technology, and external stakeholder groups.
• Experience with ATMS, CAV data, and/or enterprise database solutions supporting transportation operational systems preferred.

What Sets You Up for Success

• Deep technical expertise in traffic data environments, including data collection systems, data integration, database design and management, and transportation system performance analysis.
• Advanced knowledge of data architecture for APIs and C2C connections and data governance principles within complex transportation environments.
• Strong knowledge of AI platforms, advanced analytics, TSMO principles, active traffic management strategies, emerging technologies, and real-time operations.
• Ability to evaluate complex transportation systems and technical challenges, establish strategic direction, and translate technical findings into actionable recommendations.
• Strong executive-level communication, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.

Why You'll Thrive at Egis

At Egis, you'll do more than build your career—you'll help shape the future of infrastructure. As we continue to expand across the United States, we're looking for curious, collaborative professionals who are passionate about solving complex challenges and delivering projects that improve communities and create lasting impact.

Whether you're launching your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading experts, collaborate across disciplines and borders, and contribute to projects that transform the way people live, move, and connect. Here, you'll be empowered to take on meaningful work, develop new skills, and grow your career with the support of a global engineering leader.

What Sets Egis Apart

• Meaningful Projects – Contribute to complex infrastructure projects that strengthen communities and improve quality of life.
• Global Expertise, Local Impact – Collaborate with technical specialists across North America and around the world while delivering solutions that make a difference locally.
• Career Growth – Expand your skills through mentorship, professional development, technical training, and leadership opportunities.
• Culture of Collaboration – Thrive in an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and teamwork drives success.
• Opportunity to Grow with Us – Join a rapidly expanding organization where your ideas, contributions, and career can grow alongside the business.

Total Rewards That Support You

We believe great work starts with supporting our people. That's why Egis offers a comprehensive Total Rewards program designed to promote your health, well-being, financial security, and professional growth, including:

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage
• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

jobs.title: EHS Manager - Environmental focus
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about environmental stewardship, regulatory compliance, workplace safety and sustainability? Do you have a talent for influencing and leading others to create a positive safety culture? We are seeking an experienced EHS Manager to join our team in the Beaumont/ Port Arthur, TX area.

As our Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Manager, you’ll play a key leadership role ensuring in protecting employees,  ensuring environmental compliance and driving continuous improvement  across our operations.

The EHS Manager will oversee environmental compliance programs, including air permitting and emissions management, wastewater, and stormwater compliance, hazardous waste management, environmental  monitoring, regulatory reporting, and permit compliance assurance. This position will work closely with operations, engineering, and other stakeholders to identify environmental risks, maintain compliance, implement corrective actions, and promote a culture of environmental responsibility and operational excellence.

We’re looking for someone who is a strong advocate for our safety culture and who will help everyone internalize the key attributes of

• Shared values and engagement at all levels
• Transparency
• Continuous education
• Proactive instead of reactive solutions

This role is best suited for someone with experience working in an environment with hazardous chemicals. If you like the idea of doing meaningful work with a company that’s on a mission to create a cleaner, more sustainable world for us all, here’s more!

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and manage a variety of EHS requirements and compliance implementation which includes regulations, air permitting, wastewater permitting and treatment and hazardous waste.

jobs.title: Furniture Advisor / Analyst
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Furniture Advisor / Analyst / Project Manager to join our Furniture Advisory team. This role will support furniture procurement and advisory engagements by developing competitive sourcing strategies, managing furniture budgets and schedules, evaluating vendor proposals, and delivering value-driven solutions for clients.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor throughout the furniture procurement lifecycle, partnering with clients, design consultants, manufacturers, dealers, and project teams to achieve cost savings, schedule certainty, and successful project outcomes.

Projects typically range from 2 to 18 months in duration and involve furniture packages averaging approximately $5 million in value.

• *Hybrid work environment with flexibility based on business and client requirements.
• *Occasional travel may be required to client sites, vendor presentations, and project locations.
• *Opportunity to work on large-scale workplace transformation, headquarters, and corporate real estate assignments across multiple industries.

Responsibilities

Furniture Advisory

• Develop furniture procurement and competitive bidding strategies in partnership with senior project leadership.
• Assist in the preparation and management of Requests for Proposal (RFPs), bid forms, evaluation criteria, and procurement documentation.
• Advise project teams on furniture sourcing approaches, dealer selection, and manufacturer engagement strategies.
• Coordinate and facilitate vendor interviews, showroom tours, presentations, and evaluation sessions.
• Maintain relationships with furniture dealers, manufacturers, and industry partners.

Budget Development & Cost Management

• Develop preliminary furniture budgets during project planning phases.
• Maintain furniture budgets throughout procurement activities through dealer award.
• Analyze furniture pricing, discount structures, extended costs, and cost-per-square-foot metrics.
• Validate manufacturer and dealer discounts against historical benchmarks and market conditions.
• Identify cost-saving opportunities and document client savings achievements.

Bid Evaluation & Analysis

• Consolidate and analyze vendor responses using advanced Excel-based modeling tools.
• Review specifications, drawings, and pricing submissions to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance.
• Verify discount structures and pricing assumptions across all bidders.
• Coordinate and communicate bidder questions, clarifications, and revisions throughout the procurement process.
• Prepare client-facing bid comparison analyses and executive summaries.

Project Management

• Partner with clients, project managers, design consultants, and contractors to align furniture procurement with overall project objectives.
• Develop and maintain furniture schedules, procurement milestones, and reporting dashboards.
• Monitor project deliverables to ensure budget, schedule, and quality objectives are achieved.
• Maintain complete and accurate project documentation throughout project execution.

Contract & Audit Support

• Support furniture audit engagements and procurement compliance reviews.
• Analyze historic purchasing data and contract documentation.
• Identify pricing discrepancies, discount variance, and contractual risks.
• Prepare findings reports and recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders.

Business Development & Client Engagement

• Participate in client presentations, strategy discussions, and business development pursuits.
• Support proposal development, fee estimation, project schedules, and scope of work preparation.
• Contribute to the growth and enhancement of furniture advisory services across the business.

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Interior Design, Construction Management, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Architecture, or a related discipline.

Experience

• Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in furniture procurement, workplace solutions, project management, interior construction, contract furniture, or related consulting services.
• Experience coordinating furniture procurement for corporate workplace projects is preferred.
• Experience working with major furniture manufacturers such as Steelcase, MillerKnoll, Haworth, Allsteel, Teknion, Kimball International, or equivalent is highly desirable.

Technical Skills

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial analysis, data validation, pivot tables, and complex formulas.
• Strong budget management and cost analysis capabilities.
• Experience evaluating furniture specifications, finish schedules, and procurement documentation.
• Working knowledge of furniture discount structures, pricing models, and dealer agreements.
• Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and other reporting tools.

Professional Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to interpret and communicate quantitative information to clients and project teams.
• Effective stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
• Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.

jobs.description:

As you develop in the position, you will take on increasing responsibility and work with greater independence on projects and assignments.

• Perform laboratory testing and analytical work in accordance with GMP and/or GLP guidelines.
• Execute studies and experiments following approved methods, protocols, and SOPs.
• Accurately document laboratory activities, data, and results.
• Assist with study monitoring, data review, and report preparation.

• Hands-on experience with HPLC and/or GC instrumentation.
• Experience using a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).

jobs.title: Principal Scientist II, AI-Guided Antibody Drug Conjugate Design
jobs.description:
We are seeking an innovative and highly experienced scientist to lead the application of artificial intelligence and machine learning to the design of next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). This role will integrate computational biology, antibody engineering, linker-payload chemistry, and translational drug discovery to create ADCs with improved efficacy, safety, and manufacturability.

The successful candidate will collaborate across biologics, medicinal chemistry, data science, and translational research teams to design and optimize antibody architectures, conjugation strategies, and linker systems for oncology, immunology, and emerging therapeutic areas.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and implement AI/ML models to guide ADC discovery and optimization, including target selection, antibody engineering, linker design, and payload selection.
• Build predictive models for critical ADC properties, including stability, internalization, efficacy, pharmacokinetics, toxicity, and therapeutic index.
• Apply generative AI, protein language models, and structure-based design approaches to create novel antibody formats and conjugation strategies.
• Integrate sequence, structural, biophysical, chemical, and biological datasets to accelerate iterative design-build-test cycles.
• Inform engineering of monoclonal antibodies and advanced biologic formats to improve affinity, selectivity, internalization, developability, and manufacturability.
• Design strategies for site-specific conjugation and optimized drug-to-antibody ratio (DAR).
• Guide experimental validation of engineered antibodies through close partnership with discovery and characterization teams.
• Develop predictive frameworks connecting linker chemistry and conjugation properties to efficacy, safety, biodistribution, and resistance mechanisms.
• Partner with chemistry teams to advance novel conjugation technologies and next-generation payload delivery platforms.
• Establish data strategies and computational workflows that improve decision quality and reduce experimental cycle times.
• Communicate findings and recommendations to project teams, senior leadership, and external scientific audiences.
• Maintain awareness of advances in AI, protein engineering, linker-payload technology, conjugation chemistry, and computational drug discovery.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Science related field with 16 years of related work; Master’s Degree Science or PharmD with 14 years of related work; PhD in Science or related field with 8 years of related work experience.
• PhD in computational biology, bioengineering, protein engineering, chemistry, chemical biology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related discipline.
• 8+ years of relevant industry experience in biologics, ADCs, protein engineering, computational drug design, or related therapeutic modalities.
• Demonstrated expertise in antibody engineering, including humanization, affinity maturation, format engineering, and developability optimization.
• Proven track record applying machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, or computational design methods to therapeutic discovery.
• Strong understanding of ADC pharmacology, intracellular trafficking, pharmacokinetics, safety drivers, and resistance mechanisms.
• Experience leading or influencing multidisciplinary drug discovery teams.
• Strong record of publications, patents, platform innovation, or advancement of drug discovery programs.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with protein language models, generative molecular design, graph neural networks, multimodal learning, or biological foundation models.
• Expertise in structural biology and modeling approaches, including AlphaFold-based modeling, molecular dynamics, cryo-EM, or X-ray crystallography.
• Experience developing scalable AI platforms for biologics or multimodal therapeutic design.
• Knowledge of next-generation ADC modalities, including bispecific ADCs, immune-stimulating ADCs and targeted delivery systems.
• Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional discovery programs and scientific teams.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.description:
Summary/Objective

Full Swing's design practice sits inside a Design Center of Excellence, with designers embedded directly in our product pods. This role will be placed into one of those pods based on where the team's needs are greatest, owning design for the companion apps that pair with our simulators and connected hardware, covering setup, calibration, live sessions, and performance tracking. As our hardware ecosystem grows, these apps grow with it, and design is what keeps that growing complexity feeling simple to the athletes and golfers using it.

You will own scoped, end-to-end design work for key app feature areas: turning ambiguous problems into clear user flows and polished UI, and partnering with Product and Engineering from concept through ship. You are measured on whether the features you design hold up for real users in real sessions, not on how clean the mockups look in isolation.

Primary Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential

functions.

• Own the end-to-end design process for mobile features — from problem framing and user flows to high-fidelity UI and developer handoff
• Design and maintain detailed user flows and prototypes in Figma that clearly communicate logic, edge cases, and states to engineering
• Partner with Product Managers and Engineers from early discovery through launch, balancing user needs, technical constraints, and business goals
• Contribute to and help evolve our design system, ensuring consistency across iOS and Android
• Use qualitative and quantitative data (user research, analytics, usability testing) to validate design decisions and iterate post-launch
• Present design rationale clearly to stakeholders, including leadership, and incorporate feedback without losing sight of the user problem
• Collaborate with other designers on critique, systems thinking, and shared UX patterns across the broader product
• Design accessible mobile experiences, applying platform accessibility standards across interaction, visual hierarchy, typography, color, and touch targets.
• Partner with engineers through implementation and QA to ensure shipped experiences match intended behavior, quality, and edge-case handling.

Required Education, Experience & Skills

• 3+ years of product design experience shipping consumer or professional mobile applications for iOS and/or Android
• A portfolio that demonstrates end-to-end ownership of shipped product work, including problem
• framing, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, prototypes, and iteration informed by user feedback or product data
• Proficiency in Figma, including building and maintaining detailed user flows, component libraries, and interactive prototypes
• Solid understanding of iOS and Android design guidelines (Human Interface Guidelines / Material
• Design) and how they diverge
• Demonstrated ability to work in ambiguity and move quickly in a fast-paced environment — you're comfortable defining the problem, not just solving one that's handed to you
• Experience working directly with engineers through implementation and QA, not just handoff
• Clear communicator who can articulate design decisions to both design and non-design audiences

Preferred Education, Experience & Skills

• Experience designing connected hardware/software experiences, including Bluetooth/BLE pairing, device onboarding, setup, calibration, live-session, or device-status flows
• Experience contributing to, auditing, or scaling a component library or design system
• Experience writing or collaborating closely on UX copy/microcopy
• Experience planning or supporting user interviews, usability tests, and synthesis of findings into
• product decisions
• Comfortable incorporating AI tools into your design workflow (e.g., Figma AI, AI-assisted prototyping) to move faster without cutting corners
• Interest or background in sports, fitness, or performance-tracking products

Portfolio Requirements

Please include a portfolio with 2–3 case studies that demonstrate your direct contribution to shipped mobile

product work. We’d like to understand:

• The user problem and product context
• Your role, scope, and cross-functional partners
• How you explored workflows, states, and edge cases
• Key design decisions and tradeoffs
• Your final interface and prototype work
• What shipped and what you learned after launch

If work is confidential, password-protected case studies are welcome.

Salary Range: $120,000-$138,000

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties

or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may

change at any time with or without notice.

Work Environment

• This role operates in a hybrid or office-based environment, depending on company needs.
• Work is primarily performed in an office setting with standard working hours; however, occasional after-hours support may be required.
• The position requires frequent interaction with employees across different departments, requiring strong collaboration and communication skills.
• The role may involve sitting for extended periods, working on a computer.
• Able to lift 25 lbs

jobs.title: Structural Engineer
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Structural Engineer based in Orange or Los Angeles, CA. This Structural Engineer will support a wide range of projects across industries including entertainment, commercial, industrial, government, detention, and parking structures. This role offers the opportunity to develop analytical and design skills while focusing on seismic design, seismic retrofits, and advanced structural analysis methods.

Join our dynamic team supporting exciting projects!  Work independently and make technical decisions based on building code interpretation as well as company, client, and industry standard practices. Mentor and teach junior engineers. Grow your career with us in our Building+ Places group.

About Buildings + Places

AECOM’s Buildings + Places practice includes architecture, interiors, building engineering, workplace strategy, business transformation, asset advisory, economics and development planning, master planning, urban planning, and landscape architecture in a dynamic, interactive, and creative work environment.

With a range of expertise from strategy and design through project realization, we create better outcomes to grow economies, protect natural systems, conserve natural resources, make societies more equitable and connect and engage people through innovative, sustainable design solutions.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Performs specific and moderate portions of a broader assignment of an experienced engineer.
• Gathers and correlates basic engineering data using established and well-defined procedures.
• Works on detailed or routine engineering assignments involving calculations and relatively simple to complex tests.
• Proposes approach to solve new problems encountered using modifications of standard procedures or methods developed in previous assignments.
• Identifies discrepancies in results.
• Provides guidance to entry level engineers.
• Performs work in accordance with agreed upon budget and schedule with little supervision.
• Independently performs all the tasks necessary to complete primary design elements for engineering works.
• Performance at this level requires developmental experience in a professional position.
• Potential projects come from a wide variety of industry sectors including entertainment, commercial, industrial, parking structures, government, and detention.
• Engineer will work collaboratively with more experienced engineers where required on very large projects and will be give the responsibility to lead/work independently on moderately sized structural design projects and tasks.

Daily work includes:

• Perform structural analysis and design
• Coordinate work with other design disciplines and prepare contract documents
• Construction administration
• Author structural reports, assessments, and studies.

Minimum:

• Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering or Architectural Engineering and 4 years of experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• US Citizenship due to federal contract/security requirements

Preferred:

• Master of Science (with structural engineering concentration)
• Preferred 8+ years of experience
• Professional License in California (SE)
• Demonstrated experience applying all major structural design codes (IBC, CBC, ASCE 7, etc)
• Demonstrated experience using 3-D structural analysis software. (examples include ETABS, SAP, RISA, RAM, and SAFE)
• Experience designing in Steel, Concrete, Masonry, and Timber
• Experience with Wind and Seismic lateral design, including retrofit of existing structures.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Experience with performance-based design is highly desirable
• Experience with ASCE 41 for retrofit of existing structures is highly desirable.

Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. The Accountant will perform recurring close and balance sheet support within the FSS Record-to-Report Operations organization. The individual will follow U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), company policies, established close procedures, and applicable internal controls.

• Prepare balance sheet account reconciliations and investigate reconciling items in a timely manner.
• Support month-end close activities, including recurring entries, accruals, reclasses, allocations, prepaid expense activity, and other assigned close requirements.

• Working knowledge of GAAP and core accounting principles.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines during the close cycle.
• High attention to detail, with a consistent focus on accuracy, completeness, and documentation quality.

• Experience with SAP HANA, Blackline, and Microsoft Excel.

jobs.title: Software Product Manager
jobs.description:
Summary/Objective

Full Swing's software product practice covers the full product lifecycle: writing and driving PRDs, maintaining a living roadmap, and managing the market and competitive research that shapes what gets built next, all grounded in a genuine, hands-on understanding of the game and the software itself. This is an opportunity to help build a new Software Product Center of Excellence: take direct, accountable ownership of unscoped work as the software-side product expert, and establish the roadmap discipline and product judgment the practice needs to scale with the business.

You genuinely know the game and the software cold: the simulation mechanics, the game engine, and the architecture underneath it. You use that depth to make real, defensible product decisions rather than relaying requirements between people who understand the product better than you do.

Primary Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential

functions.

• Product decisions for the game and software, grounded in real depth in the simulation mechanics, game engine, and architecture.
• End-to-end PRD ownership, from first draft to shipped release, including unscoped initiatives that need scope, timeline, and resourcing defined from scratch.
• The Jira discovery board: capturing, triaging, and prioritizing new ideas before they become a PRD.
• A living product roadmap for your product lines, scientifically sized by scope and level of effort.
• Scope and prioritization decisions across engineering, QA, and design that hold up under scrutiny.
• Market and competitive research, understanding customers and the competitive landscape, and turning that into a defensible product direction.
• Design requirements, review, and sign-off, communicating feature needs clearly and approving design work before it moves into development.
• Partner and vendor relationship management for integrations and white-labeled products, plus running SIM demos for internal teams, external partners, and prospects.
• A visible escalation point for customer support issues that need real product judgment, and Go/No-Go readiness input with QA and Release Management.

Required Education, Experience & Skills

• 6+ years as a Product Manager inside a software engineering organization, with real ownership of shipped products, not a business-side product, marketing, or program-adjacent background.
• Deep, hands-on knowledge of game engines (e.g., Unity) and simulation or game software architecture, gained from direct experience building or shipping a game or simulation product.
• Demonstrated experience writing and driving PRDs from an ambiguous, unscoped ask through to a shipped, resourced execution plan.
• Comfortable owning multiple concurrent, sometimes competing initiatives across related but distinct product surfaces.
• Enough independent technical command of the product and the software to make and defend scope and prioritization calls with engineering, not just facilitate a conversation between other people's opinions.
• Experience with market and competitive research methods (customer interviews, sales feedback loops, surveys, competitive site visits) and turning that input into product direction.
• Excellent written communication, specifically the ability to write a clear, rigorous PRD that engineering, design, and QA can execute against without heavy back-and-forth.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

Salary Range: $130,000-$151,000

Other Duties

or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may

change at any time with or without notice.

Work Environment

• Work is primarily performed in an office setting with standard working hours; however, occasional after-hours support may be required.
• The position requires frequent interaction with employees across different departments, requiring strong collaboration and communication skills.
• The role may involve sitting for extended periods, working on a computer.

jobs.title: Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Staff Product Engineer on our Hi-Reliability team, you will utilize in-depth technical knowledge and problem-solving acumen to resolve complex engineering issues and drive new ICs through the New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle. You will understand the interrelationships of different disciplines and network with key contacts across IC design, test, reliability, packaging, radiation effects, and manufacturing. In this role, you will determine methods and procedures on new characterization and qualification assignments, exercise independent judgment to evaluate variable factors, and identify best practices that deliver high-quality, manufacturable semiconductor solutions.

Responsibilities

• Act as a technical focal point and key technical contributor for Product Engineering tasks to achieve critical project milestones and NPI schedule targets.
• Determine methods and procedures on new characterization assignments, executing electrical validation and performance evaluations across environmental conditions.
• Investigate and resolve complex yield, reliability, and manufacturability issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.
• Exercise judgment in selecting methods, adapting complex analytical techniques, and establishing evaluation criteria to interpret characterization, test, and production data.
• Network with key contacts outside own area of expertise—including Design, Test, Packaging, Quality, Reliability, and Foundry Operations—to drive cross-functional alignment.
• Partner closely with Test Engineering on automated test equipment (ATE) test strategies, bench-to-ATE correlation, and test coverage optimization.
• Identify and develop departmental best practices that deliver high-quality and effective engineering solutions.
• Adapt communication style and use persuasion to deliver technical findings, recommendations, and risk assessments relating to wider business targets.
• Frequently advise colleagues on complex technical matters and mentor less-experienced engineers within your domain expertise area.
• Complete engineering assignments independently, requiring management guidance only in the most complex situations.

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
• 6+ years of experience executing new product development within the semiconductor industry.
• Strong semiconductor/IC experience.
• Experience with Product Engineering and semiconductor new product introduction (NPI).
• Experience with IC characterization and evaluation of product performance.
• Strong data analysis capability, including interpretation of characterization, test, yield, production, or other semiconductor product data.
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred

• Direct experience with high-reliability, space-grade, or radiation-hardened semiconductor products and qualification standards (e.g., MIL-PRF-38535).
• Experience with Automated Test Equipment (ATE) platforms (e.g., Advantest V93K, Teradyne ETS-64/UltraFLEX) and bench-to-ATE correlation.
• Proficiency in statistical data analysis tools such as JMP, Spotfire, or Python.
• Technical domain background in analog, mixed-signal, or power management ICs.
• Experience mentoring early-career engineers or acting as a task lead within a product team.

jobs.title: Game Cinematic Artist Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Your main challenge

As a Game Cinematic Artist Intern, you will join our team in Barcelona and learn how cinematic sequences are created and implemented directly inside a real-time game engine.

Working alongside our artists and game team, you will help create compelling camera shots and sequences for our games, from race introductions and menu sequences to in-game cinematics. You will develop your eye for framing, composition and visual storytelling while gaining hands-on experience with our cinematic tools and pipelines.

What it means on a daily basis

• Create and adapt 3D camera shots and cinematic sequences inside our real-time game engine, including race intros, menu sequences and in-game cinematics.
• Work with 3D characters, vehicles and other game assets, positioning them within scenes and finding the best framing and composition.
• Learn and work with our existing real-time cinematic tools and pipelines, maintaining and updating sequences as the game evolves.
• Review and test your work directly in-game, identifying visual or technical issues and making the necessary adjustments.
• Collaborate with the game and art teams, responding to feedback and supporting new cinematic needs throughout production.

WHAT SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

In your first 3 months, you will become familiar with our game engine, cinematic pipeline and existing camera sequences, progressively contributing your own shots with guidance from the team.

As you progress, you will develop a stronger understanding of real-time cinematics and visual storytelling while contributing polished camera work that enhances the presentation of our games.

WHO YOU WOULD BE WORKING WITH

You will work closely with our Art and Game teams in Barcelona, collaborating with the people responsible for the characters, environments and game content featured in your cinematic sequences.

You will receive guidance from experienced team members while gradually taking more ownership of your work as you become familiar with our tools and pipelines.

YOUR RECRUITMENT JOURNEY

• Recruiter interview
• Portfolio/showreel review by our Hiring team
• Hiring Manager interview

WHERE THIS ROLE CAN TAKE YOU

This internship will give you practical experience in real-time cinematics within a professional game development environment, developing transferable skills in camera work, composition, 3D workflows and visual storytelling.

You will also gain exposure to how Art and Game teams collaborate to take cinematic content from an initial idea to its final implementation in-game.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Basic understanding of 3D environments and workflows, including navigating scenes and manipulating 3D objects.
• Understanding of camera composition, framing and visual storytelling in a 3D environment.
• Familiarity with at least one real-time game engine, such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
• Ability to understand how positioning, framing and camera movement can help present 3D characters, vehicles and environments effectively.
• Good attention to both visual and technical details.
• Good level of English.
• Ability to sign an internship agreement with a school or university.

WHO YOU ARE

• Curious about video games, film and visual storytelling.
• Eager to learn new tools, workflows and technical pipelines.
• Creative, with a good eye for composition and presentation.
• Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on your work.
• Organized and able to work towards deadlines.
• Proactive while knowing when to ask the team for guidance.
• Detail-oriented and willing to test and review your own work.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​

Benefits

• Flexible schedule adapted to your student needs
• Flexible work from home hybrid model

Life at Gameloft

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.

Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global People Operations & Transformation (USA Remote)
jobs.description:
Turnitin is seeking a forward-thinking global HR executive to lead People Operations and its continued transformation. Reporting to the Chief People Experience Officer, this role oversees Global People Shared Services, Benefits, HR Systems and Analytics, and Employee Relations operations, including our external ER partnership. The role will also lead the planned integration of global Payroll operations from Finance.

We are looking for a leader who can design organizations, build capability and create leverage through effective structures, systems, technology and people. This includes challenging legacy ways of working, testing hypotheses, making fact-based investment decisions and using AI and automation to simplify work and improve productivity.

Our environment is global, remote-first and evolving. Success requires someone who can lead through ambiguity, constructively challenge assumptions, make decisions with imperfect information and translate complex problems into practical solutions.

This leader must bring deep operational expertise, sound employee relations judgment, proven HR technology transformation experience and the ability to develop a strong leadership bench. The expectation is not simply to maintain operations, but to build a more scalable, resilient and accountable People Experience function. This leader will also serve as a trusted adviser to the CPXO and senior leadership, bringing independent judgment, sound business acumen and practical solutions to complex operational, organizational and employee matters. They will anticipate risks, offer constructive challenge and help translate business priorities into effective People practices.

What You Will Do

Global People Shared Services & Operational Excellence

• Lead global People Shared Services across employee lifecycle operations, onboarding, offboarding, leaves, immigration coordination and employee support.
• Lead the design and continuous improvement of the People Shared Services (PSS) delivery model, establishing clear ownership, decision rights, escalation protocols and accountability within PSS, while partnering with PBPs, COEs and external providers to ensure effective handoffs, coordination and service delivery.
• Evaluate organizational structure, staffing, spans of control and work allocation to improve service effectiveness, productivity and management capacity.
• Build scalable operations through standardization, self-service, documented procedures, cross-training and succession coverage.
• Establish performance measures that identify service gaps, recurring issues, operational risk and opportunities to redirect work to more effective delivery channels.

Employee Relations, Governance & Risk

• Lead the global Employee Relations operating model, including governance, quality and performance of external ER partners.
• Bring strong judgment and practical expertise to complex employee matters, including investigations, performance, restructuring, separations and employment risk.
• Establish clear decision rights, case ownership, service standards and escalation protocols in partnership with Legal and People Business Partners.
• Evaluate the effectiveness and economics of the ER delivery model, building internal expertise and alternatives to external providers where appropriate.
• Anticipate emerging employee risks and operational vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate intervention before matters escalate unnecessarily.
• Establish effective ER case management, tracking and reporting, including case volumes, themes, resolution timelines, outcomes and recurring risks to inform continuous improvement.
• Strengthen the operational management of employee separations and HR offboarding, ensuring clear ownership, timely coordination, consistent documentation and effective partnership across PSS, PBPs, Legal and external providers.

HR Technology, AI & Digital Transformation

• Lead HRIS modernization, including strategy, selection, implementation, integration, adoption and ongoing optimization.
• Reimagine the People service model using AI, automation and integrated systems to reduce administrative work, improve self-service and create capacity for higher-value activities.
• Expand AI-enabled employee and manager support, knowledge management, case routing, workflow automation and workforce analytics.
• Establish reliable People data, reporting and governance, including appropriate security, privacy and responsible AI controls.
• Develop fact-based business cases, test hypotheses through pilots and measure productivity, adoption, service improvements and return on investment.
• Challenge technology investments that automate inefficient processes without first addressing underlying organizational or workflow issues.

Global Benefits & Payroll Transformation

• Lead global Benefits operations, including administration, enrollment, vendor performance, financial stewardship and employee experience.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description:
Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (Azure)

Type: Remote Contract
Location: United States (US work authorization required)
Openings: 2 positions, including 1 Platform Lead
Start Date: Around December 1, 2026
Duration: Multi-month engagement, with potential extension

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control.

Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.

About the role

We are building a senior engineering team for a large enterprise program in healthcare operations and workforce decisioning. The platform helps operations leaders understand what is happening across their workforce, make informed decisions, take action within the enterprise systems they already use, and measure the results.

We are looking for two Senior DevOps / Platform Engineers, including one Platform Lead, to design, build, secure, and operate the production infrastructure supporting this platform.

The environment will run within the client's own Azure tenant, handle regulated workforce and operational data, and support isolated production deployments for individual customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring deep Azure expertise, infrastructure as code, cloud security, and production platform ownership. You will establish the initial build environment, develop the production infrastructure, and implement the automation, security controls, observability, and disaster recovery capabilities needed to operate a reliable enterprise platform.

For the Platform Lead position, you will also own key architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, and work directly with the client's architects and security teams.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, and maintain production Azure infrastructure, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.
• Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep, creating reusable modules and automated provisioning processes.
• Establish the initial build and development environments, followed by secure, production-ready infrastructure within the client's Azure tenant.
• Design and implement isolated customer deployments, ensuring strict separation of subscriptions, networking, encryption keys, and data stores.
• Build repeatable infrastructure deployment processes that allow new customer environments to be provisioned consistently and efficiently.
• Implement secure identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time access, and break-glass procedures.
• Design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using client-controlled repositories and runners, including automated testing, security scanning, approval workflows, and controlled production releases.
• Implement cloud security controls and support enterprise security assessments, penetration testing, compliance reviews, and vulnerability remediation.
• Build observability capabilities across customer deployments, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting, and integration with enterprise SIEM platforms.
• Design and implement resilient infrastructure, backup strategies, zone redundancy, and disaster recovery solutions, including secondary-region failover capabilities.
• Define recovery objectives, conduct disaster recovery and performance testing, and document results and remediation actions.
• Collaborate with application engineers, security teams, enterprise architects, and client stakeholders to ensure infrastructure meets operational, security, and performance requirements.
• Develop operational runbooks, infrastructure documentation, and incident response procedures.
• Participate in production on-call rotations, incident troubleshooting, and post-deployment hypercare.
• Take ownership of infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
• For the Platform Lead position, guide technical architecture, establish platform engineering standards, coordinate engineering activities, and represent the team in client architecture and security discussions.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

• Senior Azure platform engineering experience. You have designed, built, and operated production Azure environments end to end, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor. You have personally implemented infrastructure rather than only maintaining environments designed by others.
• Infrastructure as code. Strong hands-on experience with Terraform or Bicep, including reusable infrastructure modules, automated provisioning, configuration management, and infrastructure lifecycle ownership.
• Security and regulated environments. You have built production platforms handling PHI or similarly sensitive data and successfully supported HIPAA, SOC 2, or comparable enterprise security reviews. You have participated in penetration testing, addressed security findings, and produced technical evidence for compliance assessments.
• Identity and secrets management. Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time and break-glass access, credential rotation, and secure secrets management. You understand how to eliminate long-lived credentials from pipelines and repositories.
• Multi-tenant infrastructure architecture. You have designed and operated customer-isolated environments with separate networking, encryption keys, and data stores. You can automate repeatable customer deployments while maintaining strict security boundaries.
• Secure CI/CD engineering. Experience building production deployment pipelines within enterprise-controlled environments, including secure runners, environment promotion, approval workflows, container and dependency scanning, and coordinated releases across multiple deployments.
• Disaster recovery and resilience. Hands-on experience implementing backup strategies, zone-redundant infrastructure, secondary-region recovery environments, and documented RTO/RPO objectives. You have personally executed and validated production disaster recovery or failover tests.
• Observability and production operations. Strong experience implementing logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, security event monitoring, and performance testing. You can troubleshoot production issues, identify bottlenecks, and participate in on-call support.
• Technical ownership and stakeholder communication. You can independently own complex infrastructure initiatives, explain architectural decisions to enterprise architects and security reviewers, and document operational procedures and technical trade-offs.
• Strong English communication. You are fluent in written and spoken English and comfortable collaborating directly with US-based engineers, enterprise architects, security teams, and client stakeholders.
• US location and work authorization. You must be based in the United States and authorized to work in the US. Occasional domestic travel may be required.
• Available around December 1, 2026.

Additional requirement for the Platform Lead: Previous experience leading a small platform engineering team, establishing technical standards, owning architectural decisions, and representing infrastructure designs in enterprise client discussions.

Nice-to-haves

• Healthcare technology experience, particularly provider, payer, workforce management, or other regulated healthcare platforms.
• Snowflake administration, including customer-specific environments, private connectivity, customer-managed encryption keys, replication, and failover.
• Experience operating graph databases such as Neo4j in production, including clustering, encryption, backup, and patching.
• Experience deploying and supporting Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, including regional data controls and infrastructure for AI applications.
• Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, or equivalent security monitoring and governance tools.
• Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps for production containerized workloads.
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, scripting, and CI/CD engineering.
• Experience supporting enterprise platforms with strict security, availability, and customer isolation requirements.

Our recruitment process

• Recruiter interview (30 min)
• Technical interview (30 min)
• Client interview (45 min)

We strive to move efficiently from step to step to make the recruitment process as fast as possible.

jobs.title: Director, Clinical Process Engineering
jobs.description:
Lead the Clinical Process Engineering team while contributing to the design, optimization, and sustainability of clinical business processes to enable operational excellence, compliance, and innovation across Clinical Development Operations. The Director, Clinical Process Engineering partners with business process owners, change, learning, and compliance teams to translate business needs into robust, scalable, and inspection-ready process designs that drive measurable business outcomes and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

• Lead Process Engineering Team and contribute to the design, mapping, and documentation of end-to-end clinical business processes, ensuring alignment with business needs, regulatory requirements, and process excellence standards.

• Collaborate with Business Process Owners (BPOs), Process Experts, and cross-functional stakeholders to define future-state processes, clarify decision rights, and ensure clear handoffs and ownership.

• Develop and maintain process maps, work instructions, SOP-aligned content, and supporting documentation using appropriate standards and methods (e.g., BPMN/process mapping, Lean/Six Sigma concepts).

• Conduct current-state assessment and process analysis (cycle time, handoffs, rework, risk) to identify improvement opportunities and inform fit-for-purpose future-state designs.

• Facilitate process design workshops and working sessions with SMEs, system owners, and compliance partners to gather requirements, validate process flows, and confirm controls and roles.

• Ensure process designs incorporate compliance, inspection readiness, and quality-by-design principles, including appropriate controls, traceability, and documentation rigor.

• Partner with technology and business system owners to translate process designs into system requirements and enablement (e.g., user stories, acceptance criteria, UAT support, and readiness inputs).

• Define and recommend process performance measures and instrumentation approaches; partner with BPOs to establish process signals and monitoring where applicable.

• Maintain controlled process documentation and decision records, ensuring updates are versioned, communicated, and aligned to governance and audit expectations.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, life sciences, business, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.

• Lean Six Sigma or similar process methodology certification required.

• Minimum 10 years of demonstrated experience in process design, process engineering, and/or process improvement within a regulated environment (GxP, clinical development, quality systems, or similar).

• Working knowledge of clinical development operations and associated regulatory/inspection expectations (e.g., documentation rigor, traceability, and controls).

• Proficiency in process mapping and documentation techniques and tools; ability to develop clear, consumable process artifacts for diverse audiences.

• Experience facilitating workshops, eliciting requirements, and aligning stakeholders to achieve timely decisions and high-quality designs.

• Strong analytical skills (e.g., root cause analysis, risk assessment, process performance analysis) and structured problem solving.

• Experience partnering with technology/system teams on process-to-system translation (requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT support).

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex process topics into clear guidance and recommendations.

• Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, global environment and manage multiple priorities with strong attention to detail and accountability.

Key Stakeholders:

• Business Process Owners (BPOs) and Process Experts.

• Clinical Development Operations functional leaders and operational teams (process users).

• Process Excellence / process architecture partners (process architects/engineers, process governance leads).

• Quality, compliance, and inspection readiness partners.

• Change Engagement / change management partners.

• Learning / training partners.

• Business system owners and technology partners supporting the process domain.

• Cross-functional SMEs and governance forum participants.

jobs.title: Principal Content Marketing Manager, LTS Integrated Marketing
jobs.description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

This role can be based in San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Chicago or New York.

We are seeking a Principal Content Marketing Manager to shape how LinkedIn Learning Career Hub builds authority, delivers value to talent leaders, and connects its strongest insights, customer stories, product innovation, and expertise through an integrated content ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned content strategist with exceptional editorial judgment who can identify the conversations where LinkedIn has a meaningful perspective to contribute, translate complex ideas into compelling narratives, and build audience-first content strategies that drive engagement and measurable business impact.

Responsibilities

• Develop audience-first content marketing strategies that connect business priorities, customer needs, market insights, thought leadership, and product narratives across the LinkedIn Talent Solutions portfolio.
• Identify and shape distinctive editorial territories where LinkedIn can contribute a credible point of view, build sustained authority, and create value for talent and business decision-makers.
• Translate complex topics related to talent, learning, skills, work, and AI into clear, compelling narratives and content experiences across web, editorial, social, video, email, executive, and partner channels.
• Build integrated content programs that connect flagship thought leadership, customer stories, product narratives, executive perspectives, and always-on content into a cohesive ecosystem rather than a series of standalone assets.
• Create strategic briefs, editorial frameworks, and content plans that align Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, Communications, Brand, Creative, Lifecycle Marketing, and agency partners around shared audience and business objectives.
• Develop scalable approaches for translating research, customer insight, subject-matter expertise, and existing intellectual property into multiple high-value formats and experiences.
• Partner with executives, customers, creators, and subject-matter experts to uncover differentiated perspectives and develop credible, engaging thought leadership and market storytelling.
• Evolve content strategy for an AI-driven discovery environment, applying modern search, content architecture, structured content, and emerging optimization practices to improve visibility, authority, and audience value.
• Define success metrics, evaluate content performance, and use audience signals and business data to continuously improve editorial priorities, content investments, and distribution strategies.
• Champion AI-first ways of working, using AI and agentic workflows to accelerate research, insight development, content creation, optimization, measurement, and operational efficiency while maintaining strong human judgment and editorial standards.

Basic Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial strategy, thought leadership, brand storytelling, journalism, communications, or related disciplines.
• Experience developing audience-first content strategies and integrated editorial programs across multiple channels and formats.
• Experience translating complex business, technology, or market topics into clear, engaging narratives for senior audiences.
• Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across multiple teams without formal authority.
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Exceptional editorial judgment, writing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to identify ideas that are distinctive, relevant, and valuable to an audience.
• Experience developing thought leadership, research-driven content, executive content, customer storytelling, or recurring editorial programs.
• Experience marketing SaaS, HR technology, talent, learning, AI, or enterprise software solutions.
• Experience designing integrated content architectures and audience journeys across owned, earned, social, executive, creator, and partner channels, with a clear approach to content distribution, amplification, and reuse.
• Deep understanding of modern content discovery and distribution, including Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), content architecture, structured content, and evolving AI-driven search and discovery behaviors.
• Experience using audience research, performance data, and customer insights to guide editorial decisions and demonstrate business impact.
• Strong executive communication, stakeholder influence, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and execution levels, from defining an editorial opportunity to shaping and improving the resulting content.
• Demonstrated systems thinking, intellectual curiosity, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a complex organization.
• Experience applying AI, automation, and emerging technologies across content research, development, optimization, personalization, and measurement, with a strong understanding of where human editorial judgment and subject-matter expertise remain critical.

Suggested Skills

• Content Strategy & Editorial Leadership
• Audience Strategy & Content Ecosystems
• Strategic Storytelling & Thought Leadership
• Content Distribution & Organic Discovery
• AI-Enabled Content Strategy & Innovation

LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The pay range for this role is $157,000 to $245,000. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We seek candidates with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Your Role at Raising Cane’s:

The Assistant Restaurant Leader is responsible for supporting the Restaurant Leader in day-to-day operations of the restaurant and upholding Raising Cane’s standards and culture in all areas of restaurant operations.

The physical work environment includes working in a fast-paced kitchen environment (which requires extended periods of physical exertion, such as walking, standing, lifting and bending) and interacting with customers. It also includes both inside and outside work in varied temperatures, working with and around food products, common allergens, industrial equipment, commercial cleaning products that require the use of personal protective equipment and physical activities necessary to complete the responsibilities of the job.

Your Impact and Responsibilities

Purpose of the position:

• Hires and terminates all hourly, non-management crewmembers
• Owns the onboarding, status change and payroll process for all hourly crewmembers
• Creates crewmember work and training schedules
• Manages the performance of all hourly crewmembers (e.g. development, coaching, redirective communication and documentation, and other performance management tasks)
• Acts as manager on duty and opens and closes the restaurant

• Utilizes reward and recognition program for the crewmembers in the restaurant
