jobs.title: Motorsport Software and Data Analytics Graduate Intern
jobs.description:
Job Description

Welcome to Bosch Motorsport, a premier supplier of electronics, sensors, actuators, and engineering services to top racing series (Formula 1, IMSA, IndyCar, NASCAR, SuperGT, WEC, WRC), manufactures, and teams worldwide. Here at Bosch Motorsport North America, you'll be part of a growing, dynamic, and entrepreneurial team, taking on challenging tasks.

We are seeking a highly motived and passionate graduate engineer to join our team. This role allows you to play a key role in the development, testing, and application of key components for Bosch Motorsport globally. Embrace this opportunity to make an impact in the exciting world of motorsport technology!

What You Will Do

The Motorsport Software and Data Analytics Graduate Intern will be paired with an experienced engineering mentor and will work alongside simulation and software development engineers to support the development, integration, validation, and optimization of electronic systems, connectivity solutions, and software applications for professional motorsport customers across North America and global racing programs. The Graduate Intern will have dedicated project(s) and own the key deliverables by the end of the work term.

This role provides hands-on experience in a fast-paced, high-performance motorsport environment and will include multiple of the following attribute areas (not necessarily all):

• Simulation & Performance Analysis: Support vehicle and power unit simulation activities, sensitivity analysis, model development, and comparison of simulation results with dyno, test, and track data.
• Data Analysis & Visualization: Analyze and visualize simulation and telemetry data using MATLAB, Python, WinDarab (our specialized data evaluation and analysis tool) and other engineering tools to support performance evaluation and technical decision-making.
• System Testing & Validation: Support Hardware-In-the-Loop, cloud, and system-level testing for complex controls systems; analyze results, investigate discrepancies, and document findings.
• Telemetry & Trackside Engineering: Support the development, testing, and deployment of motorsport connectivity and telemetry systems, including possible opportunities to assist with track and test events.
• Application Engineering Support: Work alongside engineers to understand customer requirements and support motorsport products and services, including powertrain controls systems and telemetry and cloud-based data solutions.
• Automation & Process Improvement: Develop scripts, dashboards, and automated analysis or reporting workflows using MATLAB, Python, C#, or similar tools.
• Technical Project Ownership: Take ownership of defined graduate-level projects in simulation, telemetry, data analytics, automation, or performance analysis, with guidance from experienced engineers.
• Structured Mentorship and Professional Development: Partner with an assigned full-time engineer to receive peer-to-peer technical guidance, prioritize daily deliverables, and build foundational motorsport engineering skills. This is also an opportunity for reverse mentoring.

Required Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a Masters or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or Data Science or in a dual degree program from an accredited four-year college or university in Engineering, Computer Science, or Data Science/Analytics
• Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0
• Must be 18 years or older
• 3+ years of hands-on motorsport or relevant experience with vehicle, ICE and/or hybrid controls (industry, FSAE, EcoCar, etc.)

Desired Qualifications

Hands-on Automotive Experience: Practical, hands-on vehicle controls systems experience related to combustion engines, high voltage hybrid systems, data acquisition systems, wiring harness design, sensor application, and/or mechanical troubleshooting (e.g., project cars, Formula SAE, or shop experience).

Programming and Scripting: Programming or scripting experience (e.g., Python, MATLAB, C#, C++, embedded Linux) for data processing, automation, or testing purposes. Appropriate and responsible use of AI for acceleration of both technical and daily tasks.

Modeling and Simulation: Modeling and simulation experience (e.g., Matlab/Simulink) developing and refining plant models and/or developing and integration of Functional Mock-up Unit container files for Hardware-In-the-Loop or Driver-In-the-Loop test environments

Automotive Communications and Networking: Foundational knowledge of automotive communications (e.g., CAN, Ethernet) and wired/wireless networking (e.g., LAN, WAN).

Diagnostic Tool Proficiency: Experience with industry standard diagnostic, testing, and measurement tools (e.g., Vector tools, dSPACE products, oscilloscopes)

Demonstrated Leadership & Technical Research: Project work with full end to end scope ownership in work delivery. Graduate research, technical leadership, design reports, publications, or significant independent projects related to automotive, motorsport, connectivity, simulation, telemetry, or powertrain engineering.

Ideal Candidate Characteristics

Motorsport Passion and Drive: Possesses a genuine enthusiasm for professional motorsport and an eagerness to make meaningful technical contributions.

Proactive Self-Starter: Thrives in an agile, hands-on environment; takes initiative to ask questions, research solutions, and execute tasks with accountability.

Data-Driven and Adaptable: Approaches engineering problems with objective logic, pivoting quickly when requirements change.

Disciplined Team Player: Communicates test observations and data findings clearly (both verbally and in writing) while collaborating seamlessly within a multi-disciplinary team.

Curiosity and Growth Mindset: Eager to step outside of immediate academic comfort zone to learn new software skills, hardware implementations, and systems.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans

*Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.

Your well-being matters at Bosch! We offer a competitive compensation and a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. This includes premium health coverage, a 401(k) with generous matching, resources for financial planning and goal setting, ample paid time off, parental leave, and comprehensive life and disability protection. We're investing in your success!

jobs.description:
CE VEI FACE​

În calitate de Consultant Vânzări, vei juca un rol cheie în crearea unei experiențe remarcabile pentru clienți. Vei întâmpina clienții, îi vei ghida prin magazin și îi vei sprijini să găsească ceea ce au nevoie în timp ce prezinți produsele noastre. Acționând în conformitate cu valorile noastre, vei contribui atât la succesul tău, cât și al companiei.

Va trebui să:

• Împărtășești cunoștințele despre modă și produse pentru a ajuta clienții să ia decizii.
• Colaborezi cu echipa ta pentru a oferi servicii excepționale la fiecare pas al călătoriei clientului, inclusiv în promovarea activă a programului de loialitate (Hello Member).
• Te asiguri că suprafața de vânzări și zonele din spatele casei de marcat sunt bine aprovizionate, organizate și plăcute.
• Oferi suport la deschiderea și închiderea magazinului.
• Te reprezinți pe tine și brandul nostru în mod pozitiv în toate interacțiunile cu clienții.

​CU CINE VEI LUCRA​

Magazinele sunt inima companiei noastre, locul unde clienții experimentează direct brandul nostru. Ca parte a echipei dinamice a magazinului, fiecare rol - de la consilieri de vânzări, manageri de departament, de magazin și visual merchandiseri și până la cash office responsible - contribuie la crearea unui mediu inspirațional și primitor. De asemenea, vei păstra legătura și cu echipa mai mare a Ariei, colaborând între magazine pentru a împărtăși informații și a contribui la succes împreună. Alături de echipa ta, vei juca un rol vital în a-i ajuta pe clienți să se simtă încrezători și să-și exprime individualitatea cu cele mai recente tendințe și stiluri atemporale. Prin construirea de conexiuni semnificative cu clienții din magazinele noastre, facem moda accesibilă și durabilă pentru toți.

​CINE EȘTI​

Suntem în căutare de persoane cu…​

• Experiență în servicii pentru clienți în modă, retail sau domenii similare care va fi considerată un avantaj.
• Pasiune pentru a ajuta clienții și interes pentru modă sau retail – restul te învățăm noi!

Și persoane care …​

• Prosperă în medii colaborative și dinamice.
• Sunt comunicative, creative, curioase să lucreze cu tehnologia magazinului, cu o dorință puternică de a învăța și de a se dezvolta.
• Sunt flexibile și orientate spre acțiune.

CINE SUNTEM NOI​

H&M Group este o companie globală de branduri și întreprinderi puternice de modă. Scopul nostru este să demonstrăm că nu există compromisuri între designul excepțional, prețurile accesibile și soluțiile sustenabile. Vrem să facem moda accesibilă pentru mulți, iar clienții noștri sunt în centrul fiecărei decizii pe care o luăm.​

​Suntem un grup alcătuit din mii de colegi pasionați și talentați, uniți de cultura și valorile noastre comune. Împreună, vrem să ne folosim puterea, amploarea și cunoștințele pentru a împinge industria modei către un viitor mai incluziv și mai sustenabil. ​

​DE CE-ȚI VA PLĂCEA SĂ LUCREZI AICI ​

La H&M Group, suntem mândri să fim o companie vibrantă și primitoare. Oferim angajaților noștri beneficii atractive cu oportunități extinse de dezvoltare în întreaga lume. ​

• Reducere de 25% la achiziţiile din H&M pentru tine şi un membru al familiei. Valabil pentru H&M Group, atât în magazine, cât și online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories și ARKET)
• Bonus pentru recomandarea unui prieten
• Servicii medicale private
• Card pentru activități sportive
• Tichete de masă
• HIP- Program de suplimentare a pensiei. Află mai multe despre program aici.​
• Recompensă la pensionare
• Recompense de loialitate pentru aniversarea a 10, 15, & 20 de ani
• Card cadou pentru nou-născut
• Posibilități nelimitate pentru cariera ta

ALĂTURĂ-TE

Caracterul nostru unic provine dintr-o combinație de multe lucruri – cultura noastră incluzivă și colaborativă, valorile noastre puternice și oportunitățile de creștere. Dar, mai presus de toate, oamenii noștri sunt cei care ne fac ceea ce suntem.​

​Fă următorul pas în cariera ta împreună cu noi. Călătoria începe aici.​

​* Evaluarea rolurilor în magazin:

Pentru a gestiona volumul mare de aplicații pentru rolul de Consilier Vânzări, folosim o metodă de evaluare online pentru recrutarea bazată pe abilități în unele dintre magazinele noastre. Va trebui să-l completezi ca parte a procesului de aplicare și selecție. Răspunsurile tale vor fi notate de un instrument de evaluare care aplică criterii predefinite stabilite de H&M Group.

După finalizarea evaluării, vei avea ocazia să oferi feedback și să pui întrebări. Dacă întâmpini dificultăți sau preferi o metodă alternativă de evaluare, te rugăm să contactezi recruitment_support@hm.com . Alegerea unei alternative nu va avea impact asupra aplicației tale.

Pentru mai multe informații despre modul în care prelucrăm datele cu caracter personal, te rugăm să consulți Notificarea noastră de confidențialitate.

**Ne-am angajat într-un proces de recrutare corect, echitabil și bazat pe competență. Prin urmare, te rugăm să nu atașezi o scrisoare de intenție în cererea ta.**

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT WINCENT

We are a team of 150 people, primarily Engineers, Traders and Quants, focused on HFT with ~1% of global crypto trading volume.  Being a bit weird, we

 - Are self-taught; our founders do not come from any of the big HFTs

 - Chose to have no VCs on cap-table; this spot is for our colleagues

 - Made Bratislava the central hub, not London or Amsterdam
   
   


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for someone resourceful, organised and hands-on to join us as our Office Manager in Gibraltar.

This is not your typical office manager role. It’s about noticing what needs to be done, taking ownership and making things happen.

You’ll be responsible for making sure our Gibraltar office, company flats, and local operational support run smoothly for employees and visitors.

The work can be dynamic and occasionally ambiguous, so we’re looking for someone who enjoys bringing order to moving pieces and solving practical problems independently.



The role requires about a 60% commitment, with working hours from 9:00 to 14:00, Monday through Friday. Later on, it is possible to take on more responsibilities and transition to a full-time role.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the day-to-day running of our Gibraltar office and make sure employees and visitors have what they need.

 - Manage facility, maintenance, suppliers, building management, office access, and everyday workplace needs.

 - Coordinate our three company flats, including guest preparation, cleaning, access, and maintenance.

 - Support local administrative needs for Finance, Legal, and other teams, including documents, couriers, and local providers.

 - Keep relevant office spend, invoices, records, and reporting organised.

 - Prepare the office and accommodation for visitors and leadership visits.

 - Support occasional local team activities and workplace experience.

 - Spot practical improvements and help make the office and its processes work better.




YOUR PROFILE

 - You are organised and know how to prioritise.

 - You are proactive and notice things before someone has to ask.

 - You take ownership and follow things through.

 - You are practical and comfortable being hands-on when needed.

 - You communicate clearly with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.

 - You are comfortable working with budgets, invoices and vendors.

 - You stay calm when plans change or unexpected issues appear.

 - You are comfortable working independently in an environment that is not always perfectly defined.

 - Fluent English is required; Spanish is a plus.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The office and company flats run smoothly, visitors are well taken care of, operational issues are followed through, and important things do not fall through the cracks.




WHAT YOU'LL GAIN

 - Direct and honest communication with no fluff

 - Agile and challenging environment, dynamic agenda

 - Smart colleagues, you are not the smartest guy in the room, working with the best folks

 - Competitive team - we are competing against the best in the world

 - Great working team in Gib

 - Meal Voucher £200 /month

 - Axa worldwide (exc. US) medical insurance




WORKING AT WINCENT 

At Wincent, we foster a culture of transparency, ownership, and autonomy, where every team member is empowered to make a meaningful impact. We prioritize clear objectives and give you the freedom to innovate and grow within a supportive, high-performing environment.

We value exceptional TOP 1% talent over a perfect match to a job description. If our vision and values resonate with you, we’d love to hear from you. Don’t hesitate to reach out—let’s explore how you can be part of shaping the future of cryptocurrency trading with us!

jobs.title: Group Lead - Second Shift
jobs.description:
Shift: Second Shift

What's the Short Version?

A Group Lead will provide support to daily warehouse operations and system processes. A Group Lead is responsible

for effectively planning and coordinating workflow for assigned area. They ensure proper resource placement as

business needs dictate and ensures shipments are processed in proper time frame to meet customer service levels.

The Group Lead provides support to other areas at the discretion of the DC Supervisor and/or Shift Manager.

What Will You Be Doing?

· Ensure product is getting shipped in an accurate and efficient manner.

· Ensure compliance of company policies, procedures and practices; and support company safety efforts.

· Ensure employee productivity standards are being met and may assist with training employees including on

the job training and safety training.

· Generate and maintain reports, input or acquire data, and ensure that all data is entered consistently and

accurately.

· May operate a Radio Frequency (RF) unit in combination with Internal Operating System to perform daily

work.

· May be required to operate powered lift equipment.

· May at times communicate with trucking company dispatchers to coordinate pick up schedule changes.

· Responsible for checking out equipment and returning in same condition.

· Meet minimum standards and accuracy standards and delivery deadlines.

· Maintain safe, neat and clean work area by adhering to SanMar safety regulations.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

· Comply with all policies and standards.

What Are We Looking For?

· High School Diploma or equivalent Preferred

· 4+ years of experience supporting many areas of a warehouse.

· 4+ years of experience operating powered lift equipment.

· Bilingual a plus

· Detail-oriented, ability to follow through on projects, prioritize, and handle multiple tasks at once.

· Knowledge of Internal Operating System(s) and Microsoft Office.

· Demonstrated ability to lead a team by setting a good example (i.e., exemplary performance, strong

initiative, and strong attention to detail).

· Ability to read, write and have sufficient ability to identify colors, sizes, quantity, label and SKU information.

· Comprehend verbal and written instructions.

· Able to work both independently and within a team.

· Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills.

· Strong attention to detail.

· Ability to work in high-demand, high-volume environment and meet deadlines.

· Ability to handle confidential and business matters in a professional manner and defuse employee related

situations appropriately.

· May be required to complete and maintain SanMar’s Lift Operator Certification.

· Essential days or overtime may be required.

What's Our Offer?

Salary Range: You`ll earn between $22.54 - $30.96 on an hourly basis, depending on experience.

Bonus: You`ll be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus up to 5% of base salary.

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per

year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits: · Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits · 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle · Life insurance · Short/long-term disability coverage · Paid maternity/paternity leave · Pet insurance What Should You Expect? DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee operates powered equipment requiring use of both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Employee will be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment such as a protective harness while operating equipment. Basic English literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced. The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

jobs.title: Principal Operations Engineer, Electrical
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

 - Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Serve as the most senior technical authority for operational electrical infrastructure across the hyperscale AI data center fleet.

 - Lead site assessments and operational audits, and drive the technical readiness of teams ahead of site activation.

 - Review designs and specifications from an operational lens, and feed operational learnings back into design and manufacturing as the build model becomes productized.

 - Own electrical operational readiness and the commissioning-to-operations handover for new sites.

 - Author and approve high-risk electrical MOPs, EOPs, and AOPs, and lead root cause analysis on significant electrical events.

 - Act as the connective tissue between operations, design, construction, hardware, and EHS, and a force multiplier across cluster leads and field engineers.

 - Travel 50 to 75% across the fleet. The work is in the field, not at a desk.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've spent a career running mission-critical electrical systems and come up through the trades, the field, or both.

 - You command the operational electrical stack: switchgear, UPS, generators, paralleling, ATS/STS, PDUs, and EPMS, in live critical environments.

 - You've authored and executed high-risk electrical MOPs and led root cause analysis on significant events through closure.

 - You walk into any site and assess operational readiness, audit the posture, and raise the standard.

 - You teach. You build the technical readiness of the teams around you ahead of activation.

 - Bonus: Hyperscale or large colocation at hundreds of MW. NETA and NFPA 70E expertise. EPMS platforms. Arc-flash and electrical safety program ownership. Uptime Institute.


SALARY & BENEFITS

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.
   
   - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.
     
     
     Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.

Physical Requirements

 - Work in non-climate-controlled environments, including active construction areas, data halls, electrical and mechanical rooms, and outdoor spaces. Temperatures can be high or low, and conditions can be humid, loud or dusty.

 - Lift, carry, push and pull up to 40 pounds on your own.

 - Sit, stand, walk, kneel, bend and crouch for long periods, including full shifts on your feet.

jobs.title: Content Strategist, Amazon & Marketplace
jobs.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

About the Role

As a Content Strategist, Amazon & Marketplace, you'll own product content for our commerce clients on Amazon. You will plan what gets worked on and when, write and optimize the content, get it published in Seller Central and Vendor Central, and report on what it did for the client's search rank, traffic and conversion.

This is a hands-on role. You will work inside our existing process and tools, alongside account managers, ad managers, an offshore publishing team and the client directly. The goal of every listing is the same: help more shoppers find the product, help more of them convert, and set accurate expectations so the brand earns fewer returns and negative reviews.

This position is offered as an initial three-month contract, with a potential for extension.

Responsibilities:

• Plan Join internal and client onboarding calls to understand priorities, scope, Brand Registry status and the client's in-house content resources. Run Content Gap Analyses from Pacvue Commerce exports to find missing or weak titles, bullets, descriptions, images and A+ Content across hero and secondary ASINs. Build and present a Content Calendar that prioritizes batches by revenue, ad focus, promotions, launches and seasonality, and keep it current through QBRs.

• Create Research each product, brand, competitor set and shopper profile, including Brand Analytics demographics and Amazon policy for compliance-heavy categories (baby, pet, supplements, health). Run customer review analysis on the client's and competitors' reviews to surface what shoppers value and what they complain about. Do keyword research in Helium 10 (Cerebro) and write titles, bullets, descriptions and backend search terms using Monks' AI listing tools, then edit every output for accuracy, brand voice, SEO, readability and Amazon compliance. No unsupported claims. Peer QA colleagues' work, manage client review (two rounds of revision) and defend recommendations with search volume data when a client edit works against best practice. Share approved keyword research with the ad manager so paid and organic work from the same keyword set.

jobs.title: Account Executive - SMB (Full-Service Restaurants)
jobs.description:
ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - SMB (FULL-SERVICE RESTAURANTS)

Location: Ottawa, ON or Toronto, ON | Hybrid (4 days/week)
Department: SMB Sales | Full-service Restaurant
Department Leader: Shawna Rioux, VP, SMB Sales https://www.linkedin.com/in/shawnarioux/
Type: Permanent | Full-Time | Existing Vacancy




ABOUT SOLINK

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!




THE ROLE

We’re looking for curious and energetic sales talent to join our fast-growing team that works with some of the biggest brands in quick service restaurants, retailers, hospitality and financial organizations. The ideal candidate should have experience with sales prospecting and business development and has worked as an Account Executive selling SaaS.

Are you a self starter and not afraid to take initiative? Do you enjoy building and nurturing relationships? Do you enjoy presenting and conducting product demos? Do you thrive in collaborating and working in an ENERGETIC Team environment?... Then this opportunity is for YOU!




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Prospect with Purpose: Identify and reach out to brands you admire and customers who would benefit from Solink—using a smart, targeted, and proactive approach.

 - Own the Full Sales Cycle: From discovery and demos to pricing, negotiation, and close—you’ll lead every step with confidence and precision.

 - Deliver High-Impact Demos: Present Solink’s platform in a compelling way that speaks to each customer’s unique challenges and goals.

 - Hit (and Exceed) Your Targets: Consistently meet or exceed quota, while staying focused on quality conversations, qualified pipeline, and long-term customer value.

 - Have Fun Doing It: Celebrate wins, bring energy, and enjoy the journey—because culture matters just as much as closing.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Team Player with Individual Hustle: You love celebrating wins with a supportive team—but you also hold yourself to a high standard and consistently push to exceed your own goals.

 - Value-Driven Communicator: You can clearly connect the dots between a customer’s pain points and Solink’s value. You’re equally fluent in big-picture impact and detailed product differentiation.

 - Relationship Builder: Whether it’s with teammates or prospects, you build trust naturally and quickly. You understand people, meet them where they are, and connect with empathy.

 - Growth-Oriented: You’re a sponge for feedback and personal development. You invest in your own growth and actively share learnings with your team.

 - Goal Crusher: Quotas aren’t ceilings—they’re starting points. You set the bar high and love surpassing it.

 - Customer-Centric Listener: You’re naturally curious and know that listening—not pitching—is the foundation of great discovery and great deals.

 - Creative Problem Solver: Challenges energize you. You think on your feet and approach obstacles with creativity and a solution-first mindset.




SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

 - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

 - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.




OUR VALUES

We do things the Solink way:

 - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

 - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

 - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

 - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.
   

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.




WHY SOLINK?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

 - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

 - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

 - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

 - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

 - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

 - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

 - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.




WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

 1. Intro call with our Talent Team

 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

 3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

 4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

 5. Reference Checks

 6. Offer & onboarding 🎉


PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS.




HOW TO APPLY

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://solink.com/careers/]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.


NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION.




SOLINK IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. WE’RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE. IF YOU REQUIRE ACCOMMODATION DURING THE SELECTION PROCESS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

jobs.description:

CDH Medical Oncology (4A)

• Our unit cares for patients 18 years of age and older and treats all cancer diagnosis

• Provide palliative and end of life/hospice care

• Utilizes the best available evidence, including research findings to guide practice decisions.

jobs.title: Veterinary Receptionist
jobs.description:
Fox Creek Veterinary Hospital at Creve Coeur is seeking a skilled and compassionate Veterinary Receptionist to serve as the primary point of contact for our clients and their pets. This position plays an integral role in the overall client experience, requiring a professional who can balance administrative precision with genuine warmth across a wide range of interactions — including those of a sensitive or emotionally complex nature.

Qualified candidates will bring demonstrated experience managing high-volume front desk operations, a calm and composed presence under pressure, and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality customer service in a clinical setting.

What to Expect

As you join our mission, expect to be supported in your work and home life with:

• A comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Paid time off and a 401(k) plan for full-time employees

• Professional development opportunities

• Employee pet discount because we know your pets are family, too.

Salary: $18 - $22 per hour, determined by the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications.

Schedule: This is a full-time position.  Shifts are scheduled within our hospital's hours of operation: Monday – Sunday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM and Rotating weekends and holidays required.

Responsibilities

• Greet and check in clients and patients, verify and update medical records, and confirm appointment details using practice management software

• Answer and manage a multi-line telephone system, responding to inquiries regarding appointment scheduling, prescription refill requests, vaccination records, and general hospital information

• Perform client check-out, including processing payments, posting charges, explaining invoices, and scheduling follow-up appointments

• Communicate medical information, diagnoses, and care instructions accurately and compassionately, including in emotionally sensitive situations such as euthanasia scheduling and end-of-life discussions

• Maintain accurate electronic medical records (EMR) and ensure timely data entry in the veterinary practice information management system (PIMS)

• Coordinate with veterinarians, veterinary technicians, and support staff to relay client communications, flag urgent cases, and maintain efficient patient flow

• Maintain cleanliness and organization of the reception area and waiting room to ensure a positive client experience

Qualifications

• Minimum 1 year of experience as a veterinary receptionist is preferred

• Experience with veterinary practice management software; Cornerstone, Avimark, ImproMed, eVetPractice, or ezyVet preferred

• Knowledge of veterinary medical terminology, vaccination protocols, and basic diagnostic procedures

• Proficiency in appointment scheduling, multi-line phone management, medical records management, and payment processing

• Proven customer service skills; ability to manage high-volume client relations with composure and accuracy

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including active listening and conflict resolution

• Comfortable handling animals of varying sizes, breeds, and temperaments, including fearful or reactive patients

About Fox Creek Veterinary Hospital at Creve Coeur

Fox Creek Veterinary Hospital is excited to announce the opening of our newest location in Creve Coeur, MO! As part of the Fox Creek family — with established locations in Wildwood, Kirkwood, and Manchester — we are proud to bring our exceptional standard of care to the Creve Coeur community.

Since our founding in 2000, Fox Creek has been committed to providing compassionate, high-quality veterinary medicine using advanced facilities and equipment. We are an AAHA-Accredited practice, a distinction that reflects our dedication to the highest standards in veterinary care.

Our Creve Coeur team will offer a full range of services for dogs, cats, and more, in a modern, welcoming environment. We are building a collaborative, team-oriented culture where every staff member plays a vital role in making a positive impact on the lives of the pets and families we serve.

If you're passionate about animal care and ready to be part of something new and exciting, we'd love to have you on our founding team!

jobs.title: Dispensary Technician - Veterinary Part Time
jobs.description:
Join Our Team at Coral Springs Animal Hospital!

Are you a dedicated and compassionate professional looking to make a significant impact on veterinary medicine? We are seeking a qualified Part-Time Dispensary Technician to join our team and help us elevate the standard of care for our beloved animal patients.

Who We Are

Coral Springs Animal Hospital is a state‑of‑the‑art, AAHA‑certified facility in South Florida offering primary care, specialty services, and 24/7 emergency care. Our compassionate team collaborates across multiple disciplines—from oncology and surgery to radiology, ultrasound, and rehabilitation—delivering advanced diagnostics and treatments using cutting‑edge equipment. We’re dedicated to fostering a supportive environment where veterinary professionals can grow, feel empowered, and make a meaningful difference in pet lives daily.

About The Role

Our ideal candidate will be dedicated to providing accurate and efficient medication dispensing, can work in a fast-paced environment, and be adaptable to a dynamic workload. As a Dispensary Technician, you will provide excellent service to our clients and assist our veterinarians in the delivery of exceptional medical care to our patients.

As a valued member of our team, you will contribute with a positive attitude while supporting our veterinarians in the safe and accurate processing, packaging, and labeling of prescriptions. Responsibilities include handling refill requests received via voicemail or email, preparing controlled substances and other medications for in-hospital use, and maintaining accurate logs and reporting. A solid understanding of commonly used veterinary medications and basic medical math is essential. You will also play a role in training and mentoring assistants and junior technicians, ensuring compliance with hospital policies, procedures and quality standards, providing compassionate and professional client care, and actively engaging in continuing education to expand your skills. We value team members who bring forward solutions to challenges within the department and are flexible in assisting with other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Previous veterinary experience, preferably in an emergency or specialty hospital setting.

• Able to lift 40 lbs and stand for extended periods (up to 10 hours)

• Knowledge of veterinary EMS and inventory software (Cornerstone, Instinct, Omnicell) preferred

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong knowledge of veterinary pharmaceuticals and pharmacy regulations

Why Join Us?

Work-Life Rewards – Competitive wages, generous PTO, full medical/dental/vision coverage, employer-funded HSA, paid family leave, 401(k) with match, pet care discounts.

Mentorship and Growth: Benefit from personalized mentorship programs and career advancement opportunities. We support your professional development, providing an environment for growth, regardless of your career goals.

Ideal Location: Located in South Florida, Coral Springs offers sunny weather year-round and a wide variety of outdoor activities, beautiful beaches, nature, shopping, dining, and a vibrant arts and culture scene. It’s one of the most sought-after suburban areas, balancing quiet, charming neighborhoods with exciting destinations, events, and activities.

Ready to Apply?

Join us in supporting exceptional veterinary care through efficient and strategic hospital operations. If you’re passionate about logistics, organization, and playing a vital behind-the-scenes role in a fast-paced medical environment, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range: $17- $20

Requirements:

• Passionate about helping children with autism

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team

• 18+ years of age

• High school diploma or GED

• Ability to obtain a CPR, First Aid Certification and Tuberculosis test (if you haven’t had one in the last year)

• Ability to pass a pre employment background check

• Ability to move in various positions (sit, squat, bend, etc.)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds

• Candidates must obtain an Registered Behavior Technician Certification after completing onboarding

Perks of Working at Centria:

• Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis

• Discounts to hundreds of retail partners via our Benefit Hub

• Access to Centria’s Employee Assistance Plan with benefits around mental health and counseling

• Early wage access to employees through Rain - Work today, get paid tomorrow!

• Unlimited opportunities to make an impact in the life of a special needs child

jobs.title: Veterinary Receptionist
jobs.description:
Veterinary Receptionist

Watson's Friends Animal Hospital is seeking a skilled and compassionate veterinary receptionist to serve as the primary point of contact for our clients and their pets. This position plays an integral role in the overall client experience, requiring a professional who can balance administrative precision with genuine warmth across a wide range of interactions — including those of a sensitive or emotionally complex nature.

Qualified candidates will bring demonstrated experience managing high-volume front desk operations, a calm and composed presence under pressure, and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality customer service in a clinical setting.

What to Expect

As you join our mission, expect to be supported in your work and home life with:

• A comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Paid time off and a 401(k) plan for full-time employees

• Professional development opportunities

Salary: $16.00-$20.00 per hour dependent on skills and experience

Schedule: Monday- Friday 9AM-7PM, Thursdays off, Every other Saturday

Responsibilities

• Greet and check in clients and patients, verify and update medical records, and confirm appointment details using practice management software

• Answer and manage a multi-line telephone system, responding to inquiries regarding appointment scheduling, prescription refill requests, vaccination records, and general hospital information

• Perform client check-out, including processing payments, posting charges, explaining invoices, and scheduling follow-up appointments

• Communicate medical information, diagnoses, and care instructions accurately and compassionately, including in emotionally sensitive situations such as euthanasia scheduling and end-of-life discussions

• Maintain accurate electronic medical records (EMR) and ensure timely data entry in the veterinary practice information management system (PIMS)

• Coordinate with veterinarians, veterinary technicians, and support staff to relay client communications, flag urgent cases, and maintain efficient patient flow

• Maintain cleanliness and organization of the reception area and waiting room to ensure a positive client experience

Qualifications

• Minimum 1 year of experience as a veterinary receptionist is required

• Experience with veterinary practice management software; Cornerstone, Avimark, ImproMed, eVetPractice, or ezyVet preferred

• Knowledge of veterinary medical terminology, vaccination protocols, and basic diagnostic procedures

• Proficiency in appointment scheduling, multi-line phone management, medical records management, and payment processing

• Proven customer service skills; ability to manage high-volume client relations with composure and accuracy

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including active listening and conflict resolution

• Comfortable handling animals of varying sizes, breeds, and temperaments, including fearful or reactive patients

About Watson's Friends Animal Hospital

Our practice has state of the art technology and Surgery Suite as well as comfortable exam rooms and treatment areas. Located off Moccasin Wallow Road in Gateway Commons Shopping Center on Buffalo Road, near Publix Market.

Inspired by their beloved fur baby Watson, a Labrador Retriever, Watson's Friends Animal Hospital was chosen as the perfect name for this new center of care and wellness for pets. Now the family has expanded to include a new fur baby, Walter. They can’t wait to meet and greet you when you visit our hospital!

US Conec, Ltd. is a trusted, global company that prides itself on engineering excellence—creating innovative connectivity solutions that support today’s most important technologies. We foster a friendly, inclusive culture that values teamwork, creativity, and mutual respect. At US Conec, you’ll find real opportunities to grow and make a meaningful impact in a company that genuinely cares about its people and its customers. With competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and a supportive environment, this is a place where you can build your future—whether your interests lie in manufacturing, engineering, operations, or beyond.

Machining Technician – Hickory, NC

Overview

US Conec is seeking a skilled Manufacturing Machining Technician to join our RD&E team. In this role, you’ll provide hands‑on support for production and engineering projects, specializing in precision machining of mold components and advanced technologies such as Single Point Diamond Turning (SPDT), Wire EDM, and Hole Driller EDM. You’ll play a critical role in turning engineering designs into ultra‑precise parts, supporting product development, and ensuring the highest quality standards. Prior experience with advanced high precision machinery is not required; we will train the right person!

Responsibilities

• Program and operate multi‑axis machining equipment, Wire EDM, Hole Driller EDM, SPDT machines, and surface grinders for high‑tolerance features.

• Create and optimize CAM programs (ESPRIT) using 3D CAD (AutoDesk Inventor) and GD&T.

• Perform ultra‑precision gauging and dimensional verification with accuracies to 0.0001 mm.

• Inspect mold tooling and components using precision measurement systems; analyze and communicate results to guide team decisions.

• Support engineering projects and provide technical assistance to production teams.

• Establish and maintain preventive maintenance programs for machining equipment.

• Perform or coordinate equipment repairs as needed.

• Assist with product and process qualifications in collaboration with Product Development and Quality Assurance.

• Document activities, collect data, and prepare reports to support continuous improvement.

Must Haves

• Associate degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent hands‑on experience.

• 3+ years of experience in machining processes.

• Ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings.

• Proficiency in CAD/CAM programming, including generating and modifying G‑code.

• Strong troubleshooting, prioritization, and process improvement skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Haves

• Experience with thermoplastic or thermoset molds and molding equipment.

• Precision machining experience with SPDT, Wire EDM, Hole Driller EDM, and high‑accuracy CNC equipment.

• Background in hydraulic, pneumatic, and/or electronic systems repair.

• Knowledge of experimental design, data analysis, and statistical quality control techniques.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and related software.

• Prior experience in a product development or R&D lab environment

• Familiarity with precision metrology instrumentation and ability to inspect very small components (down to 125 microns).

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary with performance‑based bonus potential.

• 4 weeks of PTO plus paid holidays.

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

• 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match.

• A collaborative, team‑based culture that values innovation and precision.

• Opportunities to work with cutting‑edge machining technologies and global engineering teams.

• Recognition programs and professional development opportunities.

US Conec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Join US Conec today and be part of a team that values each other, promotes innovation and growth, and strives to exceed customer expectations in everything we do.

jobs.title: Dimensional Engineer
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Dimensional Engineer supports dimensional Quality engineering activities for vehicle launch and series production at Lucid Motors. Reporting to the Sr. Dimensional Engineer, this role performs drawing compliance reviews, dimensional data analysis, vehicle build correlation, fixture and measurement-system validation, process capability monitoring, containment support, and dimensional audits across Stamping, Body-in-White (BIW), Closures, and Vehicle Assembly. The engineer works cross-functionally to identify dimensional variation, protect production, and implement sustainable improvements that meet engineering specifications and customer-perceived Quality expectations.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute dimensional Quality activities and deliverables under the direction of the Sr. Dimensional Engineer for assigned vehicle systems and manufacturing areas.

• Review engineering drawings, GD&T, datum strategies, tolerance requirements, assembly interfaces, special characteristics, and measurement plans.

• Analyze ScanBox, eCube, CMM, optical scanning, fixture, and manual measurement results to identify trends, out-of-control conditions, and dimensional risks.

• Support vehicle build correlation and investigate gap, flush, fit, alignment, geometry, sealing, closure effort, and dimensional variation concerns.

• Perform structured root cause analysis with Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Supplier Quality, Tooling, Production, and Metrology teams.

• Develop and maintain dimensional inspection plans, Control Plans, reaction plans, check sheets, defect maps, and standardized reporting.

• Support fixture buyoff, tooling verification, gage approval, measurement-system validation, correlation studies, and Measurement System Analysis (MSA) activities.

• Conduct capability studies and monitor critical dimensional characteristics using SPC, Cp, and Cpk methodologies.

• Support APQP, PPAP, trial builds, safe launch, engineering changes, new-part introduction, process validation, and dimensional sign-off activities.

• Coordinate containment, suspect population identification, dimensional inspection, product disposition evidence, and corrective-action verification for nonconforming conditions.

• Perform dimensional process audits and verify compliance with approved measurement strategies, Control Plans, work instructions, and escalation requirements.

• Prepare clear dimensional issue summaries, trend reports, correlation studies, and action tracking for technical and management reviews.

• Work with metrology programmers, eCube specialists, technicians, and production teams to ensure accurate data collection and timely response to abnormalities.

• Capture lessons learned and support continuous improvement of dimensional measurement, data visualization, traceability, and manufacturing feedback loops.

Skills

• Strong working knowledge of GD&T, datum structures, tolerance interpretation, dimensional variation, and automotive body geometry.

• Experience with CMM, ScanBox, eCube or inline measurement systems, laser or optical scanning, checking fixtures, and dimensional analysis software.

• Understanding of Stamping, BIW, Closures, hemming, joining, and Vehicle Assembly processes.

• Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, Cp/Cpk, layered process audits, and structured problem-solving methods.

• Ability to interpret measurement data, recognize dimensional trends, correlate findings to process conditions, and communicate actionable conclusions.

• Strong analytical, data visualization, technical reporting, organizational, and cross-functional communication skills.

• Hands-on, customer-focused approach with the ability to manage multiple launch and production priorities.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with PLM, MES, QMS, metrology databases, and digital traceability systems.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metrology, Automotive Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

• 3-5 years of experience in automotive dimensional engineering, metrology, body engineering, or a related discipline.

• Ability to work on the manufacturing floor and support production and launch priorities.

• Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate dimensional findings and clearly escalate issues to the Sr. Dimensional Engineer and cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with GD&T, CMM or optical metrology, checking fixtures, dimensional data analysis, MSA, SPC, or capability studies.

• Experience supporting vehicle launches, greenfield manufacturing, safe launch, or high-volume production ramp-up.

• Automotive Stamping, BIW, Closures, Tooling, or Vehicle Assembly experience.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Business & International Scope
jobs.description:

A ride that will fuel up your ambitions to take on a new challenge and stretch yourself beyond your comfort zone.

We’ll deliver a non-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people, paving the way forward together.

What makes our ride unique?

• We have an ‘’office-first’’ culture and we place collaboration at the center of everything we do!
• We have a non-vanilla personality and feedback mindset. We don’t shy away from difficult conversations - we see them as a gift!
• We work with high intensity and have fun along the way. We also celebrate the wins (a lot!).
• We celebrate diversity in all its forms and foster an inclusive culture where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

💪Our career development philosophy.

• We are building a talent house of high performing teams and leaders. We invest in people who raise the bar and help others reach their full potential.
• We take ownership of our career development. We don’t believe in linear and predictable career paths - we create the job of our dreams!
• We embrace opportunities to move the needle and make an impact beyond our scope.

🤝Our commitment to being a force for good.

• Our platform is an important economic tool for millions of people (customers, partners, couriers) and we are taking action to amplify our positive impact.
• We invest in doing good by dedicating time and resources into social and environmental initiatives.
• We have the ambition of being DIB role models across the tech industry. We are creating environments, systems, and processes that provide equal opportunities, break biases, and empower our communities.

We have a vision: Building the largest marketplace in your city, to give access to anything in minutes. And this is where your ride starts.

YOUR MISSION

Build the best Talent House worldwide! As part of the Talent Acquisition team, you will be the advisor and gatekeeper that Glovo needs, helping the business raise the bar with every hire. You will understand and advise the hiring managers with your market expertise, analyze TA metrics, and build robust recruiting strategies to attract the best talent while caring about the operational excellence of our recruitment process and keep always at the center of your work the quality of both candidates and hiring managers' experience.

THE JOURNEY

• Manage end-to-end recruiting including research, sourcing, candidate assessment & management, offer recommendation, negotiation & acceptance
• Develop a deep understanding of one of our talent markets to source the best candidates.
• Tailor sourcing strategies for each region, leveraging local networks, job boards, and other resources.
• Stay updated on hiring trends, salary benchmarks, and legal requirements for the respective regions
• Coach hiring managers on several recruiting topics such as: time to fill, market mapping, candidate engagement and conversion, adapting to the region(s) you will manage.
• Improve upon existing programs and develop innovative strategies around finding top talent
• Utilizing ATS reports, dashboards, and other tools to illustrate the recruiting pipeline and results
• Be passionate about tech and on-demand and why people should work here
• Support employer branding activities through attending networking events, e-meetups, etc.
• Candidate obsession! Manage your pipeline of candidates and identify what future opportunities they may be a fit for

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

• 5+ years of experience recruiting different profiles in a fast-paced environment (experience in a scale-up or tech companies).
• History of collaborating successfully with hiring managers and business leaders – managing different types of decision makers, advising leaders, and influencing strategic hiring decisions.
• Experience working on a variety of roles/levels at an international level.
• Managing a volume of 10-15 requisitions at the same time.
• Great organisational and time management skills.
• Strong ownership and influencing skills is a must have for this role.
• Experience with market research, combined with strong and varied sourcing abilities.
• Solid understanding of Glovo's vision, business model and operations.
• Networking skills and the ability to make smart recruiting partnerships happen.
• Metrics oriented: you understand and value backing up recruiting strategy and goals with existing data (while never compromising the quality and the candidate experience).
• Knowledge and experience with regional talent markets – particularly in countries where Glovo operates.
• English [min C1 level] - spoken and written + additional language from the countries that Glovo operates is a plus.

We believe driven talent deserves:

• 🌟 An enticing equity plan that lets you own a piece of the action.
• 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
• 🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings.
• 💳 Cobee discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
• 🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energised.
• 🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
• 👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.
• 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.
• 📚 An external learning budget to fuel your thirst for knowledge and personal growth.

At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

jobs.title: CMM Programmer
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The CMM Programmer develops, validates, optimizes, and maintains Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) programs and dimensional inspection methods for vehicle launch and series production at Lucid Motors. Reporting to the Metrology Manager, this role ensures efficient, accurate, repeatable, and traceable measurement of stamped parts, body structures, closures, assemblies, fixtures, tooling, Powertrain components, and investigation samples. The CMM Programmer works closely with Dimensional Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Supplier Quality, Tooling, and Metrology Technicians to translate engineering requirements into reliable measurement strategies and actionable dimensional reports.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, prove out, validate, optimize, document, and maintain CMM programs using approved CAD models, engineering drawings, GD&T, measurement plans, and acceptance criteria.

• Define robust part alignments, datum structures, probing strategies, feature constructions, scanning paths, clearance moves, measurement sequences, and reporting outputs.

• Create and maintain inspection programs for stamped panels, Body-in-White (BIW), closures, assemblies, fixtures, tooling, master parts, Powertrain components, and investigation samples.

• Validate new and revised programs through feature verification, repeatability studies, correlation, peer review, and comparison with approved reference methods.

• Interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, GD&T, special characteristics, tolerance requirements, and dimensional control plans to ensure complete measurement coverage.

• Optimize program cycle time and equipment utilization without compromising measurement accuracy, repeatability, accessibility, or safety.

• Perform or support Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Gage Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R&R), measurement uncertainty studies, capability analysis, and correlation between CMM, ScanBox, eCube, fixtures, and manual measurement methods.

• Generate clear dimensional reports, deviation summaries, trend and SPC charts, color maps, and technical findings for launch, production, audits, containment, and root cause investigations.

• Support fixture buyoff, tooling verification, engineering changes, new-part introduction, trial builds, safe launch, process validation, and dimensional sign-off.

• Troubleshoot CMM programs, probe configurations, alignments, software errors, collisions, environmental effects, and inconsistent measurement results.

• Maintain program revision control, backups, naming conventions, report templates, probe libraries, qualification records, calibration status, and measurement traceability.

• Coordinate with Metrology Technicians to ensure correct program execution, part setup, fixture use, data storage, and escalation of abnormal results.

• Provide training and technical coaching on CMM operation, program execution, GD&T interpretation, measurement methods, reporting, and equipment care.

• Support continuous improvement of programming standards, measurement cycle time, automation, data visualization, correlation, and metrology workflows.

Skills

• Advanced CMM programming and measurement capabilities, including CAD-based programming, offline programming, alignments, datum setup, probe qualification, scanning, feature construction, reporting, and troubleshooting.

• Strong knowledge of GD&T, datum reference frames, tolerance interpretation, coordinate metrology, measurement uncertainty, MSA, repeatability, and correlation methods.

• Experience with common CMM software platforms and dimensional data analysis or reporting tools.

• Ability to interpret complex engineering drawings, CAD models, specifications, measurement plans, and automotive dimensional control requirements.

• Working knowledge of optical measurement, ScanBox, eCube or inline measurement systems, laser scanning, checking fixtures, master parts, and manual metrology.

• Understanding of stamping, BIW, closures, tooling, vehicle assembly, precision components, and manufacturing variation.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical documentation, organizational, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with PLM, QMS, MES, metrology databases, and digital traceability systems.

jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Sr. Dimensional Engineer leads dimensional Quality engineering activities for vehicle launch and series production at Lucid Motors. This role is responsible for dimensional strategy, critical characteristic deployment, dimensional validation, vehicle build correlation, launch readiness assessments, and root cause investigations across Stamping, Body-in-White (BIW), Closures, and Vehicle Assembly. The Sr. Dimensional Engineer converts measurement and metrology data into actionable manufacturing improvements and partners with Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Supplier Quality, Tooling, and Metrology teams to achieve dimensional maturity, process capability, and customer-perceived Quality targets.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the AMP-2 dimensional Quality strategy and deploy critical product and process characteristics across vehicle programs and manufacturing areas.

• Drive dimensional maturity reviews, vehicle build correlation, launch readiness validation, safe launch activities, and dimensional process sign-off.

• Review engineering drawings, GD&T, datum strategies, tolerance schemes, assembly interfaces, special characteristics, and measurement requirements for manufacturing feasibility and inspection readiness.

• Lead root cause investigations for gap, flush, fit, alignment, geometry, sealing, closure effort, and dimensional variation concerns affecting build Quality or customer perception.

• Analyze ScanBox, eCube, CMM, optical scanning, fixture, and manual measurement data to identify sources of variation and define corrective actions.

• Develop and maintain dimensional Control Plans, measurement strategies, reaction plans, inspection standards, and reporting methods for launch and production.

• Evaluate engineering changes affecting dimensional characteristics and develop actions to mitigate associated risks.

• Lead Measurement System Analysis (MSA), correlation studies, capability studies, and SPC monitoring for critical dimensional characteristics.

• Support APQP, PPAP, engineering changes, trial builds, process validation, and new-part introduction activities requiring dimensional approval.

• Partner with Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Supplier Quality, Tooling, and Metrology teams to eliminate variation and improve process capability.

• Lead containment, suspect population definition, product disposition support, corrective action verification, and recurrence monitoring for dimensional nonconformities.

• Develop dimensional issue summaries, trend reports, defect maps, build-correlation reports, lessons learned, and management escalations.

• Coach dimensional engineers, metrology programmers, eCube specialists, and technicians on GD&T, measurement methods, data interpretation, and structured problem solving.

• Support continuous improvement and digitalization of dimensional data collection, visualization, traceability, and closed-loop feedback to manufacturing.

Skills

• Expert knowledge of GD&T, datum structures, tolerance stack-up analysis, variation management, dimensional control strategies, and automotive body geometry.

• Strong experience with CMM, ScanBox, eCube or inline measurement systems, laser or optical scanning, checking fixtures, and dimensional analysis software.

• Advanced understanding of Stamping, BIW, Closures, hemming, marriage, and Vehicle Assembly processes.

• Strong knowledge of APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, Cp/Cpk, layered process audits, and structured problem-solving methods.

• Ability to correlate dimensional data with tooling, fixture, joining, process, and vehicle-build conditions and translate findings into clear corrective actions.

• Strong dimensional analysis, data visualization, technical reporting, and presentation skills.

• Excellent cross-functional communication, influencing, coaching, and problem-solving skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with PLM, MES, digital traceability systems, and metrology databases.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

• 5-8 years of experience in automotive dimensional engineering, metrology, body engineering, or a related discipline.

• Experience leading dimensional investigations, vehicle build correlation, launch validation, and dimensional maturity activities within an automotive OEM or Tier 1 environment.

• Hands-on experience with GD&T, CMM, metrology, dimensional fixtures, MSA, SPC, and capability analysis.

• Ability to work on the manufacturing floor, support launch and production priorities, and communicate complex dimensional issues across organizational levels.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Experience supporting a greenfield plant, new vehicle launch, or high-volume production ramp-up.

• Automotive Body, Closures, Stamping, Tooling, or Vehicle Assembly experience.

jobs.description:
