Our mission is to deliver personalized care that radiates compassion and preserves dignity for all that we are honored to serve on their end-of-life journey. We are centered on caring for the whole person – with expert medical care, pain management as well as emotional and spiritual support along with resources, information, and emotional support for families and caregivers.

About the role:

The PRN Masters of Social Worker contracted or employed through the organization is responsible for the implementation of standards of care for medical social work services and for adherence to all conditions in the Service or Employment Agreement.

Job Responsibilities:

• Assesses the psychosocial status of patients and families/caregivers related to the patient's terminal illness and environment and communicates findings to the registered nurse and other members of the interdisciplinary group. Provides an assessment in the patient's identified residence and assistance when this is not safe, and another plan is required.

• Carries out social evaluations, including family dynamics, caregiver abilities, communication patterns, high risks for suicide, neglect, or abuse, and plans intervention based on evaluation findings. Counsels patient and family/caregivers as needed in relationship to stress, and other identified coping difficulties. Provides crisis intervention when necessary.

• Assesses for, and educates interdisciplinary groups, on any special needs related to the culture of the patient and family. Includes communication, role of family, space, and any special traditions or taboos.

• Maintains clinical records on all patients referred to social work.

• Educates patients and families on, and assists in, the preparation of advanced directives.

• Provides information and referral services for organization patients and families/caregivers regarding practical and environmental needs.

• Provides information to patients and families/caregivers and community agencies.

• Serves as liaison between patients and families/caregivers and community agencies.

• Maintains collaborative relationships with organization personnel to support patient care.

• Maintains and develops contracts with public and private agencies as resources for patients and personnel.

• Participates in the development of the individualized plan of care, involving the patient and family, and attends regularly scheduled interdisciplinary group meetings, assisting the team in recognizing the effects of the psychosocial stresses on the symptoms of the terminal illness.

• Assists physician and other team members in understanding significant social and emotional factors related to health problems and death/dying issues.

• Actively participates in quality assessment performance improvement teams and activities.

• Assists family and patient in planning for funeral arrangements, and financial, legal, and health care decision responsibilities.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
About Tenex

Tenex builds frontier AI that works in the real world. Our engineers sit with C-suite leaders, find where AI adds the most value, and ship bleeding-edge AI to production.

We were founded in New York City in 2025. We are currently 70 team members, all based in New York, and will be 100+ by end of year. Our clients include Fortune 500 companies across media, healthcare, retail, finance, and sports.

We are a preferred partner to Anthropic, SpaceXAI and other frontier labs to turn technology into reliable systems businesses use every day.

 

The Role

We are looking for a Strategic Finance Senior Associate to take meaningful ownership across the finance organization, reporting directly to the Director of Strategic Finance. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You will work on key strategic initiatives alongside the leadership team and support the team as we scale.

You will thrive in this role if you have a strong analytical foundation and want to further your operating experience at a fast-growing startup. In this position, you will build out and own sales forecasts and significant parts of the financial model. You will also have the opportunity to own and drive process around accounts payable and accounts receivable, tracking and forecasting OPEX, and leading ad-hoc analysis and strategic initiatives set by leadership.

 - Ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership.

 - Strong attention to detail, with the judgment to connect financial results to broader business priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

 - At least one year of finance experience at a high-growth startup, ideally at the Series B or Series C stage.

 - Experience building sales forecasts, managing operating expense forecasts, or owning components of a company’s financial model.

jobs.title: Recruiter, Applied AI
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a strategic Go-To-Market Recruiter specializing in Applied AI to join our GTM recruiting organization. In this role, you'll focus specifically on building and scaling our Applied AI team - the Pre-Sales architects and technical advisors who help large enterprises successfully integrate and deploy Claude. Working within our broader GTM recruiting team, you'll drive full-cycle recruiting for these critical customer-facing technical roles that bridge our cutting-edge AI technology with real-world business applications.

This specialized role requires deep technical recruiting expertise combined with a strong understanding of enterprise SaaS and AI landscapes. You'll collaborate closely with GTM recruiting colleagues while developing targeted strategies for the unique talent needs of our Applied AI organization. You'll help shape how enterprises work with AI systems by building teams that directly influence the safe and beneficial deployment of Claude across industries.

Key responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end recruiting for Applied AI team roles, including Solutions Architects, Pre-Sales Engineers, front-line managers and other customer-facing technical positions

• Partner with Applied AI leadership and GTM recruiting colleagues to develop comprehensive hiring strategies that align with overall GTM objectives

• Execute sophisticated sourcing strategies to identify candidates with rare combinations of technical depth, customer empathy, and business acumen

• Create exceptional candidate experiences that showcase Anthropic's mission and the unique opportunity to shape enterprise AI adoption

• Build pipelines of talent with expertise in LLMs, cloud architecture, enterprise software integration, and technical consulting

• Collaborate with GTM recruiting team members to share best practices, market insights, and cross-functional candidate leads

• Leverage Claude and other AI tools to enhance recruiting efficiency while maintaining high-touch, personalized engagement

• Provide data-driven insights on compensation trends and talent availability specific to the Applied AI market

Minimum qualifications

• Excel at recruiting for customer-facing technical roles that require both deep technical knowledge and exceptional communication skills

• Understand the technical requirements of roles working with LLMs, APIs, cloud architectures, and enterprise system integration

• Thrive in collaborative environments, working seamlessly with GTM recruiting colleagues while managing specialized searches

• Can effectively assess candidates' abilities to translate complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders

• Have a track record of building trusted advisor relationships with technical hiring managers

• Are passionate about using AI to transform recruiting practices while maintaining a human-centered approach

Preferred qualifications

• Have 5+ years of technical or technical sales recruiting experience, ideally within GTM organizations at enterprise software or AI/ML companies

• Direct experience recruiting for pre-sales/solutions engineering roles in the AI/ML space

• Demonstrated success working within GTM recruiting organizations during periods of hypergrowth

• Expertise in developing specialized recruiting practices within broader team structures

• Familiarity with the challenges of deploying AI systems in enterprise environments

• Experience collaborating across recruiting teams to share resources and best practices

• A technical background or successful track record recruiting for highly specialized technical positions

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$175,000—$240,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
Who You Are

You are a consultative technology professional who combines deep networking expertise with a passion for solving customer challenges. You thrive in client-facing environments, building trusted relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, and strategic thinking. With extensive experience designing enterprise network solutions using Cisco and Juniper technologies, you're equally comfortable whiteboarding with engineers, presenting to executive stakeholders, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop winning solutions. You stay current on emerging networking trends, enjoy learning new technologies, and are motivated by helping customers achieve successful business outcomes through innovative infrastructure design.

About This Role

As a Pre-Sales Network Architect, you will play a critical role in helping clients modernize and optimize their network infrastructure by designing innovative, scalable, and secure solutions. Partnering closely with sales teams, customers, and technology partners, you'll translate complex business challenges into technical architectures that drive business outcomes. From leading discovery sessions and solution workshops to developing proposals and presenting executive-level recommendations, you'll serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales process. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex networking challenges, influencing technical strategy, and helping organizations leverage cutting-edge technologies to achieve their goals.

Must be based in the United States.

Other responsibilities include:

• Serve as the technical lead during pre-sales engagements, aligning network architectures with client goals across data center, campus, and WAN environments.

• Design and present solutions using Cisco (Catalyst, Nexus, ISR/ASR) and Juniper (MX, EX, SRX) platforms to meet customer requirements and business objectives.

• Lead whiteboarding sessions, technical workshops, and customer discovery meetings to define use cases, success criteria, and architectural recommendations.

• Collaborate with account managers, delivery teams, and OEM partners to develop comprehensive proposals, BOMs, and SOWs.

• Translate business needs into scalable, secure network architectures leveraging routing, switching, VPNs, and firewall technologies.

• Develop high-quality documentation, including HLDs, solution briefs, and client-ready presentations.

• Stay current on emerging technologies (SD-WAN, EVPN-VXLAN, automation) and communicate their value in customer environments.

• Participate in RFP responses, competitive analyses, and technical validation of proposed architectures.

• Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise clients, building long-term technical relationships.

• Complete ongoing security awareness training and comply with company policies to the requirements section

• Identify and escalate security risks to the appropriate Executive Leadership Team member and actively contribute to remediation efforts

• Other duties as assigned

Desired Skills and experience:

• 7+ years of experience in enterprise networking roles, including at least 2 years in a customer-facing pre-sales or solution architect capacity.

• Deep technical expertise in Cisco and Juniper network infrastructure (routing, switching, firewalls).

• Strong understanding of Layer 2/3 protocols (BGP, OSPF, STP, VLANs, VRFs), QoS, NAT, ACLs.

• Ability to lead technical discussions with engineers and executives alike.

• Experience designing or consulting on data center, WAN, or secure remote access solutions.

• Skilled at creating architecture diagrams, proposal documentation, and technical presentations.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certifications: CCNP/CCIE (Enterprise/Data Center), JNCIP/JNCIE strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with SD-WAN, EVPN-VXLAN, MPLS, or cloud networking (AWS/Azure).

• Experience with network automation (e.g., Ansible, Python) is a plus.

• Exposure to NAC, 802.1X, RADIUS, and hybrid networking environments.

A Little About Us

Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.

We live and breathe our core values:

• Dare To Be Great: We are big-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best.

• Own It: We set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and follow through on our commitments. We take pride in the experiences we create and the outcomes we deliver. We are personally invested in the success of our team and our clients. We iterate to deliver ever better results.

We are consistently listed among Inc & Crain's "Best Places to Work" and we're proud of our accessible & engaged executive team. We believe in cultivating an atmosphere of inclusion and providing an environment that enables every employee to work to the best of their ability.

Some of Our Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Acquisition Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

ANSER enhances national and homeland security by strengthening public institutions. We provide thought leadership for complex issues through independent analysis, and we deliver practical, useful solutions. ANSER values collaboration, integrity, and initiative and we are client focused in all that we do. Because we were established for the purpose of public service and not for profit, we measure our success in the impact of our service.

Position Overview

ANSER is seeking an experienced Senior Acquisition Program Manager to provide acquisition management, program analysis, and advisory support to U.S. Space Force organizations in El Segundo, California.

In this role, you will support the Government's Engine Room and Strategy Cell by analyzing complex acquisition and program information, coordinating priorities across stakeholders, and developing actionable recommendations to support senior leadership decisions. You will play a key role in tracking program execution, identifying risks, managing critical actions, and ensuring timely coordination across Government organizations and mission partners.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Provide senior-level acquisition management and program analysis support for complex Department of Defense (DoD) space programs.

• Support the Government's Engine Room and Strategy Cell in coordinating acquisition priorities, program activities, leadership taskings, and cross-functional actions.

• Analyze acquisition, financial, schedule, performance, funding, contracting, and requirements information to identify program trends, risks, issues, and potential impacts.

• Research, evaluate, and synthesize complex program information into concise executive summaries, briefings, reports, and decision-support materials.

• Track and coordinate workflow taskers, action items, suspense dates, and deliverables across Government organizations, contractors, and mission partners.

• Support acquisition planning, program execution, requirements development, and coordination of activities across functional and organizational boundaries.

• Collaborate with Government stakeholders and mission partners to gather information, resolve program issues, and maintain alignment with acquisition objectives and mission priorities.

• Develop, review, and coordinate acquisition documentation, executive correspondence, program reports, spreadsheets, briefings, and leadership decision materials.

• Evaluate program challenges, identify potential courses of action, assess associated impacts, and develop recommendations to support Government decision-making.

• Monitor program cost, schedule, performance, funding, contracting, and requirements activities to identify execution risks and support program oversight.

• Provide senior Government leadership with timely program analysis, status updates, and decision-quality information.

• Utilize Government acquisition, cost, requirements, reporting, and task-management systems to support program execution, coordination, and reporting.

• Independently manage assigned acquisition and program management activities, prioritize competing requirements, and deliver accurate, timely products in support of mission objectives.

Required Qualifications

• Active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility (TS/SCI).

• Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college or university in management, business, economics, finance, accounting, mathematics, science, technology, engineering, statistics, or a related field.

• Minimum of 15 years of relevant professional experience supporting acquisition, program management, business management, or operations activities, preferably within the DoD or space domain.

• PMT 4010 Certificate (or predecessor course), demonstrating qualification to support DoD Acquisition Category (ACAT) I and II programs.

• Comprehensive knowledge of DoD acquisition processes, including acquisition planning, program execution, requirements management, and program oversight.

• Understanding of mission-critical aspects of military space launch, ground systems, and sustainment programs.

• Demonstrated experience analyzing and synthesizing complex acquisition, financial, programmatic, and technical information to identify issues, assess impacts, and communicate actionable findings.

• Experience coordinating leadership taskings, action items, deliverables, and suspense requirements across multiple Government organizations and stakeholders.

• Experience developing executive-level briefings, reports, spreadsheets, program analyses, executive summaries, and other acquisition or program management products.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, to analyze program data and develop professional-quality decision-support materials.

• Familiarity with DoD acquisition, cost, requirements, reporting, and task-management systems and processes.

jobs.title: Senior Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Senior Inside Sales Representative

Location: Skopje, North Macedonia / Pristina, Kosovo (full-time, office-based)

We believe independent restaurants deserve the same advantages as big chains without giving up their independence.

Ilir Sela started Slice in his family’s pizzerias, where he saw firsthand what it takes to run a local shop. Now we’re taking everything we’ve learned beyond pizza, to taquerias, delis, burger joints, and other neighborhood staples.

We put technology, marketing, buying power, and support to work for more than 15,000 restaurants, so owners spend less time on admin, marketing, and order management and more time growing their business. They remain independent, but never alone.

We’re growing our team to help bring this next chapter to life. That’s where you come in.

The Challenge to Solve

Help independent restaurant owners see the full value of Slice, taking on more challenging sales opportunities while helping raise the bar for how we sell across the team.

The Role

As a Senior Inside Sales Representative, you'll own your sales pipeline and consistently deliver strong results, while also taking on some of our more complex and high-value opportunities where your experience can make a real difference.

You'll manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pitching through to closing and onboarding, bringing strong knowledge of our products and the ability to tailor your approach to each restaurant's needs. Whether you're navigating challenging objections, introducing multiple products or working with owners who need a more consultative approach, you'll know how to build trust and move conversations forward.

You'll also work closely with our US Territory Managers on opportunities that need additional support, and partner with Onboarding, Account Management and Support to make sure new restaurant partners have a smooth experience.

Alongside your own sales targets, you'll be someone other reps can learn from. You'll share what works, help newer colleagues build their confidence and bring ideas to leadership on how we can improve our sales approach. This is a senior individual contributor role, with the opportunity to have an impact beyond your own pipeline.

Key focus areas include:

• Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualifying through to closing and onboarding, taking the lead on more complex or high-value opportunities when needed.

• Sell across Slice's full product suite, including Slice Family Membership, Online Ordering, Phone Solution and Goods, tailoring recommendations to each restaurant's needs.

• Build strong relationships with restaurant owners, understanding their challenges and demonstrating how Slice can help them compete and grow.

• Navigate complex sales conversations, including multiple products, challenging objections and opportunities requiring a more consultative approach.

• Partner with US Territory Managers to progress difficult-to-convert opportunities and develop approaches that help move deals forward.

• Work closely with Onboarding, Account Management and Support to ensure smooth handoffs and a positive experience for new restaurant partners.

• Consistently meet or exceed sales targets, setting a strong example through individual performance, pipeline management and CRM accuracy.

• Share sales techniques, product knowledge and objection-handling approaches with newer reps, helping them develop and improve.

• Bring feedback and ideas to Sales leadership on customer needs, recurring objections and opportunities to improve our sales processes and tools.

The Team

You'll report to an Inside Sales Manager and be part of our multinational Inside Sales team, working together to bring Slice's products and services to independent restaurants across the United States.

You'll work on the same core sales opportunities as the wider team, while using your experience to take on more challenging deals when needed. You'll also play an important role in supporting newer colleagues, sharing your knowledge and helping the wider team succeed.

Where and when you'll work

• This is a full-time, office-based role in Skopje or Pristina.

• You'll work US hours, about 4pm to midnight local time, Monday to Friday.

• Because of these hours, other work or study must not clash with your schedule.

What you'll earn

• Competitive OTE + uncapped commission

• Night-hour supplement of [amount].

• Paid training from day one.

The Winning Recipe

• 5+ years of quota-carrying inside sales experience, closing deals by phone (ideally B2B), with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targets.

• A track record we can verify. Be ready to share your quota attainment for the last four quarters.

• Fluent spoken English. You'll be on the phone with US restaurant owners every day, and we'll assess this in the interview.

• Strong sales skills, with the confidence to handle challenging objections, build relationships and close deals.

• Experience managing more complex sales opportunities, ideally involving multiple products or a consultative sales approach.

• Experience coaching, mentoring or supporting other sales reps, without necessarily having formal people management responsibilities.

• Strong product knowledge and the ability to understand and communicate the value of different solutions to customers.

• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to lead complex conversations and influence different stakeholders.

• Strong pipeline management and CRM discipline, with accurate forecasting and follow-up.

• Comfortable working independently, taking ownership of challenging opportunities and finding creative ways to move deals forward.

• A proactive, goal-oriented mindset, with the resilience and adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced sales environment.

• Coachable and open to feedback, with a genuine interest in continuing to develop your own skills while helping others improve.

Nice to Have

• Experience selling to small businesses or within the restaurant technology industry.

• Experience working with field sales or territory management teams.

• Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM.

• Spanish language skills.

Our interview process

• Four stages: a recruiter screen, a hiring manager interview, a skills assessment (a live pitch and a short coaching exercise) and a final interview with sales leadership.

• We aim to move quickly and keep you updated at every stage.

The Extras

Working at Slice means more than a job - it's a place where your growth actually gets invested in.

• Paid training from day one - we invest in your success from the start with fully paid on-the-job training

• Career growth that's real - clear paths to grow within your team and across the organization, backed by close coaching from team leads and trainers

• Learning & Development program - because your skills should keep growing long after onboarding

• Referral program - help us grow the team and get rewarded for it

• Wellbeing program - a dedicated wellness stipend for your physical and mental health

• Competitive salary - plus night hour supplements and extra payments

• A team that knows how to have fun - ping pong tournaments, Pizza Fridays, and summer parties are just part of the package

Pizza brings people together. Slice is no different. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and embrace a diversity of backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law.

You will own the JavaScript layer in EuroOffice, setting the bar for code architecture, loading and rendering performance, and deep bug investigation. In this role, AI is not a separate specialty, but a core working method woven into how you build, debug, and refine software.

• Coding Excellence: Write and review clean, well-architected JavaScript/TypeScript with sound state management, creating code that both engineers and AI models can easily reason about.

• Bug Research: Trace and resolve complex, non-obvious issues across large and partially undocumented codebases.

Core Requirements

• Expertise in Modern JS/TS: High standards for code quality, architectural integrity, and browser performance (rendering pipeline, profiling via DevTools/Lighthouse).

• English Fluency: English domain for daily technical communication and team collaboration.

• Debugging & Legacy Navigation: Comfort working with complex, legacy code and pursuing non-linear bug investigations to resolution.

• Bonus: Familiarity with Canvas or WebGL.

jobs.title: Driver Partner Experience Executive
jobs.description:
Your role at Veezu:

As a Driver Partner Experience Executive, you will be responsible for the day-to-day interaction with Driver Partners, working closely with Veezu Services and Veezu Assist and using the Driver Partner Portal as the primary communication tool. Reporting into the Regional Operations Manager, you will be expected to ensure a high level of service and efficiency  is maintained and executed.

Who are Veezu?

Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!

What you’ll do:

RESPONSIBILITIES - DRIVER PARTNER INTERACTION

 - Champion a “best customer service approach” to Driver Partners.

 - Be the face of Veezu for Driver Partners, being available at the Hub to engage in face-to-face interaction with DPs regarding any issues related to their engagement with VSL.  This will include supporting DPs with the uploading of documents to the Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent) when either dealing with new DP engagement or dealing with documentation renewal or changes for existing DPs

 - Provide on the ground support to ensure any new DP attraction campaigns launched are effective and successful.

 - Actively identify DP cohorts based on their utilisation of the system to increase their usage through customer service delivery and implement all DP incentives as instructed by VSL.

 - Be the local point of contact for DPs where queries / matters cannot be addressed via the Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent) or where face-to-face contact is required or requested. (e.g. supporting with relevant document uploads, accessing the Driver App and the Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent), handling complaints).

 - Collaborate with Veezu Assist to increase utilisation of hire vehicles by providing face-to-face support for hire vehicles hand over. This may include the movement of any vehicles as and when necessary and ensuring that hire vehicles are visually checked prior to being issued to Driver Partners and upon their return.

 - Promote the use and functionality of the Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent), knowing how and when to use by and on behalf of DPs.

 - Manage, respond and action all relevant tickets issued via Intercom in a timely manner.

 - Be a champion of the Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent).

RESPONSIBILITIES - VEEZU SERVICES INTERACTION

 - Process and maintain the weekly administration documentation for Veezu Services, informing the Veezu Services Team of any necessary local Operator credits to Driver Partner weekly access fee sheets via the Veezu Portal.

 - Respond to Intercom tickets allocated to you in a timely manner.

 - Identify potential development and/or improvement elements within our Journey Booking System, Driver Partner App, Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent), Consumer App and or any other tech product used by Driver Partners or for the benefit of Driver Partners.  In so doing, raising a ticket on Intercom  wherever relevant and in order for your query or suggestion to be reviewed, resolved and closed appropriately. Continually provide recommendations that are capable of improving service delivery outcomes.

 - Support the Regional Operations Manager with identifying and informing VSL on any DP marketing campaign needs.



LICENSING

 - Investigate and where relevant, assist in complaints received about DPs from passengers, members of the public, local authorities and from other DPs, escalating to the Regional Operations Manager where appropriate.  In so doing, ensuring full compliance with the relevant process, tracking and reporting measures in place.

 - Assist with the careful monitoring, identification and follow up of any ongoing investigation in relation to potential DP issues of concern (e.g. licensing concerns, fraud and / or confirmed cases of fraud).

 - Engage with other Veezu Teams (including but not limited to Veezu Central Compliance, Veezu Legal & Licensing where necessary to ensure full collaboration and communication for the benefit of best customer service to the Driver Partner and compliance of Veezu’s licensing obligations.

ANCILLARY PRODUCTS

 - Subject to any Financial Conduct Authority restrictions, work closely with Veezu Assist to inform, promote and upsell ancillary products & services to DPs in a professional manner. Where any products are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, understand what your responsibilities are.



REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT

 - Where necessary, identify regional events and assist with planning activities that would result in an increased supply of bookings and an increased demand for DPs.

 - Support with acquisition growth by assisting the Regional Operations Manager with integrating any new businesses into the region.

GENERAL COMPLIANCE

 - Understand the Local Licensing PHO, PHD and PHV licensing conditions applicable to the area in which you are based, and keep abreast of any updates in conditions or legislation applicable to Veezu’s PHO status.

 - Understand the Veezu Safety First approach and behave accordingly.

 - Understand the Veezu Data Principles and behave accordingly.

 - Understand the Driver Partner and Passenger Terms & Conditions.

 - Undertake all mandatory training.

 - Maintain information security to a recognised required standard in line with business needs.

 - You are committed to maintaining our ISO27001 certification and set high standards for Information Security compliance.

 - Follow information security policies and procedures.

 - Ensure legal and contractual compliance.

 

What you’ll need:

 - Exceptional attention to detail and organisation skills

 - Excellent communication skills both written and verbally

 - Ability to multitask and prioritise numerous conflicting priorities

 - Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills

 - Highly organised and methodical

 - Excellent Customer Service skills with calm and professional approach

Where you’ll be:

 - This role will be based out of our Huntingdon office.

 - This role will be fully on-site

jobs.title: High School: Special Education, Aide (ABA certification needed) - Greater Boston (2026-2027)
jobs.description:
KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School is looking for committed, compassionate, and culturally competent Aides who have the power to amplify our children’s potential by contributing to creating a school experience that affirms, values, and challenges students each day. KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School Aides work with students who require additional support in order to be successful in the classroom. The Aide works collectively with teachers, school leaders, students, and family members to meet the needs of our students, ensuring their social and academic growth as they gain the skills needed to excel in school and beyond. Aides are crucial in the growth and success of the students on their caseload and work collaboratively with the Lead Teacher to ensure that all students engage in instruction at a level that is rigorous and accessible. Together, we seek to create a professional and authentic environment of joy, excellence, care, and community where educators make long term transformative outcomes for students.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Classroom Responsibilities

• Guide and assist individual students (1:1 support) and/or group of students with the requisite attention needed, which is separate from the general class
• Under the direction of the Lead Teacher and/or Supervisor, complement classroom instruction to help maximize the learning opportunities for students on a caseload including, but not limited to:Assist classroom teachers in creating curriculum modifications for specific studentsProvide support to Lead Teachers, Residents, and/or Fellows by carrying out lesson plans and assisting with learning materialsProvide testing accommodations, including supervising students completing tests in a separate location or during an extended timeReview and correct student work assignmentsAssist in the implementation of behavioral intervention plans which may involve use of positive reinforcement strategies, behavior modification, and other skills or knowledge to ensure safety and success for individual studentsAssist individual students with self-advocacy about particular needs while in the classroomFacilitate and support social interactions and foster the development of positive relationships between students on the caseload and their peers and teachersConstantly assess progress, communicate results clearly, and use data to inform decisions and set goalsFollow and record data for prescribed toilet training protocols as necessaryCollect, record, and summarize data on observable student behaviorMaintain student confidentiality (in consultation with Board Certified Behavior Analyst, as required)Attend staff professional development sessions, special education team meetings, IEP meetings, and grade level team meetings
• May physically assist with physical needs of students, as needed

School and Professional Responsibilities

• Obtain required requirements for an Aide within one year of hire, which includes one of the following:Associate’s Degree OR48 college credit hours ORPass the ParaPro Assessment with a score of 464 with study resources and support from KIPP MA
• Provide aide coverage and support to other classrooms and grade levels as needed
• Be available for an extended workday, as needed, to support colleagues, students, and families outside of school hours
• Perform necessary support duties including, but not limited to, coverage, bus, lunch, and dismissal duties
• Collaborate with grade level teams to provide support, guidance, and advocacy concerning the students on the caseload
• Utilize safe and appropriate handling procedures when working with students including becoming trained in crisis prevention and nonviolent intervention
• Dependable attendance according to our school calendar

Regional Responsibilities

• Embody KIPP MA’s Code of Conduct by acting with integrity, leading with humanity, centering self-awareness and critical consciousness, taking personal responsibility, and engaging productively
• Participate and engage in regional professional development and community events as required
• Demonstrated ability to collect and interpret data, evaluate, reason, define problems, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and make reasonable judgments and decisions in a timely manner in accordance with the needs of the school
• Self-awareness, flexibility and emotional intelligence to navigate a setting with students who express diverse needs
• The consistent use of interpersonal and self-management skills to effectively support behavioral and emotional needs of students to ensure a safe and inclusive environment, as well as build relationships and manage conflict with students, staff, and caregivers
• Effective communication skills to perform assigned duties and to meaningfully exchange information with students, staff, families and others in person, through written communication, in front of groups, and on virtual platforms
• Physical mobility to move self in various positions in order to execute duties effectively, which may include kneeling, walking, pushing/pulling, squatting, twisting, turning, bending, stooping and reaching overhead
• Physical strength sufficient to periodically lift and/or carry 20 pounds of materials or supplies and to physically restrain a student to keep from harming themself and/or others in an emergency situation
• Manual dexterity sufficient to perform repetitive hand/wrist/arm motions and to operate a computer and office equipment

KIPP MA aides are supported in their demanding work by experienced and dedicated leadership and staff who have themselves proven successful in the teaching role. Our leaders maintain consistent school-wide systems and procedures - academic, behavioral, cultural, logistical - designed to permit aides to do their best work.

In addition to the responsibilities listed above, there will occasionally be other duties as assigned that aides will engage in to help promote a positive and safe learning environment and culture.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Deep alignment with KIPP MA’s mission and values, including the unwavering belief in the high potential of all students
• Demonstrated ability to drive student growth and achievement and to create a warm, inclusive, rigorous learning environment (preferred)
• Possess an Associate’s Degree OR have completed 48 college credit hours OR pass the ParaPro Assessment with a score of at least 464 within a year of hire
• Experience and/or training in proper physical/tactical restraint procedure (preferred)
• Experience and/or training in proper ABA techniques for student support (preferred)
• Computer literacy and baseline familiarity with Google Suite
• Pass Criminal Background Checks

KIPP MA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in building a vibrant and welcoming school community that advances our mission of ensuring that all KIPP students graduate with the skills and confidence to lead fulfilling lives. This includes a commitment to attracting and developing individuals who understand the experiences of the students and communities we serve. We hire without consideration to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

The minimum base salary for this exempt position is $37,000 to $50,000 (per 1.0 FTE/45 hours per week). The role includes a $1,000 signing bonus—and an annual $2,000 retention bonus in subsequent years, as well as other bonuses, when eligible. This role follows our School Year calendar. For more about what we offer, how to apply and more about KIPP MA, please visit this link HERE.

jobs.description:

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

Hiring Process Stages

The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

• Application

• Interview with Recruiter

• Tech Screening

• Technical Interviews with Data Team

• Offer

About our Head of Data & AI

Join our Data Science team and become a key part of our product squads, delivering features that enrich our product and uphold the first-class experience we're known for. As a Head, you will balance hands-on technical work with managerial responsibilities, having the opportunity to make a significant impact through both technical excellence and strategic leadership. You will drive high-impact projects, mentor team members, and play a crucial role in shaping the technical direction of our data science and machine learning solutions.

On top of being a great Head of Data & AI, we expect you to:

• Manage a team of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers, fostering a high-performance culture and continuously raising the bar for technical excellence.

• Act as a technical reference for the team, architecting, developing, and deploying machine learning systems to production when needed.

• Discuss business requirements with Product Managers and other senior leaders to align data strategy with business goals.

• Guide the team in designing and executing experiments, ensuring robust analysis of structured and unstructured data to improve current models.

• Focus on recruiting great talent and helping them grow through regular performance feedback and development opportunities.

• Set clear goals and objectives for the team and ensure they are aligned with the overall business objectives.

• Advocate for the value of data and AI within the organization and foster a data-driven culture.

What we are looking for:

• You have a proven track record of leading teams and managing careers within the data field for at least 4 to 5 years.

• Deep understanding of machine learning concepts, including regression, classification, clustering, neural networks, cross-validation, and model explainability.

• Strong knowledge of probability and statistics, including experimental design, optimization, and causal inference for A/B testing.

• Solid understanding of the engineering challenges required to deploy and maintain machine learning systems in production.

• Proficiency in Python and experience with software engineering best practices.

You'll stand out if you:

• Have experience building solutions with Large Language Models (RAG, fine-tuning) and developing AI agents or agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain).

• Hold an MSc. or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, or a relevant technical field.

• Have solid experience with Deep Learning and NLP techniques.

• Have experience working in fast-growing startups or high-tech companies.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.

jobs.description:
Credit & Accounts Receivable Analyst

Triumvirate Environmental, one of the largest environmental services firms in North America, is seeking a Credit and Accounts Receivable Analyst for our Finance team.

This communicative and data-driven individual will be responsible for evaluating the financial health and creditworthiness of Triumvirate and its stakeholders to help the business make informed decisions.

Triumvirate Environmental provides leading organizations in the higher education, life sciences, healthcare, and advanced manufacturing sectors with diverse services and expertise to assist them with compliance management. At Triumvirate Environmental, we strive to WOW both our employees and our customers. Our unique culture fosters growth, development, education, and creativity.

This position reports to The Vice President of Finance. This position will be fully onsite for the first 90 days. After 90 days, the position will follow a hybrid schedule approved by the manager and Human Resources.

Responsibilities:

• Credit Assessment: Evaluate the creditworthiness of new and existing clients using a variety of tools, including credit reports, financial statements, and relevant data to assess risk and determine appropriate credit limits.

• Client Account Monitoring: Continuously monitor client accounts for changes in financial health or credit risk. Track payment history, review account status, and ensure that credit terms are adhered to.

• Credit Reporting: Prepare and present regular reports on credit risk, outstanding balances, and payment trends to senior management, providing actionable insights and recommendations for credit management strategies.

• Risk Mitigation: Identify and flag potentially risky clients or accounts, and work proactively to mitigate the risk through improved credit terms, collections efforts, or adjustments to credit limits as necessary.

• Client Communication: Serve as a point of contact for clients on credit-related issues.

• Accurate Record Keeping:

• Maintain detailed and accurate records of client credit history, decisions, and communications. Use data to monitor trends and make informed decisions on credit policies and practices.

• Policy Adherence: Ensure all credit decisions align with company credit policies and industry regulations. Assist in reviewing and updating company credit policies and procedures as needed.

• Collaboration with Other Departments: Work closely with sales, finance, and customer service teams to ensure that credit assessments align with business goals and that any credit issues are handled promptly and effectively. Effectively communicate potential client credit issues with internal stakeholders.

Basic Requirements:

• Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Account, Business Administration, or a related field.

• At least 2-4 years of experience in a credit-related role, such as credit analysis, collections, or financial services.

• Business to Business (B2B) experience.

• Strong understanding of credit analysis techniques and financial statement analysis.

• Proficiency with credit assessment software and Microsoft Excel.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly convey complex information to clients and stakeholders.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to identify trends or irregularities in client accounts.

• Good problem-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations with clients and internal stakeholders professionally.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to make sound judgments based on data.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

• Must be eligible to work in the United States without future sponsorship

• Must have a reliable form of transportation

Preferred Requirements:

• Relevant certifications (e.g., credit risk certification) are a plus.

• Proficiency with Oracle software

jobs.title: Sr. Training and Technical Assistance Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT ZERO TO THREE

Founded in 1977, ZERO TO THREE works to ensure that babies and toddlers benefit from the early connections that are critical to their well-being and development. Our mission is to ensure that all babies and toddlers have a strong start in life. At ZERO TO THREE, we envision a society with the knowledge and will to support all infants and toddlers in reaching their full potential. Our Core Values Statement: We believe that how we do our work is as important as what we do. To learn more about ZERO TO THREE, please visit our website at zerotothree.org.

SUMMARY

The Sr. Training and Technical Assistance (T/TA) Specialist will provide training and technical assistance to Head Start/Early Head Start regional TA specialists, Head Start (HS)/Early Head Start (EHS) and Child Care programs on content related to a wide range of areas focused on birth to five child development and effective teaching and home visiting practices in early childhood settings. This position will support elevate NCECDTL’s efforts to identify, develop, and promote the implementation of evidence-based and culturally and linguistically responsive practices for across center-based, family childcare, and home-based early childhood programs and settings, including practices that are responsive to American Indian and Alaska Native (AIAN) communities, and practices that prevent and address child incidents through an education lens.

Specifically, this position will develop and deliver in-person and virtual trainings on implementation of birth to five child development and play-based learning; effective teaching and home visiting practices; adult-child interactions and instructional support; dual language learning; disabilities services; curriculum implementation within the various HS/EHS program options and settings; transitions, including to kindergarten, promotion of secure parent/child relationships and social and emotional foundations of early learning; using data to individualize, improve practice, and enhance quality to ensure progress for all children; early childhood leadership development; and the use of ongoing professional development, Practice-Based Coaching, and reflective supervision to ensure effective practices. This role is funded through September 29, 2027.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Works with Senior Manager, TTA Delivery; Senior Manager of Content Quality, Director of PD; Director of TTA Integration; and Senior Director, Training to meet training and resource development needs around disability services.

• Develops training materials and provides in-person and virtual training and/or subject matter expertise to Head Start/Early Head Start grantees and regional TA specialists, and childcare programs as determined by the Center’s workplan.

• Develops training materials and provides training at national, regional, and service area conferences, institutes, and events as requested.

• Plan, host, and facilitate (or contribute to) national webinars, virtual learning series, office hours, or virtual meetings for identified groups of Head Start staff (e.g. Ed Managers, Home Visitors, Teachers, etc.) or regional TA providers (e.g. Early Childhood Specialists [ECSs]) as requested.

Content and Resource Development

• Contributes subject matter expertise to the development of new resources, Early Education Pathways courses, and technology innovations.

• Participates in the life cycle review and update of existing DTL courses on Early Education Pathways.

• Supports the review and update of DTL content on HeadStart.gov.

Quality, Collaboration, and Responsiveness

• Participates in various cross-functional teams and workgroups, as requested, to support day-to-day operations of the national center and address OHS priorities.

• Performs other duties as assigned for the purpose of ensuring the efficient and effective functioning of the department.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a Head Start or Early Head Start program or in a Head Start regional TA position with linkages to a program with a home-based option.

• Deep knowledge and experience with Head Start populations including those families that seek home visiting services and socializations.

• Ability to deliver TTA in face-to-face, as well as, virtual settings.

• Deep knowledge of early childhood development from birth to five and effective teaching and/or home visiting practices.

• Deep knowledge of disabilities services for children birth to five, including IDEA Part B and Part C, early intervention and special education partnerships, and individualized supports that help children with disabilities fully participate in Head Start/Early Head Start settings.

• Deep knowledge of preventing and responding to child incidents in center-based, family child care, and home-based settings.

• Strong knowledge of Practice-Based Coaching training and support.

• Strong knowledge of CLASS Pre-K observation tool and other program, teacher and child-level assessment tools commonly used in early childhood programs.

• Strong knowledge of social and emotional foundations for early learning training and support.

• Strong knowledge of adult-child and parent-child relationships, and the selection and implementation of curricula in early childhood settings.

• Extensive experience with organizing, developing and providing training and technical assistance resources to a variety of audiences.

• Experience designing and facilitating learning communities, cohorts, or communities of practice, including virtual and hybrid formats, and training trainers (TOT).

• Strong knowledge of Head Start/Early Head Start programming, the Head Start Program Performance Standards, Head Start Early Learning Outcomes Framework, and HS technical assistance resources.

• Comfort and/or experience with technology innovation and instructional design, including online course development, accessible web content, and AI-assisted content development tools

• Knowledge of and experience with inclusion and disabilities services in Head Start/Early Head Start, including the Head Start Program Performance Standards on disabilities, IDEA Part B and Part C, and evidence-based practices for including children with disabilities in center-based and home-based settings preferred.

• Excellent conceptual, written and oral skills;

• Ability to work collaboratively within a team as well as independently;

• Strong oral, written and computer skills;

• Strong interpersonal skills; and

• Ability to read, analyze and interpret complex documents and

• Ability to collect, organize, analyze, and display various types of data.

• Reliable CLASS Pre-K observer preferred.

EDUCATION

While a minimum of a Master’s degree in Early Childhood or related field is preferred, robust experience will be valued, considered, and accepted in place of academic credentials.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

This position's salary is estimated to be mid $80,000s to ~$100,000 depending on experience, geo-location, budget, and other comparable and similarly scoped internal positions. In addition to salary, ZERO TO THREE offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, HRA, retirement contributions, generous leave benefits and more.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is frequently required to use finger dexterity and sufficient hand dexterity to use a computer keyboard and be capable of reading a computer screen. Also, they may need to remain seated for extended periods, can perform repetitive motions, and reach for objects. An employee is frequently required to hold a writing instrument, communicate verbally, and hear well enough to detect nuances and receive detailed information. They may be required to grasp objects, push, and pull objects, bend, stand, walk, squat, or kneel. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision for data preparation or analysis, and expansive reading. May need to lift up to 30 pounds.

ESSENTIAL QUALITIES

• Encourages and practices critical thinking

• Is self-reflective and empathic

• Recognizes the influence of workplace relationships on outcomes and results

• Maintains a respectful and accepting approach to others

• Awareness of the influence of the larger context on individual behavior

• Collaboratively and creatively supports the work efforts of colleagues at all levels and in all areas of the organization

WORKING CONDITIONS

The work conditions described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing this job. Depending on work location, the incumbent will typically work indoors in a heated and air-conditioned office, with a mixture of natural, incandescent, and fluorescent light with low to moderate noise levels or be subject to working conditions conducive to a home environment. When travel is expected, the incumbent will be exposed to outside environmental conditions during those times.

ZERO TO THREE is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer of Minorities, Women, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.

Due to the high volume of applications, we are not able to provide individual feedback to candidates regarding the status of their application. If selected to move forward in the process, someone from the hiring team will contact you regarding next steps.

📍 Central DuPage Hospital

📍 Delnor Hospital

📍 Kishwaukee Hospital

📍 Valley West Hospital

This specialized nursing role provides compassionate, trauma-informed medical forensic care to patients following sexual assault.

The Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner (SANE) reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• The SANE (Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner) is a registered professional nurse who provides exemplary specialized, trauma-informed medical forensic services to all individuals who presents with a complaint or concern of sexual assault. These services will be prompt, non-judgmental and compassionate while encouraging autonomy and reducing psychological trauma. The medical forensic services may include a medical forensic exam and evidence collection, counseling for emergency contraception, prophylactic treatment for sexually transmitted infections, photo documentation, and referrals for appropriate medical and psychological follow-up, support and participation in legal proceedings.

Responsibilities:

• Acts autonomously following the professional standards as outlined by the Sexual Assault Survivors Emergency Treatment Act (SASETA), the Illinois Nurse Practice Act, the International Association of Forensic Nurses Scope and Standards of Practice, and unit specific protocols appropriate to the patient population served.
• Works collaboratively with the interdisciplinary team, including SANE coordinator, providers, imaging and therapeutic services to facilitate care of sexual assault survivor.
• Maintains documentation standards with accurate, timely and complete recording and reporting to ensure compliance with SASETA.
• Maintains appropriate survivor privacy and chain of custody for all evidence collected, including Illinois State Police Evidence Collection Kit (ISPECK).
• Remains up to date on current regulatory and legislative guidelines related to treatment and documentation standards for sexual assault survivors.
• Educates survivors and their families to meet their emotional and healthcare needs to aid in the recovery process.
• Performs assigned work safely, adhering to established departmental safety rules and practices, reports to supervisor, in a timely manner, any unsafe activities, conditions, hazards, or safety violations that may cause injury to oneself, other employees, patients and/or visitors.
• Testifies in court as a fact witness and/or expert and assists other SANEs in preparing for court proceedings.
• Provides a learning atmosphere by sharing knowledge with coworkers; participates in orientation of new staff by providing content relevant to caring for sexual assault survivors.
• Supports continuous quality improvement efforts designed to enhance patient outcomes, increase patient satisfaction, and improve the overall care of sexual assault survivors
• Ensures professional growth and development by participating in and utilizing current evidence-based information and keeping current with standards in Forensic and SANE nursing practice.
• Maintains required medical and forensic continuing education requirements per current regulatory or legislative guidelines.
• Participates in goal setting, program development and evaluation of the regional and system-wide SANE programs.
• Attends monthly SANE meetings and participates in peer review.

Required:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) or Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role OR Master’s degree from an accredited school/college of nursing and Advance Practice Registered Nurse (IL) license
• Current Illinois Licensure as a Registered Nurse in good standing
• BLS certification upon hire
• Completion of the IL SANE Clinical Training Program within 1 year of hireCompletion of an International Association of Forensic Nursing (IAFN) approved 40-hour didactic classCompletion of the IL SANE Clinical Training Log

Preferred:

• Adult/Adolescent SANE or Pediatric/Adolescent SANE
• Certified SANE-A or Certified SANE-P
• ACLS Certification
• TNCC or TNS
• PALS

jobs.title: Communications Lead
jobs.description:
About Tribe AI 

Tribe AI helps enterprises put frontier AI into production. We work alongside the leading AI labs and their field teams to design, build and ship real systems for our customers. The work is new, technical and moving fast, and the stories coming out of it are some of the most interesting in enterprise tech. We need someone to tell them.

The role 

You will shape how Tribe shows up in the world. You will be our CEO's external voice and narrative partner: ghostwriting, booking media, building the story and making sure the right people hear it. You'll turn frontier-AI delivery work into stories that land with enterprise buyers, our partner ecosystem and the wider market. This is a lean function, and you will help us build it. You won't inherit a playbook or a big team.

What you'll do

 - Own the narrative. Define how Tribe talks about itself and about enterprise AI, and keep that story sharp and consistent across press, partners and our own channels.

 - Prepare our CEO for the spotlight. Prepare and brief our CEO for interviews, panels and podcasts, and help shape bylines, LinkedIn posts and keynote talks.

 - Run media relations. Use your existing relationships with enterprise and AI tech journalists to get Tribe into the conversations that matter. Pitch stories, not funding announcements.

 - Support partner communications. Work with the Partnerships team to produce joint stories and announcements with the AI labs and platforms we build on.

 - Find the story in the work. Partner with our marketing team, GMs and delivery teams to pull credible, specific stories out of customer engagements, and turn technical work into narratives an enterprise buyer understands.

 - Build the function. Set up the processes, calendar, measurement and any agency or freelance support that comms needs as Tribe grows.

What we're looking for

 - 7–12 years in communications, PR or journalism, with a focus on B2B, enterprise or AI tech.

 - Warm relationships with tech press: you know reporters and editors at outlets like The Information, TechCrunch, VentureBeat, Bloomberg, Forbes or WSJ Tech, and they take your calls. Cold pitching shouldn't be your main tool.

 - You've shaped external communications for a technical or AI company and can explain complex technical work clearly and credibly.

 - You've worked directly with founders or C-suite executives on their personal visibility and thought leadership.

 - A strong written voice: clear, credible and distinct. You can write as someone else and sound like them.

 - Confidence and presence. You're comfortable in the room with executives, journalists and partners, and you have opinions.

 - You like to build. You've thrived in an early-stage or small team without much structure.

Nice to Haves

 - You've been a journalist (reporter or editor) covering enterprise tech or AI and now want to work in-house.

 - You've built a communications function from scratch.

 - You've worked in AI, SaaS or professional services and understand the language and concerns of enterprise buyers.

 - You've done partner or co-marketing comms with large platform companies.

Perform and/or oversee a range of industrial hygiene and environmental assignments, including:

• Industrial hygiene assessments, including asbestos, lead-based paint, mold, indoor air quality, and other potential occupational and environmental hazards.
• Exposure assessments and workplace monitoring to evaluate chemical, physical, and biological hazards.
• Development of sampling strategies, exposure-control recommendations, and mitigation plans.
• Environmental investigations and property assessments.
• Interpretation of laboratory and field data and preparation of clear, technically sound reports and recommendations.
• Oversight of remediation, abatement, or corrective-action activities, as appropriate.

jobs.title: Social Worker - Duty and Assessment Team
jobs.description:

• Develop, implement and review Child in Need, Child Protection and Safety Plans.

• Ensure children's wishes, feelings, voices and lived experiences are central to all assessments and decision-making.

• Maintain accurate, timely and analytical case records.

• Prepare high-quality assessments, reports, care plans and chronologies.

• Complete statutory visits, contacts and recordings within required timescales.

• Manage a varied and complex caseload, prioritising work according to risk and need.

• Work collaboratively with children, families and multi-agency professionals.

• Participate in supervision, team meetings, audits and quality assurance activities.

• Promote equality, diversity and inclusion throughout all aspects of practice.

Benefits:

• Competitive Payrate

• Hybrid working available

• Supportive team

Qualifications & Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have,

• Social Work England registration

• Eligible to work in the UK

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.
