jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Database Optimization
jobs.description:
About CAST AI

CAST AI is an automation platform that optimises cloud and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, CAST AI continuously improves performance, reliability and efficiency in production.

More than 2,100 companies already rely on CAST AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, Hugging Face, NielsenIQ, Swisscom and TGS.

CAST AI operates across 34 countries and has a remote-first culture built around small, highly technical teams. In January 2026, the company achieved unicorn status following a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, bringing its valuation above $1 billion.

About the role

Databases are still managed manually. Engineers monitor slow queries, decide which indexes to add, tune connection limits and introduce caching, often without being able to prove whether those changes will improve performance in production.

CAST AI is building an autonomous database administrator that can identify problems, recommend improvements and validate that those improvements work before customers rely on them.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Database Optimisation team, you will work across two core components:

• Database Gateway: A high-performance Rust proxy that sits in front of customer databases and provides capabilities such as rate limiting and caching without requiring application changes.

• Database Agent: A Go-based service that analyses database workloads and produces recommendations such as index suggestions and query improvements.

The focus is not simply producing recommendations. Every recommendation needs to be reliable and validated. A stale read, incorrect cache decision or poor index suggestion can affect a customer’s production system, so correctness is central to the role.

You will help shape the architecture, technical direction and roadmap of the autonomous DBA product.

What you will do

• Design, build and operate the Database Gateway.

• Develop high-performance services in Go and Rust.

• Work on database caching, rate limiting and other gateway capabilities.

• Build the Database Agent’s recommendation engine.

• Develop systems for index suggestions, query analysis and query improvements.

• Work on cache invalidation and data consistency, where correctness is critical.

• Create methods for safely validating database recommendations before they are applied.

• Debug complex production issues across the gateway, agent and underlying database systems.

• Analyse database performance, query behaviour and workload patterns.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams on problems without established solutions.

• Contribute to product direction, technical decisions and the engineering roadmap.

• Help shape the next generation of automated database administration.

What we are looking for

• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including clean abstractions and maintainable code.

• Professional experience building production services in Go.

• In-depth knowledge of PostgreSQL or MySQL.

• Understanding of how database clients, drivers and wire protocols work.

• Strong debugging, optimisation and performance-tuning skills.

• Experience with query profiling, index design and database tuning beyond ORM usage.

• Experience taking a complex technical project from design through to production.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• A proactive and adaptable approach to working in a fast-moving environment.

• Comfort working with ambiguity and contributing to technical direction.

Nice to have

• Rust experience, particularly with high-performance network services or proxies.

• Experience building or extending database proxies, gateways or poolers.

• Experience designing cache invalidation strategies at scale.

• Experience with index recommendation, query-plan analysis or query optimisation tooling.

• Experience validating technical changes through workload replay, shadow traffic or benchmarking.

• Production experience with Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry.

• Experience working with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

Technology

• Go and Rust

• PostgreSQL and MySQL

• Kubernetes

• AWS, GCP and Azure

• Terraform

• gRPC and REST

• Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo and VictoriaMetrics

• GitLab CI and Argo CD

What we offer

• €6,500 to €9,000 gross per month, depending on experience and level

• Remote-first work environment

• Equity options

• Global team of cloud and infrastructure specialists

• Fast feedback and short delivery cycles, with many feature projects completed within one to four weeks

• 10% of working time for personal projects or professional development

• Annual learning budget, including conferences and courses

• Annual hackathon

• Team-building budget and company events

• Equipment budget

• Additional days off

Hiring process

• Recruiter screening call

• Hiring Manager interview

• Technical system design interview

• Live coding interview

• Executive culture interview

A background check may be conducted at the final stage through our third-party provider, Checkr.

CAST AI does not provide visa sponsorship or work permits for this position.

This opportunity is currently open to candidates residing in:

Bulgaria, Croatia, Estonia, Greece, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia and Ukraine.

jobs.title: Shipping Agent
jobs.description:
Our Story

At Adorama Rental Company, we are dedicated to empowering creators by working hand-in-hand to help them bring their vision to life—and beyond. As a trusted partner to the cinema community, we provide the tools, technical expertise, and innovative solutions that make the impossible possible.

• Growth Mindset: We set high standards, embrace failure, and are open to change.

• Be Customer-Centered: We focus on the end-to-end customer experience.

• Take Ownership & Dig Deeper: We are proactive, use data, and avoid shortcuts.

• Think Like a Start-Up: We move fast, stay flexible, and celebrate every win.

• Be Humble & Respectful: We assume positive intent, listen actively, and support one another.

What You'll Do

The front counter Shipping Agent is responsible for providing excellent customer service while supporting the daily operations of a busy cinema camera and lighting rental house.

This position serves as one of the main points of contact for clients picking up and returning rental equipment. The employee will also assist with curbside deliveries, outgoing shipments, incoming packages, and general warehouse coordination.

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, customer-service oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced production rental environment where accuracy, communication, and efficiency are essential.

Key Responsibilities

Front Counter / Customer Service

• Greet and assist clients picking up and returning rental equipment.

• Verify client information, rental orders, and equipment paperwork.

• Coordinate with prep, returns, and warehouse departments to ensure equipment is ready for pickup.

• Maintain a professional and welcoming front counter environment.

• Communicate delays, order changes, and client requests to the department leads.

• Ensure clients receive accurate paperwork and understand pickup and return procedures.

Curbside Operations

• Coordinate curbside pickups and returns for clients.

• Communicate with warehouse and prep teams to have orders staged and ready.

• Assist clients with loading and unloading equipment when necessary.

• Quick returning and label all inbound orders.

• Ensure all equipment leaving the building is properly documented.

• Maintain an organized and efficient curbside area.

• Notify the appropriate department of any discrepancies or last-minute changes.

Shipping & Receiving

• Prepare outgoing shipments for domestic and international clients.

• Package camera, lighting, grip, and production equipment securely.

• Generate shipping labels and coordinate pickups with carriers.

• Track shipments and communicate tracking information to the appropriate departments and clients.

• Receive incoming packages and verify contents against shipping documents.

• Ensure shipments are processed accurately and on schedule.

• Maintain an organized shipping and receiving area.

General Operations Support

• Assist the warehouse, prep, and return departments when needed.

• Maintain cleanliness and organization around the front counter and shipping areas.

• Follow company procedures for equipment handling and documentation.

• Communicate effectively with department leads and management.

• Help maintain a professional and efficient workflow throughout the facility.

• Perform additional operational duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

• Previous customer service, warehouse, shipping, or rental house experience preferred.

• Familiarity with the film, television, or production industry is a plus.

• Strong organizational and communication skills.

• Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

• Basic computer skills and familiarity with shipping platforms.

• Ability to safely lift and move production equipment.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

This is a hands-on role in a professional cinema rental environment. The position may involve lifting and moving equipment, working flexible hours around production schedules, and occasionally assisting with early-morning, late-night, or weekend rentals.

Ready to Join Our Team of Creators? Apply today and let’s create something extraordinary together.

Pay range for this role:

$19—$20 USD

jobs.title: Especialista em Performance de Sustentabilidade
jobs.description:
Liderar e implementar projetos que promovam os objetivos de Sustentabilidade, Impacto Positivo e ESG (Ambiental, Social e de Governação) do Standard Bank Angola. Apoiar as Unidades de Negócio e as Funções Corporativas na integração dos princípios de sustentabilidade nas operações principais da organização. Adicionalmente, recolher informação e desenvolver relatórios de Sustentabilidade e ESG para evidenciar as práticas empresariais responsáveis, reforçando a transparência, a responsabilização e a confiança junto das partes interessadas.

Funções Essenciais

Liderar e gerir projetos e iniciativas de Sustentabilidade e ESG desde a sua conceção até à conclusão, contribuindo para o alcance dos objetivos da organização nesta área.

Apoiar a realização de avaliações de materialidade para identificar os temas de sustentabilidade mais relevantes para o Standard Bank e para as suas partes interessadas.

Desenvolver e implementar estruturas de recolha e validação de dados para garantir informação de sustentabilidade precisa e consistente.

Apoiar a preparação de relatórios de Sustentabilidade e ESG alinhados com normas reconhecidas (por exemplo, GRI, SASB e TCFD).

Colaborar com as Unidades de Negócio e Funções Corporativas para integrar os princípios de sustentabilidade nas operações empresariais.

Realizar benchmarking e análises de lacunas (gap analysis) para identificar pontos fortes e oportunidades de melhoria no reporte de sustentabilidade.

Integrar dados de sustentabilidade nos sistemas e plataformas de reporte existentes, assegurando uma produção de relatórios eficiente.

Apresentar recomendações para melhorar a qualidade dos relatórios, a transparência e o envolvimento das partes interessadas.

Recolher e analisar dados para relatórios de Sustentabilidade e ESG, garantindo a sua exatidão e credibilidade.

Interagir com partes interessadas em diferentes países e jurisdições para obter a informação e os dados necessários para os relatórios.

Envolver stakeholders internos e externos na promoção de iniciativas de sustentabilidade e no desenvolvimento de uma cultura organizacional orientada para a sustentabilidade.

Monitorizar e reportar o progresso das iniciativas de sustentabilidade, assegurando transparência e responsabilização. Utilizar análises baseadas em dados para identificar áreas de melhoria e impulsionar a melhoria contínua das práticas sustentáveis.

Acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e fornecer atualizações regulares às partes interessadas, assegurando transparência e responsabilização relativamente às iniciativas de Sustentabilidade, Impacto Positivo e ESG.

Identificar, avaliar e implementar projetos-piloto ou programas que reforcem a agenda de investigação em sustentabilidade, incluindo a colaboração com especialistas e entidades externas.

Elaborar propostas e planos de práticas empresariais e colaborar com líderes organizacionais e parceiros de negócio em todo o Standard Bank Angola para garantir a sua implementação bem-sucedida.

Assegurar a conformidade com os requisitos regulamentares e as melhores práticas do setor através de revisão e monitorização rigorosas. Implementar processos robustos que garantam que todas as iniciativas de sustentabilidade cumprem os requisitos legais e os referenciais da indústria.

Manter um conhecimento aprofundado dos referenciais e normas de reporte relevantes, aplicando-o para garantir o alinhamento dos relatórios com as melhores práticas.

Tipo de Qualificação: Licenciatura

Área de Formação: Ciências Ambientais, Ciências Sociais

Experiência Requerida

Sustentabilidade(Gestão de Risco)

jobs.title: Engineer
jobs.description:
Engineer:

The Engineer is responsible for maintaining the hotel’s facilities and the building itself in an operational condition. To achieve this, he/she carries out repair and maintenance work personally and arranges/co-ordinates the operational execution of specialized technical work performed by external contractors. This includes requesting quotations, assessing them, obtaining the necessary approvals, and overseeing the work in accordance with the maintenance plan.

What is in it for you:

Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor worldwide

Learning programs through our Academy

Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!

Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities.

What you will be doing:

• Making agreements with internal departments regarding the process for reporting maintenance issues, setting priorities, implementing precautionary measures, and related matters.
• Collecting maintenance requests, determining the nature and complexity of faults or maintenance requirements, establishing the order of work to be carried out, and identifying the materials required.
• Requesting quotations from external contractors and/or ordering the necessary equipment or spare parts in accordance with established procedures.
• Discussing costs and scheduling with the supervisor for larger or more complex projects.
• Informing and coordinating with external service providers regarding the work to be performed.
• Managing inventory, including installation materials, consumables, spare parts, and related supplies.
• Monitoring consumption levels and the frequency of recurring malfunctions, and determining the appropriate stock levels to be maintained.
• Advising management on the quality and suitability of materials to be used in order to extend asset lifespan and reduce maintenance and repair costs.
• Ordering and replenishing inventory items and tools as required.
• Resolving operational issues and handling questions or complaints from internal departments and guests.
• Performing a wide range of repair and maintenance tasks, including minor modifications to electrical and data installations, cable routing, installation of power outlets, and related work.
• Carrying out basic repairs to equipment, sanitary facilities, lighting systems, doors, locks, and fittings, as well as touch-up painting to repair damage. Assisting external contractors with repair and maintenance activities when required.
• Recording the use of materials and resources.
• Maintaining a logbook of completed maintenance and repair activities.

Your experience and skills include:

• Minimum completed MBO Level 3 vocational education. Relevant building maintenance experience is an asset.
• Proficient in standard technical practices in at least two disciplines, such as building maintenance, electrical systems, and gas/water installations, or willing to undertake the necessary training.
• Strong interpersonal and problem solving abilities and highly responsible & reliable.
• Meets the requirements set out in NEN 3140 at the level of Installation Responsible Person (Installatieverantwoordelijke). If not currently qualified, this certification can be obtained through our Academy.

Your team and working environment:

You will join a close-knit Engineering team made up of three Engineers, one Assistant Manager, and one Manager. Together, you will ensure that our property remains in excellent condition by maintaining and enhancing all 644 guest rooms, five meeting rooms, four Food & Beverage outlets, and the surrounding outdoor areas. Every day brings a variety of technical challenges and opportunities to make a visible impact on the guest experience.

And you won't do it for free, even though you love the job.

We offer a starting salary from the Horeca CAO, scale 6. That means if you are working on a fulltime contract, €2.864,- per month. How about that?!

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

jobs.title: Lead Game Designer
jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Define, structure, and drive the overall game design vision in collaboration with the game core team.

• Lead, mentor, and support a team of designers, fostering growth, ownership, knowledge sharing and uphold high-quality design standards.

• Own and manage the design process, including planning, prioritization, and delivery of features and systems

• Balance creative goals with production constraints to support reliable planning and delivery

• Design and oversee gameplay systems, economy and monetization, mechanics, and player progression, ensuring coherence and consistency across the game

• Align design direction across disciplines (programming, art, animation, UX) and communicate vision, decisions, and constraints clearly to stakeholders

• Drive a data-informed, KPI-oriented design approach for a live-f2p (GaaS) environment, leveraging player metrics, business goals and analytics to guide decisions and improvements

• Identify, prototype, and iterate on key features based on playtests, player base and game support feedback, and data insights

• Define and articulate a clear vision for tools, pipelines, and workflows to enhance team efficiency, scalability, and delivery quality, and long-term project sustainability

• Ensure timely delivery aligned with project goals, scope, and quality expectations

• Develop and maintain clear and actionable design documentation

• Support recruitment, onboarding, performance evaluation, and career development of team members

• Create a fun, engaging and outstanding player experience.

EXPERIENCE AND REQUIREMENTS

• Fluent English is mandatory

• Previous proven experience as Senior or Lead Game Designer on F2P, with at least 1 full release cycle on Mobile/F2P including LiveOps.

• Extensive knowledge of F2P mobile gaming industry, staying up to date on trends, game genres, key competitors and best practices.

• Proficient in all aspects of game design such as UX, level design, system design, with a strong acumen on social multiplayer design, economic design, pacing & monetization strategies for F2P games.

• Ability to plan, prioritize, and manage team workload effectively

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data to inform design decisions

• Excellent documentation skills to clearly communicate design intent and ensure team alignment

• Solid understanding of production pipelines, workflows, and development methodologies

• Capable of providing inspiring creative leadership.

• Skillful at complex Excel spreadsheets.

• Ability to take direction and feedback.

• Be a team player: we use agile development methods, where the team members are in permanent contact. An open mind and good communication skills are a must.

• Attention to detail, meticulous, and organized working habits. Ability to multi-task and adapt easily to change.

Bonus

• Prior experience in leading a team.

• Videogames design degree or equivalent.

• Spanish or Catalan is a plus.

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)

• Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
• Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
• Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
• Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
• Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
• 5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
• Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
• Life Insurance with AXA.
• Office Gym open from 7 AM to 8 PM
• Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
• Language training for English, Spanish, and French.
• Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
• Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
• Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).

Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

jobs.description:
Como Sales Advisor, eres la cara amable que recibe a nuestros clientes y encarnas el corazón de nuestra marca. Tendrás la oportunidad de ofrecer un servicio de alto nivel en cada interacción. Desde iniciar conversaciones hasta ayudar en la caja, los probadores y en toda la tienda, desempeñarás un papel vital en mejorar la experiencia de compra.

Tus responsabilidades también incluirán procesar entregas, reponer stock y presentar las últimas prendas en el piso de ventas.

Tu rol es esencial para crear experiencias acogedoras que reflejen lo mejor de nuestra marca. Con calidez y entusiasmo, guiarás a nuestros clientes en su recorrido, ofreciendo asistencia genuina y un servicio proactivo que inspire y motive. Junto con tu equipo, crearás momentos que importan.

Aunque tener experiencia previa en atención al cliente y conocimientos sobre tejidos es valorado, no es obligatorio.

• Orientación al cliente: Te gusta interactuar con personas y estás comprometido/a con ofrecer un excelente servicio.

• Adaptabilidad y flexibilidad: Capacidad para responder a prioridades cambiantes y solicitudes de los clientes.

• Proactividad: Iniciativa para actuar y lograr resultados con calidad.

• Buena comunicación: Interés genuino por las personas, te comunicas con claridad y escuchas activamente para comprender las perspectivas y necesidades de los demás.

• Ganas de aprender: Abierto/a a recibir retroalimentación y siempre buscando oportunidades para crecer y desarrollart.

• Entusiasmo por la marca: Pasión real por nuestra marca y colección, y disfrutas compartir ese entusiasmo con los clientes.

• Disponibilidad horaria: Disposición para trabajar en horarios variados, incluyendo noches y fines de semana.

Deseable pero no obligatorio:

• Conocimiento de operaciones en tienda y habilidades de atención al cliente adquiridas en experiencias previas en retail.
• Seguridad al ofrecer asesoramiento sobre tendencias de moda, materiales, tallas, etc.

• Este es un puesto de jornada parcial con un contrato PERMENENTE de 20 horas semanales. (en 5 días) e incluye fines de semana y turnos disponibles entre las 7.00 y las 21.30

Beneficios:

Estamos comprometidos con apoyar a nuestros empleados con una variedad de beneficios atractivos y oportunidades de desarrollo. Como miembro de nuestro equipo, disfrutarás de un 25% de descuento en todas las marcas del Grupo H&M, tanto en tienda como online. Además, todos los empleados participan en nuestro Programa de Incentivos H&M (HIP), diseñado para recompensar tus contribuciones y apoyar tu crecimiento dentro de la empresa. Puedes leer más sobre el programa aquí.

Además, los compañeros con base en España también reciben:

• Un día libre en tu cumpleaños

• Acceso a la plataforma de descuentos: Advantages Club

Inclusión y Diversidad

En H&M Group, estamos comprometidos con fomentar lugares de trabajo inclusivos, diversos y equitativos en toda nuestra organización. Creemos que los equipos prosperan cuando reúnen una amplia gama de orígenes, perspectivas y experiencias. Esta diversidad mejora nuestra capacidad para resolver problemas de forma creativa, ampliar nuestro pensamiento y construir conexiones significativas con colegas y clientes en todo el mundo. Por eso, consideramos todas las dimensiones de la diversidad durante nuestro proceso de selección, asegurando que nuestra plantilla refleje la riqueza de las comunidades a las que servimos.

COS

COS ofrece un guardarropa de prendas listas para usar y accesorios arraigados en una calidad excepcional y un diseño duradero. La marca tiene una estética elevada que encarna el lujo con énfasis en la artesanía, la innovación y los movimientos de moda convincentes.. Conoce más sobre COS aquí.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Cybersecurity RL (Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Team

The Security team protects Anthropic's AI systems and maintains the trust of our users and society.

About the Role

At Anthropic, we are pioneering new frontiers in AI that have the potential to greatly benefit society. However, developing advanced AI also comes with risks if not properly safeguarded. As a Research Engineer, you'll help to safely advance the capabilities of our models in incident response, security analysis, vulnerability remediation, and other areas of defensive cybersecurity.

This role blends research and engineering, requiring you to both develop novel approaches and realize them in code. Your work will include designing and implementing RL environments, conducting experiments and evaluations, delivering your work into production training runs, and collaborating with other researchers, engineers, and cybersecurity specialists across and outside Anthropic.

This role requires ML experience combined with domain expertise in cybersecurity. You might be an ML researcher with a history of cybersecurity work, or a security professional with a background in ML.

Responsibilities

• Partner with researchers and safety teams across Anthropic to understand their analytical needs and build solutions

• Develop agentic integrations that allow AI systems to autonomously investigate and act on analytical findings
• Contribute to the strategic direction of the team, including decisions about what to build, what to partner on, and where to invest
• This role may require participation in an on-call rotation.

You may be a good fit if you

• Have experience with machine learning.
• Have experience in cybersecurity research.
• Have strong software engineering skills.
• Can balance research exploration with engineering implementation.
• Are passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing safe and beneficial systems.

Strong candidates may also have

• Professional experience in security engineering, fuzzing, detection and response, or other applied defensive work.
• Experience participating in or building CTF competitions and cyber ranges.
• Academic research experience in cybersecurity or other experimental & research background.
• Familiarity with RL techniques and environments.
• Familiarity with LLM training methodologies.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$1—$2 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company.

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

• Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”

• Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world

• Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America

• Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer to help build the distributed backend that powers our AI agent platform and the developer-facing products around it — the event-driven services, real-time integrations, and APIs that let agents reliably do real work. You'll be building the systems that need to stay correct and available on our path to 1M users over the next year. In this role, you will also be responsible to:

• Build event-driven, horizontally-scalable backend services that process work reliably and correctly even when parts of the system fail.

• Build real-time surfaces and integrations — streaming connections, gateways, and CLIs — that hold up under load.

• Integrate LLMs and agentic harnesses into production systems.

• Drive features end-to-end — from ideation and architecture through deployment, observability, and iteration.

• Raise the engineering bar through clean, well-tested code, thoughtful reviews, and mentorship.

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

• 5+ years shipping and operating production backend systems at scale.

• Strong proficiency in Python, and the judgment to write clean, well-tested, maintainable code under it.

• Deep distributed-systems fundamentals: you know how to keep systems correct and available under partial failure, backpressure, and load — and you design for it by default.

• Hands-on experience with event-driven, streaming, or real-time systems (queues, pub/sub, long-lived connections).

• Comfortable operating services in production on Kubernetes in the cloud — and instrumenting them with metrics, tracing, and dashboards so you can debug what you ship.

• Solid API and software-architecture instincts; you make and defend sensible trade-offs in ambiguity.

• LLM/agentic and developer-facing product experience (MCP, RAG, APIs, SDKs, CLIs) a strong plus.

Our stack: Python, FastAPI, Postgres, Kubernetes, AWS. You don't need prior experience with all of it — we care that you can pick it up fast.

Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics

• High agency and ownership: You drive work end-to-end, from ambiguity to shipped and iterated, without waiting to be told.

• A reliability mindset: You design for failure, not just the happy path.

• Product-minded: You care about the users using what you build, not just the system behind it.

• AI-native: You use modern AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code) in your daily workflow and stay at the cutting edge of what it can do.

• Excellent written communication: We work async and write things down.

(REQ ID: 3006)

jobs.title: [Cooperative Internship 2027] Infrastructure Internship BKK
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Cooperative Internship period: January - May 2027 or August - December 2027

Get to know our team:

The Infrastructure Platform Development team builds and maintains the foundational infrastructure layer that powers all Agoda’s services. Running on over 25,000 server instances and hundreds of Kubernetes clusters, we design and develop systems that enable seamless virtualization, multi-tenant compute platforms and software-defined networking and storage. From building custom Kubernetes operators and automating bare metal provisioning to integrating one of the largest OpenStack private clouds in Asia and managing large-scale monitoring with Open Telemetry, we work with cutting-edge technologies to deliver scalable, reliable and automated solutions. This is a unique opportunity to shape a modern infrastructure platform that evolves to meet the demands of Agoda’s fast-paced, dynamic business landscape.

The opportunity:

Our Infrastructure Platform Development team in Bangkok is seeking a Software Development Intern to help us design, build and scale Agoda's internal infrastructure platforms. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in developing and enhancing our self-built infrastructure management system, as well as creating tools and scripts to interact with core components like OpenStack and Kubernetes.

If you are passionate about infrastructure system management and eager to work with modern technologies in a dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you!

In this role, you'll get to:

• Design, develop and implement your own ideas to contribute to Agoda’s infrastructure platform, including enhancing our self-built infrastructure management system

• Work on interesting challenges unique to the modern platform infrastructure we maintain, including scaling, reliability and automation

• Interact with technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry and other industry-leading tools to build and optimize our infrastructure

• Investigate and troubleshoot performance issues across core infrastructure components while driving performance tuning and optimization

What you'll need to succeed:

• Currently studying for a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or related fields

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills (working language is English)

• Some years of programming experience, at university level in a modern programming language (preferably Go or Python)

• Basic knowledge of Development ecosystems like Git and Docker

• High sense of ownership, self-driven mindset and willingness to learn

• Comfortable working in the Linux command line environment including Bash scripting

It's great if you have:

• Experience in using modern CI/CD systems (GitLab or GitHub Actions) and creating CI/CD pipelines with configuration as code (e.g., YAML, Bash)

• Experience in managing and optimizing Kubernetes clusters, OpenStack environments or other virtualization platforms

• Advanced Docker knowledge, including creating Dockerfiles, building multi-stage builds and troubleshooting complex container-related issues

• Knowledge of physical architecture at scale, including building resilient, highly available and fault-tolerant systems.

jobs.title: [Cooperative Internship 2027] Data Pipeline Intern BKK
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Cooperative Internship period: January - May 2027 or August - December 2027

The Opportunity:

Join us as an Intern in one of the Data Platform Teams which together manage the data infrastructure serving as the core backbone for all Agoda’s Data needs. The Data Platform spans four teams:

• Data Pipeline: Maintaining large scale Data Pipelines spanning trillions of events a day across multiple Data Centers

• Data Lake Operations: Administering our massive Hadoop Data Lakes at ~30+ PB scale for our data storage and computational needs

• Data Applications: Creating self-service data tools/apps (e.g. ETL, Synchronization Tools, Discoverability Tools, Data Quality Tools etc.) for use by anyone in Agoda

• Data Experience: Promoting Data Democratization and Usage through intuitive Web UIs that make it easy for any Agoda employee to interact with data

If you are interested in Data Engineering and Big Data, then this is the right internship program for you. You’ll have opportunity to work with large distributed system such as Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, Hadoop, Object Storage, Spark, Docker, Kubernetes etc.

In this Role, you'll get to:

• Start off by learning about our Systems, going through the onboarding courses (based off one of the 4 teams that you’ll join)

• Based on your interests, you’ll have an opportunity to choose which components you would like to work on.

• At which point, you’ll be assigned a mentor. Together, you’ll then decide on an internship project and go through the full development cycle within the course of your internship.

• You will take a project from ideation all the way to production. You would come up with an idea, develop a proof of concept, write tests, build dashboards, make your code production ready, deploy to production, debug issues, and learn how to automate everything.

• Come out at the end of the Internship shipping real code, understanding what it takes to deal with TB to PB worth of data, how to design good and scalable software, learning more about large distributed systems, and seeing your code run in Production

What you'll Need to Succeed:

• Be an Undergraduate / Graduate in an IT related / Computer Science or equivalent degree

• Proficient in at least one of these languages: Java, C#, Go, Python, JavaScript + React

• Good communication skills, Fast learner, Positive and Open Attitude

• Ability to work independently and as a team player

• Strong English speaking and writing skills

It's Great if you have:

• Knowledge and experiences in Big Data such as Hadoop, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Docker and Kubernetes

jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Summer internship period: 24th May - 30th July 2027

Get to Know our Team:

In Agoda’s Back End Engineering department, we build the scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that host our core business logic. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, and more. These mission-critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self-healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and C#, data technologies like Kafka and Spark, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of the Back End Engineering team.

The Opportunity:

You might call yourself “full stack” or "back end" or you might consider yourself an authority in a certain field, but you will have a keen interest in how the different systems work together.

We'd love to hear from you if you are experienced in any of the technologies we work with (note - we are not looking for you to have them all). We are interested in speaking to persons of any level from individuals just starting their IT careers to experts in their field.

In this Role, you'll get to:

• A chance to contribute to a top-notch codebase and work on scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that serve millions of requests

• You will use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and C#, data technologies like Kafka and Spark, and agile development practices

• You must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime

• Think about the full life cycle of our products, and not just about a single piece of code - from product requirements, technology selection to coding standards, agile development, testing, deployment and monitoring

What you'll Need to Succeed:

• Studying for a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or any related fields

• Familiar with basics of Object-oriented and/or Functional programming

• Familiar with relational and/or non-relational databases

• Good English communication skill

• Ready to learn fast

It's Great if you have:

• Practical knowledge with Scala, C# or Java

• You have built some back-end applications and services. You understand the basics of system scaling

• Familiar with data platforms like MS SQL, Cassandra or Hadoop. You understand that different applications have different data requirements

• Core engineering infrastructure tools like Git for source control, TeamCity for Continuous Integration and Puppet for deployment

jobs.description:
PRAC. POZÍCIA SA OBSADZUJE Z INTERNÝCH ZDROJOV SPOLOČNOSTI

Do nášho tímu Kalibračného laboratória hľadáme skúseného odborníka v oblasti metrológie alebo skúšobníctva, ktorý má ambíciu sa ďalej vzdelávať a postupne prevziať širšiu odbornú zodpovednosť v oblasti kalibračných procesov  Skúšobného centra Púchov.

POPIS PRACOVNÉHO MIESTA

• Evidencia meradiel v internom metrologickom softvéri.
• Kalibrácia prenosných meradiel v laboratóriu.
• Kalibrácia meradiel a meracích systémov na skúšobných a výrobných strojoch vo výrobných závodoch TT a PLT.
• Kalibrácia prístrojov a zariadení v Skúšobnom centre Púchov.
• Vyhodnocovanie výsledkov kalibrácií, analýza nameraných údajov a vystavovanie kalibračných certifikátov.
• Organizovanie a vykonávanie bilaterálnych porovnávacích meraní.
• Koordinácia a realizácia komplexných kalibračných procesov skúšobných zariadení v Skúšobnom centre Púchov ako aj globálnych Skúšobných centrách spoločnosti Continental.
• Aktívna komunikácia s internými oprávnenými osobami v oblasti metrológie v slovenskom a anglickom jazyku.
• Aktívna komunikácia s externými dodávateľmi meradiel, meracích systémov a zariadení v slovenskom a anglickom jazyku.
• Koordinácia kalibrácií prenosných meradiel s externými kalibračnými laboratóriami.
• Vykonávanie činností v súlade s normou EN ISO/IEC 17025.
• Práca sa vykonáva hlavne na rannej zmene.

• Minimálne stredoškolské vzdelanie s maturitou v odbore elektrotechnika, mechatronika, meracia a regulačná technika, automatizačná technika alebo v inom príbuznom elektrotechnickom odbore.
• Osvedčenie podľa Vyhlášky č. 508/2009 Z. z. minimálne § 21.
• Skúsenosti v oblasti meracej a regulačnej techniky sú výhodou.
• Schopnosť čítať, interpretovať a pracovať v zmysle pracovných postupov a technickej dokumentácie.
• Znalosť normy EN ISO/IEC 17025 je výhodou.
• Počítačové zručnosti na používateľskej úrovni (MS Office a bežná práca s IT nástrojmi).
• Anglický jazyk na komunikatívnej úrovni (slovom aj písmom).
• Skúsenosť z laboratórneho alebo skúšobného prostredia výhodou.
• Skúsenosti s riadením alebo koordináciou technických aktivít, projektov alebo menších tímov výhodou.
• Zodpovednosť, samostatnosť a ochota naďalej sa odborne rozvíjať.

• Nástupná mzda: v súlade s internými pravidlami odmeňovania (podľa znalostí a skúseností kandidáta)

Pracovná pozícia je klasifikovaná s cieľovou tarifnou triedou RT - 6.

jobs.title: Associate Bereavement Counselor
jobs.description:
By The Bay Health, a non-profit established in 1975, set the standard for hospice in the U.S. by emphasizing the role of the patient in making important medical decisions. Our spectrum of home-based services now includes Skilled Home Health Care, Palliative Care, Adult Hospice Care and Pediatric Care. Our team approach strives to address practical, social, emotional and spiritual aspects of care, with the goal to maximize quality of life for our patients, caregivers and families.

We are seeking an Associate Bereavement Counselor/Intern (post grad) for our Grief Counseling program. The Associate Bereavement Counselor/Intern works under supervision of a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, or Licensed Clinical Social Worker, or Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor, and provides individual and group counseling services to patients/families to address their emotional needs related to the impact of a terminal illness, loss, and grief.

Schedule:

Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday; 8:30am - 5:00pm with some evening shifts

Location:

Onsite; Larkspur, CA office with additional coverage at our San Francisco, CA office; 1 day remote option

By the Bay Health follows all CDPH vaccine requirements for healthcare personnel.

Associate Bereavement Counselors provide individual, family, group, and school-based Grief Counseling to bereaved Hospice families and members of the community.

Associate Bereavement Counselors receive:

• Weekly individual and group supervision meeting requirements of the BBS.

• A wide range of applicable educational in-services and learning opportunities.

• An hourly stipend and benefits

• Extensive training in clinical documentation in an electronic medical record.

• Development of Associate Bereavement Counselor's theoretical orientation in a supportive environment.

• Professional counseling experience in a fast-paced medical agency

Prospective candidates must:

• Hold a master’s degree from an accredited master’s degree Program in Counseling Psychology or Social Work. Appropriate registration with the BBS required.

• 1+ years of experience conducting on-going counseling preferred (virtually or in-person).

• Be knowledgeable about Loss and Grief Counseling techniques.

• Be able to commit to 24 hrs./week, including one evening per week, (on an intermittent basis), for a minimum of 18 months as well as travel to satellite sites, as needed.

• Have availability which includes Wednesdays and either Mon. or Fri.’s. & the 1st Wednesday of each month.

• Be proficient in basic Microsoft Office applications. Experience with documentation in an electronic medical record preferred.

Candidates bi-lingual in Mandarin are encouraged to apply.

Pay Range:
$30.00 - $36.00 hourly

By the Bay Health is proud to serve our community as an equal employment opportunity employer.  Everyone is valued and welcome at BTBH. Our organization is committed to diversity, equity and continues to build a culture of inclusion by recruiting, screening, hiring and retaining any qualified individual without regard to age, race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, registered domestic partner status, citizenship, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military care status, veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by Federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Media Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI-generated answers.

Our AI-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action.

Founder-controlled and growing  profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, technically curious Media Automation Specialist to help configure, automate, and improve the workflows that power Muck Rack’s global media intelligence services.

In this role, you’ll help transition manual operational processes into scalable, reliable automated workflows. You’ll work across content acquisition, processing, validation, and delivery systems to ensure high-quality outputs for domestic and international clients. You’ll combine a strong operational mindset with hands-on curiosity around workflow automation, systems configuration, data quality, and AI-enabled tools.

What You’ll Do

• Help migrate manual media-services workflows into scalable, automated processes using internal tools and platforms such as n8n

• Translate client briefs, editorial requirements, and operational needs into clear workflow configurations

• Configure, maintain, and improve automations that support content acquisition, validation, tagging, summarization, and delivery

• Monitor workflow health, investigate errors, and troubleshoot data-quality or system-performance issues

• Build and maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, and client-configuration records

• Partner with Global Services, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to ensure client requirements are accurately implemented and maintained

• Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and increase the speed and accuracy of service delivery

• Test workflow changes, validate outputs against client requirements, and support quality-control processes

• Support vendor-related processes, including service evaluation, communication, and invoice reconciliation

• Proactively use AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, and support process improvement

How Success Will Be Measured

• Manual workflows are transitioned into reliable, scalable automated processes

• Client deliverables are accurate, timely, and consistently aligned with briefs

• Workflow issues and data-quality concerns are identified and resolved quickly

• Automation reduces manual effort and improves operational efficiency

• Workflow, client-configuration, and SOP documentation remains clear and up to date

• Internal teams and vendor partners have the information they need to support smooth delivery

What Will Help You Succeed

• Experience or strong interest in workflow automation, systems configuration, process improvement, or operational tooling

• Familiarity with n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, Google Apps Script, or similar workflow-automation tools

• Comfort working with APIs, webhooks, spreadsheets, structured data, or system integrations

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with close attention to detail and data quality

• Ability to turn a non-technical operational need into a clear, repeatable workflow

• Experience documenting processes, writing SOPs, or maintaining operational configurations

• Clear written and verbal communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders

• A proactive, collaborative approach and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment

• Experience in media monitoring, media intelligence, content operations, customer onboarding, or vendor management is a plus

Interview Overview:

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

• 30 minute interview with a member of our Talent Team

• A 1 hour zoom interview with the hiring manager

• Panel interviews with several team members, including a discussion of cross departmental coordination and typical IT work loads

• 30 minute executive interview

• 30 minute Bar Raiser

Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

Salary

The gross monthly salary for this role in Bulgaria is approximately 1,500 - 1,800 EUR.

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Why Muck Rack?

Remote Work, Forever

• Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup

• Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership

• Virtual and in-person team bonding (lunches, events, competitions)

Transparent & Fair Compensation

• Competitive geo-neutral pay in the U.S.

• Annual reviews to ensure equity and market alignment

• Standardized bonus or commission structure

• 401(k) with employer contributions

• Equity opportunities

Health & Wellness

• Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance for employees and dependents

• 100% premium coverage for individuals on high-deductible plans

• 24/7 Virtual Care and Employee Assistance Program

• Employer-funded HSA contributions and other pre-tax benefits

• Quarterly wellness stipend and free Headspace subscription

Time Off & Family Benefits

• 4+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days

• 13 paid holidays with the option to swap for personal days

• Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

Learning and Development

• Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion

• Bi-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training

• Unlimited access to Coursera and O’Reilly

• 2 additional PTO days annually for learning and development

Inclusive, Customer-First Culture

• Commitment to equity and valuing diverse perspectives

• Agile, founder-led company focused on collaboration and innovation

• Trusted by 3,000+ companies worldwide

Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.-based employees. Support is provided for employees in other locations, in compliance with local laws and regulations.

Supply Chain Specialist

Position Overview

The Supply Chain Specialist is responsible for supplier management, procurement, inventory planning, and supply continuity to support hardware operations and customer fulfillment. This role monitors supplier performance, manages material availability, drives cost optimization, and supports new product introductions (NPI) and product lifecycle activities. The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented self-starter with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of working independently, taking ownership of responsibilities, and collaborating effectively with internal teams and external suppliers.

jobs.title: Data Center Technician (Early Talent)
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

Duration: 3 months
Start date: January 2027
Compensation: Paid
Eligibility: Current University student (Computer Science or related field), Recent Graduate or Early Career specialist
Work authorization: Permitted to work in the job's location

Program Overview

The Nebius IT Data Center Technician Early Talent program is a structured 3-month work experience designed to introduce early-career candidates to hands-on enterprise data center operations. Early talent participants are embedded on the data center floor as active team members alongside experienced DC Technicians and senior operations staff. Over the program, participants develop foundational technical skills, learn Nebius operational standards and safety procedures, and progress from fully supervised tasks toward working with increasing independence as their competency is demonstrated and validated.

What You Will Do

As an IT Data Center Technician Early Talent participant, you will work on the data center floor under the direct guidance of an experienced DC Technician. All hands-on work begins under close supervision. As you demonstrate proficiency and adherence to Nebius safety and operational standards, you will progressively take on tasks with greater independence — working toward completing assigned activities with minimal supervision by end of program.

Hardware & Infrastructure

• Learn to identify, handle, and document server components, rack hardware, and data center equipment under direct technician supervision.

• Observe and assist with physical installation, cabling, and labeling of server hardware in rack enclosures under guidance.

• Assist with hardware inventory counts, asset tagging, and equipment tracking tasks as directed.

• Shadow and support technicians during component replacements, hardware decommissions, and equipment staging activities.

• Begin performing basic rack and stack tasks independently once foundational procedures have been trained and validated.

Cabling & Connectivity

• Learn copper and fiber cabling standards, patch cord management, and labeling practices used at Nebius data center sites.

• Assist with cable organization, dressing, and documentation under direct technician guidance.

• Support connectivity checks and basic cable tracing tasks as assigned.

Documentation & Ticketing

• Learn to use Nebius ticketing and asset management systems for logging work, updating hardware records, and tracking assigned tasks.

• Assist with documentation of equipment configurations, cable layouts, and maintenance activities under technician review.

• Begin entering and updating tickets independently for assigned work items once system proficiency is demonstrated.

Safety & Operational Standards

• Complete all required Nebius data center safety training, site access procedures, and equipment handling certifications at program start.

• Follow all safety protocols, access controls, and site procedures at all times while on the data center floor.

• Never work unsupervised on live infrastructure or perform any task outside your validated scope without direct technician authorization.

• Observe and learn Nebius operational standards including shift handoff procedures, escalation practices, and incident documentation.

Learning & Development

• Participate in structured weekly check-ins with your assigned DC Technician mentor to review skill progression and address questions.

• Complete assigned Nebius training modules covering hardware fundamentals, data center operations, and safety throughout the program.

• Shadow senior technicians during escalated incidents, complex deployments, and hardware troubleshooting activities to build technical awareness.

• Actively engage during shadowing activities and take initiative in building your technical knowledge base throughout the 3 months.

Supervision & Progression

Early talent participants begin under close, continuous supervision for all data center floor activities. This is not a desk-based or observation-only role — you are an active participant on the floor from day one. Progression follows a structured competency model:

• Weeks 1–3: Orientation and shadowing. All tasks under direct supervision with step-by-step guidance. Focus on safety, site familiarity, system access, and equipment identification.

• Weeks 4–7: Assisted execution. You perform assigned tasks with your mentor present and reviewing all completed work before sign-off.

• Weeks 8–10: Supervised independence. You complete defined tasks independently within your validated scope, checking in at key milestones. Technician remains nearby and available.

• Weeks 11–12: Demonstrated competency. Qualified participants work with minimal supervision on fully validated tasks; technician oversight maintained for any task outside established scope.

Progression is based on demonstrated proficiency and adherence to Nebius standards — not time served. Participants who complete the program with strong evaluations will be considered for the Nebius early talent pipeline.

Core Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and remain on your feet for extended periods during active floor operations.

• Ability to safely lift and position equipment up to 50 pounds unassisted; heavier loads with team-lift support.

• Comfortable working at heights including ladders, raised platforms, and elevated data center infrastructure.

• Ability to work in confined spaces such as under raised floors, within rack enclosures, and in cable management pathways.

• Comfortable in environments with variable temperatures including cold aisle containment zones.

• Manual dexterity to handle small form-factor components, precision cabling, and fine connector installations.

• Ability to push or pull equipment carts and server sleds up to 500 pounds on level surfaces.

Compensation
We offer competitive salaries, ranging from $48k- $72k OTE (On Target Earnings) based on your experience

Key employee benefits in the US:

• Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.

• 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.

• Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.

• Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$48,000—$72,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

The amount and location of travel may vary depending on customer needs, company events, sales activities, and the agricultural season.

The employee must be willing and able to travel when required.

Sales Team Coordination

The Sales Team Coordinator will help organize and coordinate the daily work of the sales team.

Responsibilities include:

• Helping communicate daily and weekly priorities to members of the sales team.
• Tracking sales-related assignments, deadlines, customer commitments, quotes, orders, and follow-up activities.
• Contacting team members for updates, missing information, and task completion.
• Reminding team members of deadlines, meetings, customer commitments, and required follow-ups.
• Making sure assigned tasks have a clear owner, deadline, and next step.
• Following up when work is incomplete, overdue, unclear, or missing.
• Helping organize and facilitate sales meetings.
• Preparing meeting agendas, notes, action items, assignments, and follow-up lists.
• Monitoring progress on action items discussed during meetings.
• Helping keep sales representatives aligned with company priorities and customer expectations.
• Identifying stalled opportunities, communication gaps, workload conflicts, or missing information.
• Escalating repeated delays, unresolved problems, or serious concerns to management.
• Helping maintain consistent use of the company’s CRM, calendars, sales procedures, and reporting systems.
• Assisting with onboarding and training coordination for new sales team members.
• Helping organize training materials, system access, schedules, meetings, and follow-up activities.

This role includes meaningful people coordination and day-to-day oversight of sales activities.

The employee may provide direction, follow-up, and accountability to members of the sales team. However, final authority regarding hiring, termination, compensation, formal discipline, and major personnel decisions remains with company management unless otherwise assigned.

Customer Service and Communication

The Sales Team Coordinator will help support customers throughout the sales process.

Responsibilities include:

• Answering customer phone calls, emails, and other inquiries in a friendly and professional manner.
• Gathering the information needed to understand the customer’s request.
• Directing technical, pricing, warranty, service, or product questions to the appropriate team member when necessary.
• Following up with customers regarding quotes, orders, availability, appointments, delivery information, and next steps.
• Providing customers with accurate information based on approved company materials and pricing.
• Communicating delays, changes, and updates clearly and promptly.
• Documenting customer commitments and making sure promised follow-ups are completed.
• Assisting with customer concerns by gathering information and coordinating with the appropriate department.
• Following customer issues through until they are resolved or transferred to the correct person.
• Representing Bish Enterprises professionally when communicating with customers, vendors, dealers, visitors, and industry contacts.

Quotes, Orders, and Sales Support

Responsibilities include:

• Preparing customer quotes, proposals, product information, and sales documents using company templates and approved pricing.
• Reviewing documents for accuracy and completeness before they are sent.
• Receiving customer orders and accurately entering the required information into company systems.
• Confirming customer contact information, products, pricing, delivery details, payment requirements, and other order information.
• Monitoring open quotes and orders to help prevent missed deadlines or incomplete tasks.
• Coordinating with production, parts, service, shipping, accounting, marketing, and other departments.
• Checking order status and identifying possible delays or missing information.
• Communicating order updates to the appropriate sales representative, customer, or manager.
• Scheduling customer calls, meetings, demonstrations, appointments, and follow-ups.
• Maintaining sales calendars and communicating scheduling changes.
• Assisting with preparation for trade shows, customer visits, sales meetings, and equipment demonstrations.

CRM, Reporting, and Administrative Support

Responsibilities include:

• Entering and maintaining customer, lead, quote, order, and follow-up information in the company’s systems.
• Keeping customer contact information, notes, deadlines, sales stages, and next steps complete and current.
• Preparing regular sales reports using information from the CRM, spreadsheets, and other company systems.
• Organizing information clearly for management and the sales team.
• Highlighting overdue follow-ups, open quotes, customer concerns, order issues, and other items requiring attention.
• Completing data entry, filing, document preparation, and record organization.
• Maintaining commonly used sales materials, templates, documents, and office supplies.
• Helping improve sales coordination procedures, tracking systems, and internal communication.

Independence and Accountability

The successful candidate must be able to work independently after receiving appropriate training.

The employee will be expected to:

• Keep track of assigned tasks and deadlines.
• Follow up without needing repeated reminders.
• Ask questions when instructions or information are unclear.
• Identify routine problems and take reasonable action to solve them.
• Find the correct person or resource when assistance is needed.
• Communicate delays, mistakes, or concerns promptly.
• Keep management informed about important customer, sales, or team issues.
• Address incomplete work professionally and respectfully.
• Balance being supportive with maintaining clear expectations.
• Work confidently with different personalities and communication styles.

This position may not be a good fit for someone who requires constant step-by-step direction for routine work or who is uncomfortable following up with coworkers about incomplete assignments.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time position that generally requires approximately 44 to 50 working hours per week.

The normal schedule is Monday through Friday.

Saturday, early-morning, evening, or additional hours may occasionally be required due to:

• Customer deadlines
• Company travel
• Trade shows or events
• Equipment demonstrations
• Agricultural seasonality
• Increased workload during busy periods

Some scheduling flexibility may be available with management approval.

Any schedule adjustment must still allow the employee to meet customer needs, attend required meetings, complete on-site responsibilities, coordinate the sales team, and fulfill travel requirements.

Because Bish Enterprises is a small and growing company, employees may occasionally be asked to assist with reasonable duties outside their normal task list.
