jobs.title: Associate Manager - Investor Services
jobs.location: Port Louis, Port Louis District, Mauritius
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about investor services and ready to take the next step in your leadership journey? As an Associate Manager within our Investor Services team, you'll lead and develop a talented team while acting as a trusted partner to clients, investors, and key stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity to combine technical expertise with people leadership, overseeing the delivery of high-quality investor servicing solutions, driving operational excellence, and contributing to the continued growth of a dynamic and collaborative business. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy building strong relationships, and are motivated by developing both people and processes, this role offers an excellent platform to make a meaningful impact and advance your career.

What You Will Do

• You’ll oversee day‑to‑day investor services operations, reviewing work completed by Investor Services Officers and ensuring all deliverables meet quality, compliance, and regulatory requirements
• You’ll manage relationships with clients and investors, providing guidance on ongoing matters and proactively resolving issues before they escalate into complaints
• You’ll monitor investor transactions, including subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, trade settlements, and capital calls, ensuring accuracy and timely processing
• You’ll oversee FATCA/CRS reporting, AM/CFT reviews, CDD requirements, investor onboarding processes, and compliance approvals for complex investor structures, including Omnibus Accounts, PEPs, and REPs
• You’ll coach and develop team members, support performance reviews, drive process improvements, and ensure all internal, client, and Group reporting deadlines are achieved

What We Offer

• Comprehensive remuneration: Motivating financial packages based upon market rates for your role and is proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
• Pension Scheme: Generous employer contribution with the ability to allow and increase employee contributions
• Annual leave: All our employees are entitled to 22 days paid leave. Enhanced maternity and paternity, including shared parental leave and adoption leave
• Flexible working: We recognise the value of working flexibly and is keen to ensure all employees enjoy an excellent work-life blend. As such, we are open to conversations with employees related to setting up flexible working arrangements
• Support and development: We will ensure you have the right training, tools and development plan to grow and improve your skills every day

• You hold a degree or are fully qualified ACCA or ICSA, with a strong foundation in investor services, fund administration, or financial services
• You bring robust relevant experience, including exposure to investor servicing, transfer agency, or fund administration activities
• You have a strong understanding of FSC regulations relating to open‑ended and closed‑ended fund structures
• You are a people‑focused leader who enjoys coaching, developing talent, and creating a collaborative and high‑performing team environment
• You are highly organised, client‑focused, and detail‑oriented, with strong Microsoft Office skills, working knowledge of Microgen, and excellent communication skills in English

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

As a forward-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders, including our employees, clients, and local communities, while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve, whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We're committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees' careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to colleagues. We want to empower our 5,500+ employees, from 94 nationalities, speaking 41 languages across 25 countries, to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad, we support female managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We're committed to growing long-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We're emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

As a Sales Manager, you will lead our small but dedicated sales team, drive customer acquisition, increase revenue growth, and oversee direct sales efforts. Collaborating with upper management as well as our marketing team, you'll devise strategic sales and marketing plans, manage the marketing budget, and ensure our campaigns align with our brand identity.  This role will be directly involved with the day-to-day sales, while simultaneously providing coaching, guidance, and accountability to our sales team members.

Your knack for analyzing the effectiveness of these strategies will be critical to optimizing our sales potential. As the primary contact for sales-related issues, we will rely on your proactive problem-solving skills. Join us as we continue to foster growth and success within the agricultural equipment sector.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to COO
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Executive Assistant to support our Chief Operating Officer (COO).

This role is much more than traditional administrative support. The Executive Assistant will help the COO manage priorities, organize information, coordinate communication, track commitments, and keep important projects and follow-ups moving across the company.

The right person will become a trusted administrative partner who can anticipate needs, manage multiple priorities, communicate professionally, and independently close open loops without requiring constant direction.

You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly, interruptions happen, and follow-through matters.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Calendar Support

• Manage and maintain the COO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and scheduling priorities.
• Coordinate and confirm phone calls, Teams/Zoom meetings, appointments, and other commitments.
• Identify scheduling conflicts and help prioritize the COO's time.
• Make sure the COO has the documents, notes, links, background information, and other materials needed before meetings.
• Coordinate travel, accommodations, itineraries, events, and related logistics.
• Help keep the COO prepared for upcoming meetings, deadlines, commitments, and responsibilities.

Email, Communication & Follow-Up

• Help organize and maintain the COO's email inbox and communications.
• Track requests, commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items.
• Draft, format, proofread, and review emails, correspondence, reports, presentations, quotes, and other materials.
• Communicate professionally with employees, customers, vendors, industry partners, nonprofit organizations, and other external contacts.
• Make sure promised information and follow-ups are completed.
• Screen and appropriately direct incoming communications.
• Maintain professional relationship continuity on behalf of the COO.

Project & Team Coordination

• Follow up with team members across administration, sales, marketing, production, engineering, and other departments.
• Track project deliverables, deadlines, open questions, responsibilities, and next steps.
• Follow through on outstanding items until they are resolved.
• Help maintain accountability across projects and departments.
• Take clear meeting notes and turn discussions into organized action items.
• Keep project information, notes, and supporting documents organized.
• Update customer records, notes, CRM information, and project information when requested.

Administrative & Business Support

• Prepare presentations, reports, correspondence, meeting materials, and other documents.
• Organize and maintain electronic files and records.
• Conduct basic research and organize information for executive review.
• Assist with internal and external meetings, events, conferences, and speaking engagements.
• Provide administrative support for industry associations, nonprofit initiatives, and other organizational activities.
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
• Assist with changing business and executive priorities as needed.

What Success Looks Like

A strong Executive Assistant at Bish does more than complete assigned tasks.

You should be someone who:

• Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through.
• Notices when something is incomplete and works to resolve it.
• Keeps commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups from falling through the cracks.
• Understands what is urgent, what can wait, and when clarification is needed.
• Learns processes quickly and becomes increasingly independent.
• Takes useful notes and remembers recurring expectations.
• Communicates clearly and professionally with different personalities and departments.
• Is comfortable respectfully following up with coworkers and executives.
• Can manage interruptions and changing priorities without losing organization.
• Identifies practical solutions instead of simply reporting problems.
• Pays close attention to details while still understanding the larger priority.
• Can work independently without needing constant supervision.
• Knows when to take initiative and when to ask for direction.
• Is reliable, discreet, and trusted with sensitive information.

Required

• At least 2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Administrator, or in a closely related support role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
• Demonstrated reliability and follow-through.
• Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, deadlines, and changing priorities.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
• Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.
• Professional communication skills when interacting with executives, employees, customers, vendors, and external partners.
• Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365, including:OutlookWordExcelPowerPointTeams
• Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
• Legally authorized to work in the United States.
• Able to work on-site at our Giltner, Nebraska location.

Preferred

• Experience directly supporting a COO, CEO, business owner, entrepreneur, or senior executive.
• Experience managing executive calendars and email inboxes.
• Experience coordinating projects across multiple departments.
• Experience with CRM systems.
• Experience with project-management tools such as Smartsheet, Trello, Asana, or similar platforms.
• Experience in sales support, marketing, public relations, business operations, or customer communication.
• Experience coordinating travel, conferences, events, or speaking engagements.
• Spanish language skills.
• Interest in agriculture, manufacturing, agricultural equipment, sustainability, or mission-driven organizations.

Agricultural experience is helpful but not required. We are more interested in finding someone who can learn quickly, understand the business, and become a reliable and increasingly independent partner to the COO.

Schedule

jobs.title: Founder, AI Insurance
jobs.description:
Forum's Venture Studio https://www.forumvc.com/studio brings together ambitious people, brilliant ideas, and capital to build the best B2B SaaS businesses in the world, from 0 to 1. In addition to capital and an idea, we provide founders with access to investor networks, fundraising support, and the resources needed to build transformational companies. Our AI Studio has launched 17 companies since 2023, and we're launching 7 more in 2026. We're designed to help Founders move faster, develop better insights, and build companies that have a higher success rate than startups built in any other way.

What We're Looking At:

Insurance was built for people and machines. AI is both. Every policy assumes you can tell who did the work, and AI-assisted work broke that assumption. The industry's first answer has been to exclude it: 2,369 generative AI exclusions are now in force on US commercial policies, up from zero a year ago, including 146 filed on professional liability and E&O in the first four months of 2026 alone. Most were added defensively, not because of losses, which means the right evidence can bring coverage back. Nobody is producing it yet. Forum AI Studio is looking for a Founder exploring any of these themes:

 - Proof of review for professionals: per-matter records proving a licensed lawyer, accountant, engineer, or architect reviewed the AI's work, packaged so coverage holds at renewal

 - Getting coverage back for the trades: evidence and carrier partnerships that restore general liability and umbrella coverage for contractors using AI estimating and planning tools

 - Underwriting hybrid work: the attribution data layer that prices teleoperated and supervised-autonomy robotics for MGAs and carriers

 - Agentic commerce guarantees: delegation records and guarantees that settle who eats the loss when an AI agent buys wrong

Maybe you've run underwriting or product at an insurtech or MGA and know what it takes to get a carrier to say yes. Maybe you've placed professional or contractor coverage as a broker and watched clients lose it this year. Maybe you've built risk or chargeback infrastructure in payments, or sold software into carriers and know how long the yes takes. You don't need to have done all four. You need to know exactly where insurance stopped working for AI and be relentless about fixing it.



Forum derisks and accelerates the Founder path by:

 - A $250K USD investment, and an end-to-end fundraising playbook and network to raise your seed and Series A

 - A validation partner with proven playbooks, networks, and the systems to validate, unlock your ICP, ignite your sales pipeline, and beyond

 - The support of our experienced operating team - from business design, product development, growth, recruitment, legal and more

 - Executing a winning GTM strategy to get to $50-100K ARR, and the right MVP to ensure early traction

 - A community full of mentors, peers, and leaders

 - $100K worth of business perks

About you:

 - Early-stage operator experience with a proven track record in insurance, insurtech, or risk infrastructure

 - You may have run underwriting, product, or distribution at a carrier, MGA, or insurtech and know how carrier partnerships actually get signed

 - You may have placed professional liability, E&O, or contractor coverage as a broker and seen AI exclusions hit your book firsthand

 - You may have built fraud, chargeback, or risk-scoring infrastructure in payments or commerce

 - The ability to attract, hire and lead world-class teams

 - A demonstrated passion for technology's ability to change the world

 - A desire to be a venture-backed founder

 - Canada or US-based, and the ability to collaborate in North American time zones.

Please note, this is not an employment opportunity with Forum Ventures. If you are currently fundraising your pre-seed or Seed round, please pitch our investment team instead here https://www.forumvc.com/pitch-us.

jobs.title: Site Manager (Northern Cape)
jobs.description:
To manage, lead and grow the Northern Cape site by ensuring safe, compliant and efficient inspection, sampling and sample-preparation operations, while supporting business development, client retention, revenue growth and the SGS management system

Operational leadership

• Plan, organise and control all Northern Cape site operations, including field sampling, inspection, sample preparation, dispatch, reporting support and site administration.

• Schedule personnel, vehicles, equipment and tools to meet client requirements safely, efficiently and within agreed turnaround times.

• Manage daily operational performance, productivity, overtime, turnaround time, service quality and adherence to work instructions.

• Ensure adequate manpower, equipment, consumables, PPE, vehicles and site resources are available for efficient operations.

• Support site supervisors, the HSE coordinator and quality coordinator in resolving operational, safety and quality issues.

• Maintain effective communication between the site, Regional Manager, HOD of Trade, clients and support functions.

Technical, quality and safety control

• Implement and maintain technical procedures, operational procedures, sampling instructions, sample-preparation controls and inspection requirements.

• Ensure all work complies with SGS policies, the SGS Code of Integrity, QHSE requirements, client instructions and applicable South African legislation.

• Apply the Check Status process and Stop Work Authority whenever risks are not clearly controlled or understood.

• Monitor quality control, data integrity, equipment condition, calibration status, traceability, chain of custody and sample security.

• Record the basis for opinions and interpretations and ensure these are only issued by designated authorised personnel.

• Participate in Operational Integrity projects, safety campaigns, audits, investigations and corrective actions.

People management

• Lead, coach and monitor staff performance, discipline, attendance, training needs, competency records and safe work behavior.

• Ensure new and existing staff are trained and competent for sampling, inspection, sample preparation, reporting support and safety-critical activities.

• Promote a professional, client-focused, ethical and accountable site culture.

Financial and administrative control

• Manage petty cash usage, site assets, consumables, stock usage, overtime and other controllable site costs.

• Provide monthly workload, opportunity, cost and operational performance updates to management.

• Support complaint, claim, nonconformance and improvement-request investigations with facts, records and corrective actions.

Build and maintain a Northern Cape client pipeline covering existing clients, potential clients, mining operations, stockyards, sidings, logistics providers and related commodity stakeholders.

• Conduct planned client visits and technical engagements to understand upcoming work, pain points, service gaps, tender opportunities and competitor activity.

• Identify opportunities to grow inspection, sampling, sample preparation, moisture, size, quality, stockpile, vessel/rail/truck and related trade services where applicable.

• Support the Regional Manager with quotations, proposals, tenders, pricing inputs, scope definition, method statements and service-level discussions.

• Maintain a simple opportunity register showing client, commodity, service need, value estimate, probability, next action and expected close date.

• Track lost work, client complaints, turnaround issues and market feedback, and propose actions to retain or win business.

• Represent SGS professionally in the region and strengthen confidence in the site through reliable delivery, technical support and rapid issue resolution.

• Report monthly on business development activity, revenue risk, new leads, upcoming projects, cross-selling opportunities and support required from management.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and training

• Minimum qualification - Matric / Grade 12.

• Advantage: Degree in quality/metallurgy/Chemical engineering

• Sampling, inspection, laboratory, mineral processing, logistics or other relevant technical qualification is preferred.

• SHE / HSE knowledge and practical risk-assessment training.

• ISO/IEC 17025 awareness or VLC SANAS ISO 17025 course, where applicable to the site scope.

• Valid Code B driver’s licence required due to site travel and client visits.

Experience

• Minimum 3 years management or supervisory experience in inspection, sampling, sample preparation, mining, minerals, trade, logistics or a related operational environment.

• Experience scheduling staff, vehicles, shifts, equipment and site resources.

• Experience with safety, quality, client communication, operational reporting and complaint resolution.

• Experience in business development, client relationship management, quotations, proposals or revenue growth is strongly preferred.

• Practical knowledge of bulk commodity sampling and sample preparation is essential.

REQUIRED SKILLS

Leadership and operational skills

• Ability to lead teams, allocate work, monitor performance and hold staff accountable.

• Strong planning, scheduling, prioritisation and resource-control capability.

• Ability to solve operational problems quickly while protecting safety, quality and client service.

• Strong understanding of sampling, inspection, sample preparation, chain of custody and field controls.

Commercial and business development skills

• Client relationship management, professional communication and confidence in client-facing discussions.

• Ability to identify opportunities, prepare basic commercial inputs, support proposals and follow up leads.

• Commercial awareness of revenue, margin, cost control, overtime, utilisation and service profitability.

• Ability to prepare monthly revenue, opportunity and operational performance updates.

Quality, safety and compliance skills

• Practical HSE risk management, Stop Work Authority, incident reporting and corrective-action follow-up.

• Understanding of quality systems, document control, equipment status, traceability, nonconformances and data integrity.

Communication and personal competencies

• Good written and verbal English communication skills.

• Numeracy and calculation capability for operational, commercial and technical checks.

• Computer literacy, including Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and basic operational reporting.

• Delivers results, adapts to change, acts ethically and maintains confidentiality.

Safe operations: zero tolerance for uncontrolled risk, with timely close-out of incidents, observations and corrective actions.

• Quality and compliance: adherence to methods, work instructions, traceability, equipment status and management-system requirements.

• Operational delivery: on-time service delivery, effective scheduling, controlled overtime and efficient use of site resources.

• People performance: staff competence, attendance, discipline, productivity and adherence to professional conduct.

• Client service: complaint response, client engagement, issue resolution and retention of existing business.

• Business growth: new leads, proposals supported, revenue opportunities identified and monthly business development reporting.

• Financial control: revenue updates, petty cash control, consumable usage, site-cost discipline and accurate operational records.

Compliant with all SGS QOH&S, HR, Operational Integrity, ethics and management-system policies and procedures.

• Granted sufficient authority to achieve the responsibilities of the role in line with relevant SGS authority policies.

• Responsible for the daily safety and health of employees at the site on behalf of SGS management, and for escalating unresolved risks or resourcing issues.

• Keep up to date with SGS inspection, sampling and operational policies and apply the correct policy to avoid misunderstanding during inspections.

• Cease work or equipment use where safety, quality, integrity, legal compliance or client confidence may be compromised, and take action to address the issue.

• Initiate improvement requests, nonconformance reports and corrective actions where deviations, risks or improvement opportunities are identified.

• Adhere to all QHSE requirements of the SGS management systems.

jobs.title: Videographer (Lo- to Mid-fi)
jobs.description:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the role

You’ll capture and edit the footage that powers Hims & Hers ads and social content. You’ll create fast, platform-native video that grabs attention, from lo-fi social content to more polished campaigns. Working closely with our producer, strategists and editors, you’ll turn briefs into content that connects with audiences and drives results.

What you’ll be doing

• Work with the producer and strategists to turn briefs into video, planning shot lists and independently running small to mid-sized shoots on location or in the studio.

• Shoot short-form vertical and landscape video across interviews, UGC-style content, talking heads, community moments and b-roll, capturing hooks and variations for testing.

• Operate professional cameras or smartphones, including Blackmagic, Canon and Arri systems, and handle lighting, framing and clean audio capture.

• Edit lo-fi and more polished content for performance marketing and other channels, from quick-turn selects and rough cuts to finished assets, including basic colour correction and sound mixing.

• Collaborate with video editors, creatives and producers on storytelling, visual polish and the timely delivery of larger campaigns. Support larger shoots as a camera assistant, B-camera operator or data wrangler when needed.

• Use creative feedback and performance insights with the team to test and improve content, while sharing ideas, formats and platform trends.

• Keep footage, work-in-progress files and final exports organised with consistent naming, and keep equipment and the studio shoot-ready.

About you

• 3–6+ years in video production and editing for brands, creators or publishers, with experience producing social-first content.

• A portfolio or demo reel showing platform-native shooting and editing, strong storytelling and an eye for content that captures attention.

• Confident operating cameras and working independently on small to mid-sized shoots, with strong lighting, framing and sound skills.

• Proficient in video editing tools such as Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve, including basic colour correction and sound mixing.

• Skilled at making lo-fi footage feel intentional, and at directing non-professional talent, including clinicians and customers.

• Organised and detail-oriented, with sound file-management practices and an ability to balance quality with speed across multiple shoots.

• A collaborative communicator who shares ideas and work in progress, takes feedback and is comfortable working in a regulated health context.

Nice to have

• Experience with YouTube, traditional TVCs or larger campaign shoots.

• DOP or directing experience, or a background in design or art direction.

• Ability to create simple motion graphics in After Effects, or experience with colour grading and sound design.

• Experience with tools such as Iconik, Figma or Blackmagic Cloud.

• Own kit, if working on a freelance basis.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

• What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.

• Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.

• Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

• Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.

• Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in Australia?

• Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. ****Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.

• Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.

• Work where well-being matters - Experience catered wellness talks, exercise classes, free barista coffees, funded social clubs, and quarterly rooftop parties.

• Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare.

• Support at every stage - Benefit from parental and miscarriage leave, health, professional development, and personal days, and our Employee Assistance Program.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. jobs.title: Model Engineer, Multimodal Understanding
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

MODEL ENGINEER, MULTIMODAL UNDERSTANDING

You will join the multimodal team to push toward superhuman multimodal intelligence. Advance understanding and generation across modalities—image, video, audio, and text—spanning the full stack: data curation/acquisition, tokenizer training, large-scale pre-training, post-training/alignment, infrastructure/scaling, evaluation, tooling/demos, and end-to-end product experiences.

Collaborate cross-functionally with pre-training, post-training, reasoning, data, applied, and product teams to deliver frontier capabilities in multimodal reasoning, world modeling, tool use, agentic behaviors, and interactive human-AI collaboration. Contribute to building models that can see, hear, reason about, and interact with the world in real time at unprecedented levels.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, build, and optimize large-scale distributed systems for multimodal pre-training, post-training, inference, data processing, and tokenization at web/petabyte scale

• Develop high-throughput pipelines for data acquisition, preprocessing, filtering, generation, decoding, loading, crawling, visualization, and management (images, videos, audio + text)

• Advance multimodal capabilities including spatial-temporal compression, cross-modal alignment, world modeling, reasoning, emergent abilities, audio/image/video understanding & generation, real-time video processing, and noisy data handling

• Drive data quality and studies: curation (human/synthetic), filtering techniques, analysis, and scalable pipelines to support trillion-parameter models

• Create evaluation frameworks, internal benchmarks, reward models, and metrics that capture real-world usage, failure modes, interactive dynamics, and human-AI synergy

• Innovate on algorithms, modeling approaches, hardware/software/algorithm co-design, and scaling paradigms for state-of-the-art performance

• Build research tooling, user-friendly interfaces, prototypes/demos, full-stack applications, and enable rapid iteration based on feedback

• Work across the stack (pre-training → SFT/RL/post-training) to enable reasoning, tool calling, agentic behaviors, orchestration, and seamless real-time interactions

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience writing production-quality code in Python, PyTorch, JAX, Rust, or C++

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Expert-level proficiency in Python (core language), with strong experience in at least one of: JAX / PyTorch / XLA

• Proven track record building or optimizing large-scale distributed ML systems (training/inference optimization, GPU utilization, multi-GPU/TPU setups, hardware co-design)

• Deep experience designing and running data pipelines at scale: curation, filtering, generation, quality studies, especially for noisy/real-world multimodal data

• Strong fundamentals in evaluation design, benchmarks, reward modeling, or RL techniques (particularly for interactive/agentic behaviors)

• Proactive self-starter who thrives in high-intensity environments and is passionate about pushing multimodal AI frontiers

• Willingness to own end-to-end initiatives and do whatever it takes to deliver breakthrough user experiences

• Experience leading major improvements in model capabilities through better data, modeling, algorithms, or scaling

• Hands-on work with large-scale orchestration tools such as Spark, Ray, or Kubernetes

• Background building full-stack tooling: performant interfaces, real-time research demos/apps, or end-to-end product ownership

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$160,000 - $250,000 USD

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive
jobs.description:

Nightfall is the AI-native, unified data loss prevention and insider risk management platform that protects sensitive data across SaaS apps, GenAI tools, email, endpoint devices, and more. Hundreds of customers, spanning AI innovators to top 10 banks, trust Nightfall to detect and stop data exfiltration at scale. Nightfall enables organizations to innovate freely without the risks of losing intellectual property or exposing customer data. With automatic remediation, security violations can be resolved automatically before they become incidents, and end-users can be automatically trained and coached in the moment to self-heal violations that they introduce.

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the foundation for faster, safer innovation.

Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud supports critical enterprise workloads across multiple clouds and regions. As AI accelerates software development, the volume and pace of change are outgrowing what engineers can manually review, coordinate, and monitor. Moving faster requires systems that make understanding, diagnosing, and resolving issues an integral part of how customers and engineers work.

The Observability team builds the telemetry, analytics, and diagnostic platform that helps Snowflake customers and engineers understand the health of their workloads and services, detect problems early, and resolve them quickly. We’re looking for a hands-on, product-minded Principal Software Engineer I to help build an AI-driven observability platform, combining deep distributed-systems engineering with a strong instinct for what customers and developers need.

You will shape technical direction, solve challenging systems problems, and lead initiatives from concept to customer launch across engineering, product, and design. The opportunity is to build a platform where AI agents and engineers detect, diagnose, and resolve issues together, so that growing scale and complexity translate into faster answers rather than more manual investigation.




AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

 - Architect and build distributed infrastructure. Design scalable pipelines and services for ingesting, storing, and querying logs, metrics, traces, and events at very high volume, with predictable cost, low query latency, fault isolation, and clear data-freshness guarantees.

 - Ship observability products to customers. Partner with product management and design to define and deliver customer-facing capabilities, from telemetry collection and alerting to dashboards and diagnostics, that work natively within Snowflake. Turn customer feedback and usage data into product decisions, and own outcomes through launch and adoption.

 - Build AI-driven detection and diagnosis. Develop agentic workflows that correlate signals across the stack, surface anomalies, explain likely root causes, and recommend or take remediation steps. Ground these capabilities in high-quality telemetry and rigorous evaluation so customers and engineers can trust them.

 - Build and work AI-first. Make AI integral to how you design, implement, test, and operate software. Establish rigorous evaluation, security, and reliability standards for AI-powered capabilities, and drive adoption of AI-first practices across the team.

 - Lead from architecture through adoption. Translate ambiguous customer and developer needs into practical designs and milestones. Deliver intuitive APIs, SDKs, and self-service experiences built on open standards such as OpenTelemetry, and guide incremental migrations from existing tooling.

 - Raise the engineering bar. Write and review production code, diagnose complex failures, own operational outcomes, and mentor engineers. Influence across teams through technical depth, clear communication, and sound judgment.




OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - 12+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex backend, infrastructure, or data-platform initiatives spanning multiple teams.

 - Deep experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with strong understanding of concurrency, consistency, caching, failure recovery, storage and query efficiency, and performance.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals and hands-on proficiency in Java, Go, C++, or a comparable backend language, plus experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

 - An AI-first engineering practice: you actively use AI throughout the software lifecycle and can demonstrate how it improves your execution, problem-solving, and quality. You are ready to build AI-powered platform capabilities and help others adopt this approach.

 - A track record of shipping products to external customers: partnering with product and design, turning ambiguous problems into delivered systems, making scope and quality trade-offs, and driving adoption, reliability, and customer satisfaction after launch.

 - Clear written communication, low-ego collaboration, strong ownership, and experience mentoring senior engineers.

 - A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Especially relevant: Experience building observability, monitoring, or analytics platforms (logs, metrics, traces, alerting); OpenTelemetry; time-series or columnar storage; AIOps or agentic diagnosis systems; or developer-facing data products.

Help build the platform that lets customers and engineers understand and resolve issues faster than manual investigation allows, with the scale and trust that critical workloads demand.

jobs.title: Lead Quality Inspector, 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Quality team is the frontline guardian of reliability and safety at Anduril. We are responsible for a wide range of activities crucial to the manufacturing lifecycle—from operating specialized inspection equipment and performing rigorous quality control checks, to optimizing workflows and maintaining a safe, world-class production environment. We partner directly with engineering and production to ensure our systems work flawlessly the first time, every time.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a Lead Quality Inspector to join our rapidly growing manufacturing team. In this role, you will work with cutting-edge technology aimed at advancing the state-of-the-possible. You will lead and mentor a team of highly talented Quality Inspectors to produce advanced Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) and other defense assets for strategic military and commercial customers.

This is a highly dynamic, hands-on role that requires a unique blend of frontline technical expertise and strong leadership. The ideal candidate will have a deep technical background in aerospace structures, avionics, or propulsion systems, paired with a proven track record of guiding teams in high-stakes environments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead & Mentor: Coordinate daily team activities, schedules, and workflows. Assist inspectors in understanding work procedures, maintaining accurate work-order clocking, and meeting strict performance and safety standards.

• Collaborate Cross-Functional: Interface directly with Shipping, Receiving, Production, Quality Engineering, and Planning to rapidly resolve bottlenecks and support business needs.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Ensure clean, organized work areas (5S). Implement training programs to foster a highly skilled, cross-functional inspector workforce.

• Technical Inspection: Perform and oversee in-process, final, and First Article Inspections (FAI) using advanced metrology tools, mechanical drawings, and blueprints.

• Problem Solve: Navigate challenging production situations by leveraging your technical knowledge and quality principles to determine the most constructive path forward.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• High School Diploma or GED.

• 3+ years of experience in an aerospace, defense, military, or high-reliability hardware testing environment.

• U.S. Person Status is required as this position needs to access controlled data.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Industry Experience: Background working in fast-paced, high-standard aerospace/defense environments

• Technical Domain Expertise: Hands-on inspection experience with structural, avionics, or propulsion manufacturing.

• Leadership Background: Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or guiding teams (either in civilian manufacturing or military aviation/maintenance environments).

• Technical Skillset: Proficient in reading and interpreting complex engineering drawings, blueprints, and specifications using ASME Y14.5 GD&T. Skillful use of precision hand tools (micrometers, calipers, scales, gauges, height gauges) and CMM equipment. Strong understanding of AS9100/ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. Ability to detect design and drawing flaws early in the production cycle.

• Operational Agility: Strong computer skills (Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word) and the ability to seamlessly multitask between production line checks and formal FAIs.

• Communication: Exceptional attention to detail, work efficiency, and the ability to clearly communicate quality standards to influence engineering and production stakeholders.

US Hourly Range

$37—$50 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer- Autonomous Driving (ADAS) Data Loop & Flywheel
jobs.description:

You will serve as the chief technical authority driving the software, data loop, and MLOps machinery that automatically ingests raw fleet logs, curates high-value edge cases, auto-labels datasets, retrains deep learning models, and validates releases for embedded automotive platforms.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the technical roadmap and strategy for the E2E Autonomous Driving Data Engine, including fleet data loop automation, active learning pipelines, auto-labeling, simulation, and MLOps tooling.
• Oversee the end-to-end architecture, development, and testing of the AI data flywheel and its seamless interaction with edge fleet triggers, cloud data lakes, model repositories, and automotive target hardware.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional leads (data engineering, cloud infrastructure, embedded runtime SOC teams) to define, drive, and scale the integrated AI machinery ecosystem.
• Establish a rapid-evaluation development framework that accelerates the benchmarking, active learning selection, and continuous integration of emerging multimodal E2E AI solutions (e.g., Transformers, Occupancy Networks, Vision-Language models).
• Guide the transition of raw fleet log data and research prototypes into scalable, production-grade training and auto-labeling pipelines, ensuring runtime performance optimization on automotive-grade hardware.
• Leverage prior industry experience launching AI-based L2+ systems to implement automated validation workflows, scenario-based testing (SIL/HIL), and continuous feedback loops aligned with automotive safety standards (ISO 26262, ISO 21448 / SOTIF).
• Mentor and lead a high-caliber team of AI scientists and software engineers, establishing technical excellence in automated data engines and large-scale AI machinery.

Basic Qualifications:

• Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, AI, or a closely related field focused on autonomous systems.
• 10+ years of software development and system architecture experience in ADAS or Autonomous Driving applications.
• Proven industry track record of taking AI-based L2+ or L3/L4 autonomous driving systems into mass production.
• Deep knowledge of End-to-End AI architecture, model training algorithms, and data flywheel concepts (including active learning, fleet edge-triggers, and automated data curation).
• Deep technical mastery of modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and foundational AI paradigms (Transformers, Occupancy Networks, Reinforcement/Imitation Learning).
• Expertise in model compression, quantization, and deployment of complex neural networks onto embedded automotive target platforms (SOCs).
• Hands-on experience architecting cloud-native distributed training infrastructures, high-throughput data processing pipelines, and MLOps / CI/CD platforms for petabyte-scale fleet datasets (e.g., Ray, Kubernetes, Triton, Spark).

Preferred Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience developing offline high-precision auto-labeling frameworks (utilizing multimodal foundation models, 3D perception fusion, or generative AI engines).
• Experience integrating closed-loop simulation engines (SIL/HIL) and synthetic scenario generation into AI retraining pipelines.
• Strong programming proficiency in Python and C++.
• Deep understanding of functional safety and safety-of-the-intended-functionality standards (ISO 26262, ISO 21448 / SOTIF) applied to deep learning systems.
• Exceptional technical leadership, mentoring skills, and cross-functional communication abilities.

Pay ranges included in the postings, when included, generally reflect base salary; certain positions may include bonus, or additional benefits.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans

jobs.title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Brand Marketing

CircleCI helps more than two million developers ship software confidently. The way software gets built and shipped is getting turned on its head, and our brand has to meet the moment. It has a clear center: the developer is the hero of our story. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Brand Marketing to lead it into its next chapter. Our team is small by design, the category is at an inflection point, and you'll be close to the decisions that shape what comes next.

This is a strategic individual contributor role on the Content team, reporting to the Senior Director of Marketing and Communications. You'll work every day with Content and Visual Design, which together act as an in-house agency for the rest of marketing. You'll be the steward of our customer and of our copy. We're investing in brand, and you'll have a focused budget and leadership behind you.

What You'll Do

A day might start with a launch headline that isn't landing and an hour showing the writer why. Then a working session with the Senior Creative Director on a campaign concept, a pass on the narrative leadership will use with the company, and a late check on what AI assistants are telling developers about us. The next day looks different.

• Guide the brand. Shape our strategy, positioning, and narrative through this next chapter. Start with what we've built, and help us see where it should evolve as the way software gets built changes.

• Shape the company's voice. Choose when to lead with personality and when to lead with proof. Own our positioning in the market and carry the story across every global touchpoint from our homepage, holistic web experience, events, sales comms and paid advertising. Show its impact through conversion rates and other measurable results.

• Steward our copy. Be the final read on the work that matters most, from campaign concepts to launch headlines to sales decks. Use one test: would an engineer here send it to a friend? Write the biggest pieces yourself.

• Enable marketing. Content is produced across all of marketing, so enabling writers is as much your job as reviewing their work. Review fewer things, and make the rest better.

• Be a creative partner. Work side by side with Visual Design from the first idea. Be a generous brainstorm partner who builds on rough concepts, and give feedback that makes the work better.

• Know who we are and what we do. Learn the product, the company, and the developers we serve. Spend time with the people who build and sell CircleCI, follow where developers talk to each other, and watch what competitors say, then bring it back to the team.

• Keep the brand easy to use. Write guidelines and build assets simple enough that teams use them without asking, and manage the brand budget, agencies, and freelancers.

• Track brand health. Follow branded search, share of voice, developer sentiment, and whether AI assistants give developers the right answer about us. Report what you find honestly, and adjust.

What We're Looking For

You have 10+ years in brand, product marketing, or creative marketing, ideally for a B2B, developer, or technical audience. You write well, you've guided an established brand through a period of change, and you have guts, taste, and EQ. You'll argue for your idea and be glad when a better one wins. You care about the outcome, not just your piece of it, and you bring people along because you know this is a team sport.

• Excellent writing, shown in samples. You can move from a precise technical explanation to a one-line headline without losing the voice, and you can say exactly why a sentence falls flat.

• The confidence to say "this isn't us" and the patience to teach why.

• Agency experience, or real enthusiasm for the pace: many internal clients, quick turnarounds, shared credit.

• Experience enabling a distributed content model through guidelines, examples, and coaching, rather than by rewriting everything yourself.

• A feel for what matters to software developers. Coding experience is optional. Empathy for the developer is required.

• Uses AI as a tool, and knows when to throw out what doesn't meet the mark.

• Experience with positioning and messaging, and presenting both to executives.

• Experience influencing partners across a matrixed company and building a brand with focused resources.

• A track record of writing that moves the numbers: web conversion, pipeline growth, and campaign performance with results you can show.

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

How to Apply

Share an example of work you created or led, including at least one piece of writing you're proud of. Briefly (under 50 words) describe your role and why you're proud to share it with us.

United States Base Pay Range

$127,500—$159,000 USD

Expected salary range for San Francisco and the surrounding area.

US SF Bay Area (Metro Zone 3)

$147,500—$183,500 USD

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

• Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.

• Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.

• Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.

• Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com.  For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: IVF Nurse Manager
jobs.description:
Who is Spring Fertility?

We are a passionate, dedicated team of leading physicians and scientists who have trained at some of the world’s top research hospitals and fertility centers. Together, we are building the fastest-growing fertility group in the country, grounded in clinical excellence and innovation. We deliver deeply patient-centric, individualized, and compassionate care, recognizing that every journey is unique. Our mission is to partner with patients to help them achieve their goals, whatever those may be. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity to build a family if they choose, and our team is committed to guiding and supporting patients every step of the way.

Why should you join our team?

We are a mission-driven organization seeking motivated, high-performing professionals who are eager to innovate and make an impact. As we build a first-class fertility practice, we balance excellence with a culture that values collaboration, positivity, and enjoyment in the work we do. We are growing rapidly and are deeply committed to the professional and personal development of our team. Guided by optimism, compassion, and teamwork, we are united by a shared dedication to putting patients first.

Role Summary

The IVF Nurse Manager –provides clinical, operational, and people leadership across all clinical nursing services and patient navigation functions within fertility and specialty care programs. This leadership role ensures the delivery of seamless exceptional patient-centered fertility care while maintaining operational excellence, quality compliance, and team development.

This role is accountable for:

• Safe, compliant clinical IVF nursing operations and care management for all aspect of fertility care.

• Staff leadership, mentorship, training, quality assurance, regulatory readiness, and KPI performance across multiple sites.

The IVF Nurse Manager ensures seamless coordination between patient navigation teams, ASC nursing teams, clinical and ASC medical assistants, providers, labs, and administrative partners to deliver high quality, timely, patient centered fertility care.

Essential Functions

Clinical Leadership

• Provide clinical leadership, education, and mentorship to nursing staff.

• Support all fertility treatments including but not limited to IVF, Third-party, and IUI treatment workflows

• Ensure safe and high-quality patient care standards.

Patient Navigation & Patient Experience

• Lead the IVF Nursing team ensuring a seamless and compassionate patient journey.

• Oversee Care Team Introductions and patient onboarding processes.

• Ensure effective coordination between navigators, nurses, providers, and administrative teams.

• Monitor patient readiness, scheduling, consents, and treatment prerequisites.

• Manage patient escalations and support complex patient cases.

Team Leadership & Development

• Recruit, train, and mentor nursing staff.

• Conduct performance evaluations and support professional development.

• Foster a collaborative, compassionate, and high-performing team culture.

• Manage staff scheduling and ensure appropriate coverage across treatment areas.

Quality & Compliance

• Support and maintain the clinic’s Quality Management System.

• Ensure compliance with all state, federal, and network regulatory standards and clinical protocols included but not limited to CDC, Tissue bank regulations, and FDA regulations.

• Conduct chart audits and quality assurance reviews.

• Lead preparation for regulatory inspections and internal quality reviews.

• Monitor and enforce infection control and safety procedures.

• Develop and oversee a Quality Assurance (QA) program covering both nursing and patient navigation services include ability to define, generate, and refine current and new SOPs

• Investigate patient complaints, incidents, and quality variances; implement corrective and preventive action plans (CAPAs). Expert level in root cause analyses for clinical incidents and implement quality assurance programs.

Operational Excellence & KPI Management

• Monitor and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across nursing teams.

• Analyze trends and implement process improvements.

• Lead regular operational meetings to improve workflow efficiency and patient experience.

• Support risk management, incident investigation, and corrective action planning.

Training & Workflow Standardization

• Develop and maintain training programs and competency validation for staff.

• Create and maintain clinical SOPs, job aids, and workflow guides.

• Ensure consistent patient communication and care coordination across teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with physicians, embryologists, patient navigators, ASC clinical team, operations leaders, and administrative teams to optimize patient care and clinic operations.

• Lead or participate in cross-functional meetings to improve care delivery and operational performance.

Education, Licenses, Certifications and Other Requirements

• Bachelor's Degree

• Licensed Registered Nurse in CA (RN)/(BSN)

• Current ACLS certification

• 3-5 Years experience in fertility nursing/reproductive medicine

• 2 years of leadership/management experience

Employment Type

This is a full-time (40 hours a week/8 hours per day) exempt onsite position that requires early hours, rotational weekends and holidays.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $135,000-165,000 annually. Salary is based on several factors including job related knowledge and skill set, depth of experience, certifications and/or degrees.

Benefits

Investing in You Today and Tomorrow

Supporting your well-being

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision plans

• Paid time off to recharge and enjoy personal time

• Access to BetterHelp therapy sessions for mental and emotional wellness

• Commuter benefits and discounted rates on home, auto, and pet insurance

Investing in your future

• 401(k) with up to a 4% company match

• Comprehensive fertility and parental leave benefits

• Career development opportunities in a fast-growing organization

• Employer-paid life and disability insurance

*Temporary and contract roles may not be eligible for all benefits listed above

Don’t have it all? We still welcome you to apply!

At Spring Fertility, we believe that everyone who wants a family deserves to have one, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, or religion. Just as we acknowledge and value the diversity of goals, life experiences, and unique paths to parenthood among our patients, we also actively celebrate diversity within our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a safe and inclusive work environment for all. We recognize that diversity among our team allows us to not only more effectively serve our patients, but also to advance innovation and opportunity within our field. We encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to apply to our employment opportunities.

We are scientists. We are humanists. We are passionate about fertility.

Spring Fertility will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please give us a call.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Identity
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Manager to own Tailscale's Identity ecosystem — the bridge between our "Zero Trust" networking philosophy and the existing identity infrastructure our customers already rely on. Identity is the foundation of access control in Tailscale; if a user cannot authenticate or authorize correctly, the network cannot be secure. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex security protocols (OIDC, SAML, SCIM) and a seamless, "it just works" user experience.

The Identity portfolio covers the end-to-end lifecycle of a user and device within the tailnet:

• Authentication: Integrating with external Identity Providers (IdPs) so users can log in using the credentials they already have (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, etc.).

• Authorization: Defining how roles, groups, and attributes translate into granular network access policies.

• Lifecycle Management: Automating the onboarding, offboarding, and synchronization (SCIM) of users and devices as they change roles or leave organizations.

These capabilities are where Tailscale meets the customer's existing security stack. Nearly every enterprise deployment begins with an identity integration, grows through complex multi-IdP setups, and increasingly depends on automated lifecycle management for production security.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Tailscale's Identity portfolio: workload and agent identity, SSO integrations, Directory Sync (SCIM), access controls and policy, user management.

• Own the operator experience for admins: How IT and security teams configure identity providers, audit authentication events, and manage user, workload, and agent access policies at scale, across the admin console, API, and clients.

• Build a best-in-class authentication experience for end-users: Save our users time and money by making every auth flow fast, secure, and intuitive.

• Partner closely across engineering, product, and design org to ensure Tailscale’s identity service meets the needs of the broader organization and integrates tightly with other platform components.

• Build systematic customer insight across the full spread of Tailscale users, from a homelab operator exposing a media server through Funnel to a regulated enterprise routing traffic across multi-region datacenters.

• Turn customer signal, support patterns, cross-product requests, and competitive dynamics into roadmap priorities

What We Are Looking For

• 4–7 years in product management, with direct ownership of an identity product or platform.

• Strong technical fluency in identity protocols: Comfortable engaging engineers as a peer on OIDC, SAML, SCIM, WebAuthn, and OAuth flows.

• Experience shipping products for developer or security-focused audiences: You understand the friction points of modern IAM and know how to build tools that admins and developers actually enjoy using.

• Demonstrated ability to own a product area end to end: Strategy, roadmap, execution, and the customer relationships that keep you honest.

• Operational mindset: You understand that for an identity product, downtime or misconfiguration isn't just a bug—it’s a security event.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on experience with Tailscale at work or home.

• Background working with specific Identity Providers (Okta, Azure Entra ID/Active Directory, Google Workspace) or Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) architectures.

• Experience with cloud-native identity concepts: service mesh, workload identity federation

• Public technical writing, conference talks, or open-source contributions in the security or identity space.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range

$177,000—$221,000 USD

What We Offer

• An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.

• A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).

• Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

• Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.

• Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.

• Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.

• Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.

• Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!

• A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.

• Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.
