jobs.title: Senior Designer, Loyalty
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Fanatics is building one of the most ambitious connected fan platforms in sports… a truly single ecosystem where millions of fans earn, spend, engage, and belong across commerce, betting and gaming, collectibles, live events, credit card and more. The glue holding that ecosystem together is great design, a great loyalty program and single identity: a coherent, trustworthy, delightful experience that feels like one Fanatics regardless of where a fan enters, that their engagement feels rewarding and connected to everything they do.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Designer, you will be operating across the Loyalty layer of the Fanatics Ecosystem — this includes Loyalty itself, Identity (account, log-in, customer profile) and our SDK (which enables us to launch experiences across our various platforms seamlessly). Loyalty is the core of the customer experience, it's how we reward customers for their fandom across every touchpoint in our apps.

Your initial focus will be on improving upon our existing Loyalty infrastructure and taking key elements like rewards, Fanatics ONE, and FanCash to the next level giving them a reason to keep coming back.

This is a hands-on Senior role. You'll own design for key features within the pod, ship the work yourself, and help raise the design bar for the team around you.

What You'll Own

• Deep end-to-end design on key features for Fanatics ONE, FanCash, and Rewards — from fostering early concepts through launch and iteration.

• Well-scoped projects and features that you drive to outcomes with guidance from design leadership, partnering with PM and Engineering on scope and tradeoffs.

• Contributions to the FanApp design system: using existing patterns well and proposing new components for rewards, offers, and other Loyalty surfaces that other pods can adopt.

• Prototyping as a way to decide, including in code or the app where useful, using AI tools to explore and validate real behavior against real data and backend constraints.

• Quality for your own work: bringing it to critique and delivering clear, well-redlined handoffs to engineering.

• Peer feedback and support for designers on and around the pod.

How You'll Work

You'll partner closely with the Loyalty pod's Product Manager and Engineering Manager, sitting inside the pod rather than serving it from a distance. You'll also work with other designers in the Fanatics Ecosystem to keep your area's patterns coherent across.

This is a role that touches not one app, but multiple. Being able to represent the ecosystem through collaboration with designers, product managers, and engineers in other lines of the business is key to your success.

What Success Looks Like

• Usability, accessibility, and comprehension scores on core flows

• Speed and confidence of cross-tenant experience delivery

• Features that ship with a high craft bar and hold up at the edges.

• Patterns you design that get reused elsewhere in the app because they're good

• Trusted partnerships with your PM and engineering counterparts.

What We're Looking For

• 4+ years in Product Design, with experience owning features or a product area end to end

• Experience in relevant domains; loyalty, rewarding, membership, account for consumer-facing companies

• Systems thinking - you've designed with and contributed to design systems, and you know when to reuse a pattern versus create a new one

• Prototyping fluency, and comfort using AI tools to move faster without losing rigor

• Experience giving thoughtful feedback to peers and taking part in design critique

• Comfort in a mobile-first, fast-moving consumer environment where the roadmap can be ambiguous and priorities shift

Design Craft

• You design complete flows, not just screens - you can hold your whole area in your head without losing the individual moment.

• You care deeply about visual and interaction quality, and you know when to simplify and unify rather than add another pattern.

• You prototype fluently enough to settle debates with a demo instead of a deck.

• You understand data and backend realities well enough to design interactions that are feasible, resilient, and predictable at the edges.

The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

jobs.title: Director of Security & Risk
jobs.description:
SentiLink https://www.sentilink.com/ helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/companies/sentilink/?list=fintech50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260330439998/en/SentiLink-Named-a-2026-FICO-Industry-Vanguard-Decision-Award-Winner-for-Leadership-in-Identity-Theft-Detection. We were also the first company to go live https://resources.sentilink.com/blog/sentilink-makes-history-as-first-ecbsv-provider with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress https://resources.sentilink.com/media/dr.-david-maimons-congressional-testimony-on-emerging-fraud-threats-and-the-evolving-fraud-landscape on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.




ROLE:

SentiLink's Information Security team is responsible for protecting our systems, data, and customers while enabling the business to operate securely and efficiently. We work closely with Engineering, IT, Legal, Product, and business teams to manage security risks, maintain regulatory compliance, and build effective security controls across the organization.

We're looking for a Director of Security & Risk to lead our security governance, compliance, assurance, and risk management programs. This is a leadership role with broad ownership across FedRAMP, SOC 2, PCI DSS, customer and partner security assessments, third-party risk, and security policy.

This is not a traditional GRC role. SentiLink operates a highly technical, AWS-based environment, and many of the risks and compliance requirements we manage require deep technical understanding. We're looking for someone who can independently evaluate technical risks, understand security architecture and proposed remediations, and work effectively with engineers, auditors, regulators, and business stakeholders.

You will lead and develop a team of security and compliance professionals, establish priorities, identify gaps in our existing programs, and develop a roadmap for improving our security posture. We expect you to bring the experience and judgment to identify problems and opportunities independently, rather than simply execute an existing plan.

You will report to SentiLink's security leader and work closely with Security Engineering, which remains a separate function responsible for technical security architecture and implementation.

Success in this role means building a proactive, effective, and scalable security program that goes beyond passing audits to meaningfully reducing organizational risk.

This is a remote, US-based position.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Lead and develop SentiLink's security governance, risk, and compliance organization. Manage and mentor security and compliance professionals, evaluate program effectiveness, identify gaps in expertise and capacity, and develop organizational and hiring plans as the company grows.

 - Own SentiLink's security compliance and audit programs, including FedRAMP, SOC 2, and PCI DSS. Lead external assessments, manage control effectiveness and evidence collection, oversee Vanta and compliance automation, and ensure the organization continuously meets its obligations rather than preparing only for periodic audits.

 - Drive the ongoing maturity of SentiLink's government security program. Oversee FedRAMP continuous monitoring, POA&M governance, change-management compliance, agency-specific requirements, and assessment readiness. Anticipate evolving requirements, including FedRAMP 20x, and develop plans to address them.

 - Establish and operate a rigorous security risk management program. Own the identification, assessment, documentation, escalation, and treatment of security risks, control deficiencies, and exceptions. Ensure material risks receive appropriate attention and that remediation is tracked through completion.

 - Lead SentiLink's third-party security risk management program. Establish and enforce risk-based vendor diligence requirements, improve assessment quality, manage ongoing vendor oversight, and ensure material security concerns are resolved or appropriately escalated before approval.

 - Own customer and partner security assurance. Lead complex security assessments and audits from financial institutions, government agencies, and other partners. Evaluate contractual security requirements in collaboration with Legal, coordinate technical responses, and ensure security representations are accurate, complete, and defensible.

 - Own security policy and control governance. Maintain security policies, standards, and control frameworks, ensuring requirements are appropriately mapped across regulatory obligations, reflected in actual operations, and periodically evaluated for effectiveness.

 - Continuously improve the effectiveness and scalability of security programs. Develop clear accountability, measurable outcomes, repeatable processes, and automation. Proactively identify emerging risks and requirements, communicate recommendations to leadership, and drive improvements across organizational boundaries.




REQUIREMENTS:

 - 10+ years of experience in information security, including significant experience leading security governance, compliance, assurance, or risk management programs.

 - Demonstrated experience owning major security compliance and assurance programs such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or comparable regulatory frameworks, including direct engagement with auditors, assessors, and external stakeholders.

 - Strong technical understanding of modern cloud infrastructure, SaaS application security, identity and access management, vulnerability management, and security architecture. Ability to independently evaluate technical findings, control designs, and remediation approaches.

 - Proven ability to build and improve security programs, independently identify control gaps and emerging requirements, establish priorities, and translate security risks into actionable organizational plans.

 - Experience managing and developing security professionals, establishing high standards for quality and accountability, and leading programs across distributed teams.

 - Experience with third-party risk assessments, customer security diligence, and security risk management, including the ability to evaluate complex technical and contractual security requirements.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to influence engineering teams, business leaders, auditors, and external stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.




COMPENSATION:

$200,000/year - $260,000/year + equity + benefits

Note: This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels, and the actual base salary within that range will be determined by several components including but not limited to the individual's experience, skills, and qualifications.




PERKS:

 - Employer paid group health insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles)

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Regular company-wide in-person events

 - Home office stipend, and more!




CORPORATE VALUES:

 - Follow Through

 - Deep Understanding

 - Whatever It Takes

 - Do Something Smart

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid) / Remote · Department: Engineering

PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.

Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis is critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes.

At PathAI, we are constantly evaluating our tech stack and our current tools consist of:

• Languages & Frameworks: Python, JavaScript, Django / DRF, FastAPI, Vue

• Platform: EKS (Kubernetes), S3, RDS / PostgreSQL, SQS, MSK (Kafka)

• Tooling: GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, Docker, Datadog, Orca, AWS GuardDuty, Cloudflare, GCP

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer who thinks like a software engineer. You will make secure development the easy path at PathAI by embedding security into how our engineers design, build, and ship software, and by building the tools and automation that help them do their jobs securely without slowing down. Your goal is not just to find vulnerabilities, but to actively reduce the friction engineers experience when identifying, prioritizing, and resolving cybersecurity issues.

• You will champion secure coding practices across our Python and JavaScript codebases, partnering with engineering teams through design reviews, threat modeling, and code review.

• You will design and build internal tools, automation, and paved-road patterns (e.g., secure libraries, CI/CD guardrails, pre-commit checks, self-service workflows) that help engineers write and ship secure software by default.

• You will own and continuously improve security tooling in the SDLC, including SAST, DAST, SCA/dependency scanning, secrets detection, container and IaC scanning, and tune it to maximize signal and minimize noise.

• You will streamline how cybersecurity issues are triaged, tracked, and remediated, making findings actionable, well-prioritized, and integrated into the tools engineers already use (GitLab, Orca, AWS GuardDuty, Jira, Bugbounty).

• You will collaborate with product, infrastructure, machine learning, and IT teams to secure our cloud-native SaaS platform on AWS and Kubernetes.

• You will drive and uphold high engineering standards, bringing consistency to the codebases and pipelines you encounter and ensuring security controls are adequately reviewed, tested, and integrated.

• You will foster a culture of continuous learning by mentoring teammates, delivering secure coding guidance and training, and sharing technical knowledge.

• You will contribute to a SaaS platform ensuring reliability, data integrity, protection of sensitive health data, and compliance with industry standards.

• You will collaborate with clinical, QA, and regulatory teams to ensure security activities meet validation expectations and support audits and inspection readiness.

Who You Are:

(Required)

• You have a BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity or closely related technical field.

• You have 5+ years of full life cycle development and/or application security engineering experience.

• You have a strong, hands-on understanding of secure coding practices and common vulnerability classes (e.g., OWASP Top 10, CWE), and can explain both the risk and the fix to developers.

• You have demonstrated experience building tools and automation that improve developer workflows, ideally in Python.

• You have demonstrated experience integrating security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.

• You have demonstrated the ability to take on complex tasks, learn quickly and work in a proactive manner.

• You have a demonstrated ability to collaborate with a distributed team and to work autonomously on projects; You have demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment.

• You have strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to attend client-facing meetings and explain technical concepts to non-experts.

• You have demonstrated cloud platform experience (AWS).

Preferred:

• You have experience managing cybersecurity and risk in a controlled or regulated environment (e.g., FDA-regulated medical device software, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, HIPAA).

• You have an advanced degree or relevant security certification (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, CSSLP, CISSP).

• You have experience working in the healthtech industry, including working with HL7, HL7 FHIR, or DICOM.

• You have experience with threat modeling, vulnerability management programs, and risk-based prioritization of findings.

• You have hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, e.g. GitLab CI.

• You have demonstrated knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and container orchestration tools like Kubernetes, including securing them.

• You have knowledge of some IaC framework (e.g., Terraform) and experience applying policy-as-code or IaC security scanning.

• You have experience with cloud security tooling and practices (IAM, network segmentation, logging and monitoring, CSPM).

• You have excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects efficiently.

This is either a remote position or a hybrid position based in Boston, MA. Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $127,500 - $195,500. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

PathAI is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Workplace Coordinator

Dyna Robotics builds general-purpose robots powered by a proprietary embodied AI foundation model with top-in-industry generalization and real-world performance. Already deployed with customers across multiple industries, our robots do commercial-grade work in the physical world. Our team comes from Google DeepMind, Meta, and Cruise, and we're backed by CRV, First Round, and other leading investors.



As a Workplace Coordinator at Dyna Robotics, you’ll keep our offices running smoothly and make sure every employee has a great workplace experience. You’ll own day-to-day operations, procurement and inventory, office moves, and company events. You’re organized, detail-oriented, and at home in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift, and you’re resourceful enough to make decisions on your own. As we grow, you’ll help shape the processes and systems that let our workplace and inventory operations scale.



This is a full-time, on-site position in Redwood City.



What You’ll Do

 - Workplace Operations: Manage daily office operations, including mail, kitchen and snacks, supplies, and maintenance requests, and serve as the go-to resource for workplace needs. Keep conference rooms and shared spaces clean, stocked, and ready.

 - Guests, Travel & Onboarding: Oversee visitor management, including pre-registration NDAs, guest check-in, and badge systems. Coordinate flights, hotels, and workspace setup for teammates visiting from other offices, and partner with IT and People Ops so new hires have workstations ready on day one.

 - Inventory & Receiving: Receive, ship, and track packages, and receive, inspect, and store incoming parts. Support the Inventory Associate with cycle counts and stockroom organization, keeping quantities accurate and parts kitted for builds, repairs, and R&D.

 - Office Moves: Plan and run office moves with movers, contractors, and IT/network vendors.

 - Events & Offsites: Plan and support company events, offsites, and team meals, including catering and A/V.

 - Workplace Safety: Help build and maintain our safety program, including emergency plans, first aid supplies, and training and drills.



What You’ll Bring

 - The Experience: 2–3 years in workplace, facilities, or office operations, preferably at a startup.

 - Ownership: You move fast and work independently, juggling multiple requests and shifting priorities without needing direction.

 - Process Improvement: You speak up with ideas to improve our workplace, procurement, and inventory processes, and you fix recurring issues (like supply shortages or room booking conflicts) at the root rather than relying on quick fixes.

 - Low Ego: You’re willing to take on any task, from room setup to receiving robot shipments.

 - Technical Comfort: You’re tech-savvy and comfortable with workstation setup, A/V troubleshooting, and working around robot hardware.

 - Flexibility: You’re willing to work after hours and weekends for events, office moves, and urgent needs.





At Dyna Robotics, we build technology for the real world, which requires a team as diverse as the environments our robots inhabit. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to technical rigor and mutual respect.

Don’t let a checklist stop you. Data shows that underrepresented groups often only apply if they meet 100% of the criteria. We value problem-solving and grit over keyword matching. If you’re passionate about robotics, no matter your discipline, we want to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Integrations and New Verticals
jobs.location: Remote; San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Integrations and New Verticals to join our growing team! As Senior Product Manager, Integrations and New Verticals, you’ll own the third-party integrations that power Figure’s mortgage and lending products and drive the product roadmap for a set of emerging HELOC growth channels. Integrations run through every step of our HELOC funnel and loan origination system (LOS): property and public record data, collateral valuation, credit, income and identity verification, document generation and eSign, notarization, and recording. Each one shapes how quickly a borrower gets an offer, how confidently we underwrite, and how smoothly a loan officer or partner gets a loan to funding. You’ll own the full lifecycle of these integrations, from improving the vendors we have and onboarding new ones to holding vendors accountable to the quality and SLAs our borrowers and partners depend on. You’ll build the monitoring that makes integration health visible across the company and use funnel, conversion, and quality data to decide where the next investment goes. This is a hands-on role: you write the requirements, run the vendor calls, and stay close to the details. You’ll also own the core product roadmap for new HELOC growth channels like SMB brokers, select fintech partnerships, and home improvement and solar contractors, early, high-upside channels where the product and partner workflow are still being defined.

What You’ll Do

• Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for all third-party integrations across Figure’s mortgage and lending products, including data integrations, integrations that feed credit and underwriting workflows, and the vendor services behind each stage of the HELOC funnel (property data, valuation, credit, income and identity verification, document generation, notarization, recording, and debt payoff)

• Drive a prioritized roadmap of improvements to existing vendor integrations, measured by funnel conversion, borrower and loan officer engagement, underwriting quality, and LOS usability

• Evaluate, select, and onboard new vendors that improve HELOC and LOS functionality or unlock new capabilities, from due diligence through contracting, build, QA, and launch, with Engineering, Credit, Compliance, Legal, and Operations

• Navigate the trade-offs that make or break an integration, including data quality and coverage, latency, cost, security, compliance, redundancy, and cross-team dependencies

• Build and maintain dashboards that monitor integration health and vendor performance against contracted quality and SLA commitments, surface issues early, and drive resolution

• Hold vendors accountable when they breach SLAs or fall short of borrower and partner needs, and own escalations, remediation plans, and renewal and replacement decisions with Legal and Finance

• Own the core product roadmap for emerging HELOC verticals and GTM channels (SMB brokers, select fintech partnerships, and home improvement and solar contractors), defining the partner workflow, product experience, and integration surface each needs to scale

• Synthesize feedback from borrowers, loan officers, partners, Operations, and Support into clear priorities: what problem to solve, for whom, and why it matters

• Drive feature development end to end: write requirements, partner with Engineering, GTM, Design, and other cross-functional stakeholders, launch, analyze results, and iterate

What We Look For

• 7+ years of experience as a Product Manager

• Fintech, lending, or mortgage experience (preferred)

• Experience shipping and owning third-party integrations, such as vendor APIs, data providers, embedded partner services, or platform integrations

• Strong understanding of APIs, data contracts, and failure modes, enough to hold peer-level conversations with Engineering and vendor technical teams

• Track record of managing vendor relationships with commercial rigor: evaluating options, negotiating scope and SLAs, measuring performance, and making renewal or replacement calls

• Experience defining monitoring, KPIs, and SLA frameworks for operational systems, and using that data to drive prioritization and accountability

• Active use of AI tools in your own work, with a point of view on how automation, insights, and agents should show up in integration and verification workflows

• Proven ability to operate with speed and ownership in fast-moving environments, driving clarity and execution without heavy process

• Energized by external-facing work with vendors and channel partners

• Strong analytical and structured thinking, with comfort evaluating trade-offs across cost, quality, speed, and compliance

• Highly collaborative and low-ego, working seamlessly with Engineering, Design, Data, Credit, Compliance, Operations, GTM, and executive stakeholders to turn ideas into an end product

• Comfort navigating ambiguity and excitement about defining the product and partner model for new channels at the intersection of mortgage lending and fintech

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment

• Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures

• Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes

• Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team

Salary

• Base Compensation Range: $183,600 - $275,400/yr

• 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly

• Company equity in the form of RSUs

While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Client Services

• Be the client’s trusted product contact, leading product updates in partner meetings and quarterly business reviews

• Strong understanding of the healthcare landscape, including different types of healthcare professionals, specialties, and patient needs.

jobs.title: Intern, Product Intelligence Engineering (AI/ML)
jobs.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

We are seeking a motivated Product Intelligence, Engineering Intern to join our team developing AI/ML analytics applications for semiconductor manufacturing. This internship offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience building software used in advanced manufacturing environments while working alongside experienced engineers.

As an intern, you’ll contribute to real development projects, learn how scalable backend systems are designed and tested, and gain exposure to the full software development lifecycle. You’ll work with technologies such as Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, gRPC, Linux, and containerized applications, while learning how software and AI/ML are applied to semiconductor manufacturing.

Throughout the internship, you’ll receive guidance and mentorship from experienced engineers while taking ownership of a defined project or set of technical deliverables.

What You’ll Do

• Contribute to the design, development, and testing of backend services supporting our AI/ML analytics platform.

• Work on a defined internship project with meaningful technical deliverables and business impact.

• Write clean, reliable, and well-tested code with support and feedback from experienced engineers.

• Gain hands-on experience working with large-scale telemetry and manufacturing equipment data.

• Assist with developing and improving APIs, data pipelines, backend services, and application functionality.

• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and troubleshooting.

• Learn how software is developed and deployed in secure semiconductor manufacturing environments.

• Collaborate with software, product, field, and engineering teams to understand requirements and develop technical solutions.

• Document your work, technical approach, testing, and project outcomes.

• Present your internship project, key learnings, and results to the team at the conclusion of the internship.

What You’ll Need

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.

• Programming experience through coursework, research, personal projects, previous internships, or similar hands-on work.

• Experience with or interest in learning Go and/or Python.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, APIs, databases, and version control.

• Familiarity with Linux and database technologies such as PostgreSQL is a plus.

• Interest in backend development, distributed systems, data-intensive applications, or AI/ML.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn new technologies.

• Ability to collaborate with engineers and communicate technical ideas clearly.

• Curiosity, initiative, and an interest in taking ownership of a meaningful technical project.

Nice to Have

• Previous coursework, research, or project experience involving AI/ML applications.

• Exposure to technologies such as Go, Python, PostgreSQL, gRPC, Kafka, Redis, Docker, C#, or C++.

• Experience with cloud, containerized, distributed, or data-intensive applications.

• Familiarity with React, TypeScript, or JavaScript.

• Experience working with time-series or high-volume datasets.

• Exposure to or interest in semiconductor manufacturing, advanced manufacturing, or engineering technology.

• Previous technical internship, research, lab, or software project experience.

What You’ll Gain

• Hands-on experience developing software for real-world semiconductor manufacturing applications.

• Exposure to the intersection of software engineering, AI/ML, data analytics, and semiconductor technology.

• Practical experience with modern backend technologies and large-scale data.

• Mentorship and technical guidance from experienced engineers.

• Experience collaborating within a multidisciplinary engineering environment.

• A defined technical project that allows you to apply your academic knowledge to a real engineering challenge.

• The opportunity to present your work and accomplishments at the end of the internship.

Additional Details

Travel: Depending on the project and business needs, interns may have opportunities to interact with field teams or visit relevant facilities.

Security & Compliance: Some projects may involve secure semiconductor manufacturing environments. Interns will be expected to follow applicable confidentiality, information-security, and export-control requirements.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:

Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. jobs.title: Real Estate Photographer - Odessa/Midland, TX
jobs.description:
Role Mission

Are you a visual storyteller with an eye for detail and a knack for seamless execution?

Ziprent (a subsidiary of TurboTenant) is looking for a independent contractor (1099) Real Estate Photographer & Field Operations Specialist to be our eyes and ears on the ground. This isn’t just about snapping a few photos; it’s about crafting the digital first impression for our rental properties and ensuring every home is "rent-ready" through meticulous property walkthroughs and technical setups.

In this role, you’ll serve as a vital link in our growth engine, transforming empty spaces into high-performing listings. You’ll work independently to manage everything from 3D tours and high-fidelity photography to smart lockbox installations and condition reporting. If you love the freedom of the road and have a "tech-forward" approach, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities:

• Visual Storytelling: Deliver 15–25+ professionally edited, high-quality interior and exterior photos that make our listings pop.

• Immersive Tech: Capture Zillow 3D tours and digital floor plans using a 360° camera to provide prospective tenants with a "true-to-life" experience.

• Property Stewardship: Perform initial property walkthroughs and submit comprehensive condition reports to ensure our high standards are met.

• Operational Logistics: Take the lead on key management, including the pick-up, installation, and battery maintenance of smart lockboxes.

• High-Velocity Response: Maintain a "Be Better" mindset by responding promptly to new assignments and ensuring a 24-hour turnaround on all reports and deliverables.

• Territory Mastery: Serving our local community and surrounding region, with a willingness to travel a 35–50+ mile radius to support our expanding market.

Qualifications:

• Proven Experience: A strong real estate photography portfolio showcasing your ability to capture spaces effectively.

• Tech-Savvy Toolkit: Professional gear including a high-quality wide-angle lens and a 360° camera compatible with Zillow.

• Editing Expertise: Advanced photo editing skills to ensure every shot is polished and professional.

• Mobile Proficiency: An updated mobile device capable of capturing clear, detailed images for on-site walkthrough reports.

• Collaborative Spirit: Excellent written communication skills and a professional demeanor when representing the Ziprent/TurboTenant brand.

• Reliability: A valid driver’s license, a reliable vehicle, and a flexible schedule to handle multiple shoots per month.

• Location: You must live within 35 miles of the market area to be considered for this role.

Bonus SuperPowers:

• Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with FHA and housing compliance (smoke alarms, CO detectors, etc.).

• Efficient Workflow: You stay ahead of the curve by leveraging modern tools and smart processes to streamline documentation, reporting, and day-to-day tasks—maximizing productivity without sacrificing quality.

• Tech Comfort: You have a "can-do" attitude when it comes to learning new property management software.

• AI-Native Workflow: You use modern tools to streamline your editing or reporting process for maximum efficiency.

• Hyper-Detail Oriented: You notice the small things—from a loose door handle to a flickering light—that others might miss.

Our "Be Better" Culture:

At TurboTenant, we live by the Be Better mantra. Our high-performance culture makes us relentless in our efforts to Be Better at serving our landlords and renters, and in unlocking the potential in one another.

What does our Be Better culture mean to you?

• You’ll be in an environment that pushes you to reach your potential.

• You’ll make a massive impact on our landlords, renters, company, and the proptech industry.

• You’ll be on the highest performing team of your career.

About Us:

At TurboTenant, we simplify the complex and intimidating process of managing your own rental property. And we do it through an elegant software platform for small, “do-it-yourself” landlords and their tenants. But don’t take our word for it. Read reviews from some of our 1 million landlords.

Quantity of Jobs:

Number of job requests varies by market region. This is a contracted 1099 position, and requests are sent out on an as-needed basis. Most markets average 3 –10+ jobs per month.

Candidates should be flexible and comfortable with limited assignments initially while the market and workload grow.

The role requires completion of a background check and signing of an independent contractor agreement.

Compensation

• $225–$325+ per listing appointment (varies based on property size and scope) Includes: professionally edited photos, Zillow 3D tour, floor plan, initial walkthrough report, and lockbox installation with key management $50/hour for additional as-needed tasks Lockbox Pick-Up: $30–$60 per lockbox (depending on distance) Travel Compensation: Paid for travel exceeding 35 miles each way (70 miles round trip) Reimbursed at $1.20 per mile beyond this threshold

Salary Range

$1—$100,000 USD

Additional Information

TurboTenant is proud to serve a diverse group of landlords and renters. We strive to reflect that diversity within our team. Employment at TurboTenant is based on merit, competence, performance, and business need. TurboTenant celebrates being an equal opportunity employer and never discriminates based on race, color, genetic information, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), age, or any other basis protected by law.

At this time, employer-based visa sponsorship is not available. All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Next Steps

Ready to work on the highest performing team of your career at TurboTenant? Submit your resume and we’ll be in touch soon.

jobs.title: Delivery Driver: East Wenatchee - 595 Grant Road, Suite 595-1
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our

delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it

because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible

schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be.

You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if

you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so

fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 18 years of age or older.

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

Additional Information:

• Pay- $17.13 (minimum wage) plus mileage and tips
• Healthcare (after 90 days and must work 40 hours per week)
• Flexible schedule
• Employee discounts
• Paid sick leave

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

jobs.title: Portfolio & Investment Operations Manager
jobs.location: Remote; Reno, NV; Charlotte, NC; Dallas, TX
jobs.description:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Portfolio & Investment Operations Manager to join our growing team! As Portfolio & Investment Operations Manager, you’ll own asset management for a portfolio of residential transition loans (RTL)/bridge loans and home equity lines of credit (HELOCs) across securitizations, forward flow agreements, and joint ventures. You’ll be the primary point of accountability for the ongoing performance, compliance, and economics of these portfolios and joint ventures, bridging deal structuring and live operations by turning portfolio management objectives and servicing, warehouse, and sale documents into repeatable practices. This is a newly created role on our Capital Markets team, supporting a leading structured finance platform with multiple institutional counterparties.

What You’ll Do

• Track performance of mortgage assets, including origination trends, payoffs, delinquency, extensions, draws, and loss metrics across warehouse and owned positions

• Produce recurring portfolio reports for internal and institutional stakeholders, and support board and investor reporting cycles

• Maintain a current view of concentration limits, eligibility criteria, and covenant compliance across the portfolio

• Build and maintain portfolio dashboards and trackers covering performance, cash flows, and key risk metrics

jobs.title: Senior IT Help Desk Technician
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.




WHO WE ARE:

We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy.




WHO YOU ARE:

You’re the face of our IT department. When someone has a problem, you’re usually the first person they talk to, and you leave them feeling heard, helped and a little more confident with their tools. You enjoy people as much as technology: you’re patient, approachable and good at explaining technical things in plain language to engineers, executives and new hires. You’re the kind of person who walks over to someone’s desk instead of just closing a ticket, and who notices when a team is struggling before they ask. You also have solid technical depth across Windows, macOS and Microsoft 365. You know that in a regulated environment, good service and good security go together.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Be the friendly, go-to point of contact for IT support across the company, in person, on chat and through tickets

 - Build strong relationships with teams across engineering, operations and leadership so IT is seen as a partner, not a roadblock

 - Resolve escalated hardware, software, account and network issues for Windows, macOS and Linux users

 - Lead new hire onboarding: set up laptops and accounts, and walk people through our tools and security practices on their first day

 - Support Microsoft 365 GCC High, including user accounts, email, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams

 - Manage devices through Microsoft Intune and Jamf: enrollment, apps, updates and compliance

 - Help users with Okta sign-in and MFA, and explain new security controls in a way people understand and accept

 - Troubleshoot Ubiquiti and Cisco network issues at the desk and in the office

 - Mentor junior technicians, and share what you learn through clear documentation and how-to guides

 - Gather feedback from users and suggest improvements to our tools, processes and support experience

 - Follow CMMC 2.0 and ITAR/EAR requirements in day-to-day support, and help keep our environment compliant




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 3+ years of experience in an IT help desk or desktop support role

 - Excellent communication and people skills, with a genuine enjoyment of working with others

 - A patient, positive, customer-first attitude, even when things are busy

 - Experience supporting both Windows and macOS users; Linux experience is a plus

 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Jamf

 - Experience supporting Microsoft 365; GCC or GCC High experience is a strong plus

 - Familiarity with Ubiquiti and Cisco networking

 - Familiarity with CMMC 2.0 and ITAR/EAR requirements, or a willingness to learn quickly

 - 2+ years of experience working in a startup environment

 - Ability to work full-time in office, Monday through Friday

 - Must be a U.S. citizen




PERKS & BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment
   
   


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Veterinary Scribe (Per Diem) - Winter Park, FL
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the best experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Scribe, you’ll play a crucial role in optimizing the patient care experience by building accurate, detailed medical records, setting the foundation for exceptional care. This role isn’t just about documentation. It’s your gateway to an emergency career, where you can grow where you want to go and gain firsthand experience in the ER learning an invaluable skill for the future. By shadowing and partnering with our doctors, you’ll feel empowered to take your career to unexpected places and be respected as a key member of the team. Here, you’ll have the support and freedom to forge a path that’s uniquely yours, expanding your skills and opening doors to new possibilities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Compose electronic medical records

• Submit lab work and notify doctor when results are in

• Assist doctors with any non-clinical duties

• Communicate effectively with every member of the medical team

• Maintain professionalism and an exemplary work ethic

• Write clearly and concisely and able to type quickly

WHAT YOU NEED

• Undergraduate or postgraduate student with an interest in a future career in veterinary emergency medicine

• Detail oriented, with strong communication and multitasking skills

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor, as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs; this is not a remote position

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.




WHO WE ARE:

We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy.




WHO YOU ARE:

You’re the engineer who keeps our systems secure, reliable and running smoothly behind the scenes. You design things properly the first time, automate anything you do twice, and document everything so others can follow. You’re at home in Microsoft 365, identity platforms, MDM, servers and networks, and you can move between Windows, macOS and Linux without missing a beat. You’ve worked in regulated environments, and you understand that CMMC, ITAR and EAR requirements have to be built into every system from the start. You’re also a strong collaborator: you work closely with the help desk, explain your decisions clearly, and enjoy helping engineers get what they need while keeping our environment compliant.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Administer and secure our Microsoft 365 GCC High tenant, including Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and Entra ID

 - Manage identity and access through Okta, including SSO, MFA, conditional access and user lifecycle automation

 - Build and maintain device policies in Microsoft Intune and Jamf: configuration profiles, compliance, patching, encryption and app deployment

 - Design, deploy and maintain our Ubiquiti and Cisco network infrastructure, including switching, wireless, firewalls and VPN

 - Manage Windows, macOS and Linux servers and services, both on-premises and in AWS GovCloud or Azure Government

 - Implement and monitor CMMC 2.0 controls, maintain the System Security Plan (SSP) and POA&M, and collect evidence for assessments

 - Ensure systems that store or process controlled technical data meet ITAR and EAR requirements

 - Own backups, disaster recovery, logging and monitoring, and work with our SIEM to investigate and respond to security events

 - Automate routine work with PowerShell, Bash or Python

 - Lead migrations and rollouts of new tools, from planning and testing through user communication

 - Serve as the escalation point for the help desk, and mentor technicians on complex issues

 - Write and maintain system documentation, runbooks, and configuration standards




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 5+ years of experience as a systems administrator or systems engineer

 - Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 GCC and GCC High

 - 3+ years administering Microsoft Intune and Jamf MDM platforms

 - Strong Windows and macOS administration experience; Linux experience is a huge plus

 - Experience with identity platforms such as Okta and Entra ID, including SSO and MFA

 - Experience designing and managing Ubiquiti and Cisco networks

 - Experience administering a CMMC 2.0 compliant environment

 - Working knowledge of CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-171 and ITAR/EAR compliance requirements

 - Experience with AWS GovCloud or Azure Government is a strong plus

 - Scripting and automation skills in PowerShell, Bash or Python

 - Clear communication skills, and an enjoyment of working with others across the company

 - 2+ years of experience working in a startup environment

 - Ability to work full-time in office, Monday through Friday

 - Must be a U.S. citizen




PERKS & BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment
   
   


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Associate Product Marketing Manager – GRC
jobs.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in a diverse, inclusive culture centered on great people practices, learning opportunities, and fun! Our culture blends entrepreneurial spirit with enterprise investment, giving you the chance to move quickly with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

This role is based in the US and operates as a key member of a globally distributed marketing team, collaborating closely with colleagues across the US, CAD, UK, and EMEA to deliver consistent, high-performing digital programs at scale.

Job Overview

The Associate Product Marketing Manager, GRC will support the go-to-market strategy and execution for select products in Mitratech's GRC portfolio. This role will focus on positioning and messaging, competitive intelligence, product launches, and sales enablement, working closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, and Customer Marketing. We're looking for a hands-on marketer who can own defined projects, turn complex product and market information into clear, customer-facing messaging, and collaborate effectively across teams. The ideal candidate is curious, proactive, organized, and comfortable using data and AI tools to make marketing work more efficient.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Launch & GTM Execution

• Support go-to-market activities for new products, capabilities, and feature releases.

• Translate product updates into launch messaging, sales materials, presentations, and other customer-facing assets.

• Coordinate with Product Management, Demand Generation, Customer Marketing, and Sales to support launch execution.

• Support cross-sell and upsell initiatives by developing messaging and materials that help customers understand the value of additional products and capabilities.

• Help ensure product positioning is consistently represented across relevant marketing and sales channels.

Sales Enablement

• Develop and maintain sales enablement materials including buyer's guides, competitive guides, presentations, FAQs, objection-handling resources, and product messaging.

• Manage the internal sales enablement tool and sales asset repository and act as primary administrator

• Support sales training and internal communications around new products, releases, positioning, and competitive insights.

• Provide timely support for sales requests related to product messaging, competitive information, and deal-specific needs.

AI-Enabled Workflows

• Use AI tools to streamline research, competitive monitoring, content development, and other repetitive marketing workflows.

• Help test, improve, and maintain AI-assisted workflows while ensuring outputs remain accurate and aligned with business needs.

• Come up with new ways to use AI in the PMM lifecycle and build skills and agents to assist

Competitive Intelligence & Win/Loss

• Monitor competitors, market trends, customer needs, and developments across the GRC landscape.

• Support the development and ongoing maintenance of competitive battlecards and sales resources for assigned products.

• Support win/loss analysis by organizing feedback and identifying trends.

Requirements & Skills:

• 2-3 years of relevant experience in product marketing, B2B technology, SaaS, risk, compliance, or a related field.

• Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, or Customer teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex products and concepts for different audiences.

• Experience creating marketing and sales enablement materials for B2B audiences.

• Comfortable conducting market and competitive research and turning findings into practical insights and assets.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

• Comfortable working with marketing or business metrics and using data to inform decisions.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve research, content creation, analysis, or marketing workflows.

• Experience in GRC, risk, compliance, cybersecurity, legal technology, or enterprise SaaS is an asset.

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is an asset.

What Success Looks Like Within the first 6–12 months, you will:

• Develop a strong understanding of Mitratech's GRC portfolio, customers, personas, and competitive landscape.

• Become a reliable partner to Product Management and Sales on product messaging and go-to-market execution for assigned products.

• Deliver high-quality positioning, launch, competitive, and sales enablement materials with increasing independence.

• Contribute meaningful competitive and win/loss insights that improve messaging and sales effectiveness.

• Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to make Product Marketing workflows more efficient.

• Build strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer teams.

This role can be performed 100% remote anywhere in the US. Given the need for team collaboration and meeting overlap, candidates who can align with Eastern Time Zone business hours are strongly preferred. Anticipated Pay Range: 70,000-80,000 USD Annually.

Mitratech is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, national or ethnic origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, disability, or veteran status.
